pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.health.tip2.en: Ask your bot puts the question in your Chief of Staff's chat for you.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.health.why.text: Saiba que o Murage está funcionando e resolva em um passo quando não estiver.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.health.why.en: Know Murage is working, and fix it in one step when it is not.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.routines.intro.text: O que seus bots fazem em horários marcados. Clique em uma rotina ou marca para abri-la.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.routines.intro.en: Things your bots do on a schedule. Click a routine or a mark to open it.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.routines.tip1.text: Peça a um bot, com suas palavras, para fazer algo em horário marcado.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.routines.tip1.en: Ask a bot in words to do something on a schedule.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.routines.tip2.text: Abra uma rotina para executá-la agora, pausá-la ou mudar quando ela roda.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.routines.tip2.en: Open a routine to run it now, pause it or change when it runs.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.routines.tip3.text: As rotinas seguem o nível do bot, a menos que você dê um próprio a uma delas.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.routines.tip3.en: Routines follow their bot's level unless you give one its own.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.routines.why.text: Veja cada tarefa agendada em uma semana.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.routines.why.en: See every scheduled job in one week.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.routine.intro.text: Uma rotina: quando ela roda, o que faz e como foram as últimas execuções.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.routine.intro.en: One routine: when it runs, what it does and how its last runs went.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.routine.tip1.text: Execute agora para ver o que ela faz antes da próxima vez.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.routine.tip1.en: Run it now to see what it does before the next time.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.routine.tip2.text: Uma execução que parou diz o motivo. Abra para ver.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.routine.tip2.en: A run that stopped says why. Open it to see.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.routine.why.text: Mude uma tarefa agendada sem precisar procurá-la.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.routine.why.en: Change one scheduled job without hunting for it.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.bot.intro.text: Tudo sobre {name}: quem ele é, o que pode fazer e do que se lembra.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.bot.intro.en: Everything about {name}: who it is, what it may do and what it remembers.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.bot.tip1.text: Permissões define com que frequência {name} pergunta antes de agir.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.bot.tip1.en: Permissions sets how often {name} asks before acting.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.bot.tip2.text: Acesso define a pasta de trabalho e os apps de {name}.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.bot.tip2.en: Access sets {name}'s working folder and apps.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.bot.tip3.text: As mudanças são salvas conforme você as faz.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.bot.tip3.en: Changes save as you make them.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.bot.why.text: Um só lugar para as configurações de um bot.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.bot.why.en: One place for one bot's settings.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.bot.overview.intro.text: O papel de {name}, sua equipe e um resumo de como ele está configurado.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.bot.overview.intro.en: {name}'s role, its team and a summary of how it is set up.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.bot.overview.tip1.text: O papel decide quem {name} pode contatar e quem pode contatá-lo.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.bot.overview.tip1.en: The role decides who {name} can reach and who can reach it.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.bot.overview.why.text: Uma leitura rápida de um bot antes de mudar qualquer coisa.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.bot.overview.why.en: A quick read of one bot before you change anything.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.bot.identity.intro.text: O nome, a imagem, a personalidade de {name} e as instruções permanentes que ele segue.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.bot.identity.intro.en: {name}'s name, picture, personality and the standing instructions it follows.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.bot.identity.tip1.text: Diga com palavras simples qual é o trabalho; {name} lê isso toda vez.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.bot.identity.tip1.en: Say what the job is in plain words; {name} reads it every time.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.bot.identity.why.text: Diga a um bot quem ele é e como trabalhar.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.bot.identity.why.en: Tell a bot who it is and how to work.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.bot.shapes.intro.text: Tudo o que {name} lê antes de responder, na ordem em que lê.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.bot.shapes.intro.en: Everything {name} reads before it answers, in the order it reads it.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.bot.shapes.tip1.text: As regras da casa vêm primeiro e todo bot as segue.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.bot.shapes.tip1.en: House rules come first and every bot follows them.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.bot.shapes.why.text: Entenda por que um bot se comporta como se comporta.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.bot.shapes.why.en: See why a bot behaves the way it does.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.bot.skills.intro.text: Know-how passo a passo que {name} pode usar, vindo da biblioteca ou aprendido com você.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.bot.skills.intro.en: Step-by-step know-how {name} can use, from the library or learned from you.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.bot.skills.tip1.text: Desligue uma skill para mantê-la sem que {name} a use.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.bot.skills.tip1.en: Turn a skill off to keep it without {name} using it.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.bot.skills.why.text: Dê a um bot um know-how que ele possa reutilizar.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.bot.skills.why.en: Give a bot know-how it can reuse.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.bot.learning.intro.text: O que {name} aprendeu com seu feedback e o que você pode desfazer.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.bot.learning.intro.en: What {name} learned from your feedback, and what you can undo.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.bot.learning.tip1.text: Use o botão de feedback abaixo de uma resposta para dizer a {name} o que funcionou.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.bot.learning.tip1.en: Use the feedback button under a reply to tell {name} what worked.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.bot.learning.why.text: Veja e desfaça o que um bot aprendeu.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.bot.learning.why.en: See and undo what a bot learned.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.bot.memory.intro.text: O que {name} lembra entre os chats.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.bot.memory.tip1.text: Apague uma memória e {name} deixa de usá-la.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.bot.memory.tip1.en: Delete a memory and {name} stops using it.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.bot.memory.why.text: Confira e corrija o que um bot lembra.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.bot.memory.why.en: Check and correct what a bot remembers.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.bot.routines.tip1.text: Pause uma rotina aqui; ela fica pausada até você ligar de novo.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.bot.routines.tip1.en: Pause a routine here; it stays until you turn it back on.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.bot.routines.why.text: As tarefas agendadas de um bot em uma só lista.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.bot.routines.why.en: One bot's scheduled jobs in one list.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.bot.teams.intro.text: As equipes a que {name} pertence e as notas que ele compartilha com elas.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.bot.teams.intro.en: The teams {name} belongs to and the notes it shares with them.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.bot.teams.tip1.text: As notas de uma equipe chegam a todo bot que faz parte dela.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.bot.teams.tip1.en: A team's notes reach every bot on it.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.bot.teams.why.text: Compartilhe know-how entre um grupo de bots.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.bot.teams.why.en: Share know-how across a group of bots.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.bot.access.intro.text: Onde {name} pode trabalhar: a pasta dele, o computador, o navegador e os apps conectados.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.bot.access.intro.en: Where {name} may work: its folder, the computer, the browser and connected apps.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.bot.access.tip1.text: {name} trabalha dentro da pasta de trabalho, a menos que você permita mais.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.bot.access.tip1.en: {name} works inside its working folder unless you allow more.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.bot.access.tip2.text: Os apps conectados ficam desligados para um bot até você ligá-los.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.bot.access.tip2.en: Connected apps are off for a bot until you turn them on.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.bot.access.why.text: Decida a que um bot pode ter acesso.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.bot.access.why.en: Decide what a bot can reach.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.bot.email.intro.text: O endereço de e-mail próprio de {name}, para quem ele pode escrever e o que enviou.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.bot.email.intro.en: {name}'s own email address, who it may write to and what it sent.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.bot.email.tip1.text: Pause os envios aqui a qualquer momento.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.bot.email.tip1.en: Pause sending here at any time.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.bot.email.why.text: Deixe um bot enviar e receber os próprios e-mails.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.bot.email.why.en: Let a bot send and receive email of its own.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.bot.model.intro.text: O motor e o modelo com que {name} pensa, e o quanto ele pensa.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.bot.model.intro.en: The engine and model {name} thinks with, and how hard it thinks.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.bot.model.tip1.text: Um modelo mais leve é mais rápido e custa menos para tarefas simples.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.bot.model.tip1.en: A lighter model is quicker and costs less for simple jobs.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.bot.model.why.text: Ajuste o raciocínio de um bot ao trabalho dele.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.bot.model.why.en: Match a bot's thinking to its job.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.bot.permissions.intr.text: Com que frequência {name} pergunta antes de agir: Perguntar, Automático, Acesso total ou Sem limites.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.bot.permissions.intr.en: How often {name} asks before it acts: Ask, Auto, Full access or No limits.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.bot.permissions.tip1.text: Perguntar confere com você primeiro; Automático pergunta só nos passos maiores.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.bot.permissions.tip1.en: Ask checks with you first; Auto asks only for bigger steps.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.bot.permissions.tip2.text: Seu bot sempre pergunta antes de pagar ou ler suas chaves, em todos os níveis.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.bot.permissions.tip2.en: Your bot always asks before paying or reading your keys, at every level.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.bot.permissions.why.text: Decida quanto um bot faz sem perguntar.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.bot.permissions.why.en: Decide how much a bot does without asking.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.bot.voice.intro.text: Como {name} soa e quando ele avisa você de algo.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.bot.voice.intro.en: How {name} sounds and when it lets you know something.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.bot.voice.tip1.text: Ligue as respostas faladas para ouvir {name} responder.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.bot.voice.tip1.en: Turn on spoken replies to hear {name} answer.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.bot.voice.why.text: Escolha como um bot chama sua atenção.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.bot.voice.why.en: Choose how a bot gets your attention.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.bot.history.intro.text: Cada chat e tarefa que {name} já teve.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.bot.history.intro.en: Every chat and task {name} has had.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.bot.history.tip1.text: Abra qualquer chat antigo para retomá-lo.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.bot.history.tip1.en: Open any past chat to pick it up again.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.bot.history.why.text: Encontre um chat antigo com um bot.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.bot.history.why.en: Find an old chat with one bot.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.bot.usage.intro.en: How much {name} has used this month.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.bot.usage.tip1.text: Suas próprias chaves e logins aparecem nesses serviços, não aqui.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.bot.usage.tip1.en: Your own keys and sign-ins show up with those services, not here.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.new.intro.text: Comece algo: um bot, um chat, um projeto ou um canal.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.new.intro.en: Start something: a bot, a chat, a project or a channel.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.new.tip1.text: {mod} N cria um novo bot de qualquer lugar.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.new.tip1.en: {mod} N makes a new bot from anywhere.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.new.why.text: Uma só porta para tudo o que você pode começar.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.new.why.en: One door for everything you can start.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.new-bot.intro.text: Diga o que o novo bot deve fazer. O Murage o configura para você conferir.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.new-bot.intro.en: Say what the new bot should do. Murage sets it up for you to check.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.new-bot.tip1.text: Você pode mudar qualquer coisa de um bot depois, nas configurações dele.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.new-bot.tip1.en: You can change anything about a bot later in its settings.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.new-bot.tip2.text: Um novo bot começa no nível Perguntar, então ele confere com você primeiro.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.new-bot.tip2.en: A new bot starts on Ask, so it checks with you first.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.new-bot.why.text: Contrate um bot sem aprender configurações antes.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.new-bot.why.en: Hire a bot without learning settings first.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.connect-app.intro.text: Entre em um app para que um bot possa usá-lo por você.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.connect-app.intro.en: Sign in to an app so a bot can use it for you.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.connect-app.tip1.text: Você entra na página do próprio app. O Murage guarda o login neste computador.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.connect-app.tip1.en: You sign in on the app's own page. Murage keeps the login on this computer.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.connect-app.tip2.text: Cada bot precisa do próprio sim antes de usar o app.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.connect-app.tip2.en: Each bot needs its own yes before it uses the app.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.connect-app.why.text: Deixe um bot trabalhar no Gmail, Slack e outros apps.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.connect-app.why.en: Let a bot work in Gmail, Slack and other apps.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.settings.general.int.text: Toda configuração está aqui, ligada ou desligada. Digite uma palavra para achar uma. Um cartão desligado diz por quê e o que o liga.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.settings.general.int.en: Every setting is here, on or off. Type a word to find one. A card that is off says why and what turns it on.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.settings.general.tip.text: Digite qualquer palavra na busca para chegar à configuração dela.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.settings.general.tip.en: Type any word in the search box to land on its setting.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.settings.general.tip.text: Esta página guarda seu nome, a aparência do app e o idioma.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.settings.general.tip.en: This page holds your name, the app's look and its language.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.settings.general.why.text: Seu perfil e como o app aparece e se comporta.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.settings.general.why.en: Your profile and how the app looks and behaves.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.settings.botDefaults.text: Como os novos bots começam, as regras da casa que todo bot segue e como os bots se revezam.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.settings.botDefaults.en: How new bots start, the house rules every bot follows, and how bots take turns.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.settings.botDefaults.text: As regras da casa valem para todo bot, antigo e novo.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.settings.botDefaults.en: House rules apply to every bot, old and new.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.settings.botDefaults.text: Defina o ponto de partida de cada bot.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.settings.botDefaults.en: Set the starting point for every bot.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.settings.skills.intr.text: Know-how que seus bots podem usar, como guias passo a passo.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.settings.skills.intr.en: Know-how your bots can use, like step-by-step guides.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.settings.skills.tip1.text: Dê uma olhada em uma skill antes de entregá-la a um bot.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.settings.skills.tip1.en: Look through a skill before you give it to a bot.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.settings.skills.why.text: Gerencie o know-how em que todo bot pode se apoiar.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.settings.skills.why.en: Manage the know-how every bot can draw on.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.settings.memory.intr.text: O que seus bots lembram entre as conversas.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.settings.memory.intr.en: What your bots remember between conversations.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.settings.memory.tip1.text: A memória própria de cada bot fica nas configurações desse bot.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.settings.memory.tip1.en: Each bot's own memory is in that bot's settings.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.settings.memory.why.en: Decide how much your bots remember.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.settings.models.intr.text: Os modelos de IA com que seus bots pensam, os programas que os executam e as chaves que pagam por eles.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.settings.models.intr.en: The AI models your bots think with, the programs that run them, and the keys that pay for them.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.settings.models.tip1.text: O Flux Router dá um modelo a cada bot com um só login.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.settings.models.tip1.en: Flux Router gives every bot a model with one sign-in.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.settings.models.tip2.text: Motores lista os programas deste computador que podem executar um bot.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.settings.models.tip2.en: Engines lists the programs on this computer that can run a bot.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.settings.models.why.text: Dê aos seus bots algo com que pensar.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.settings.models.why.en: Give your bots something to think with.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.settings.webSearch.i.text: Busca na web, imagens e voz para seus bots.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.settings.webSearch.i.en: Web search, pictures and voice for your bots.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.settings.webSearch.t.text: Ligue a busca na web para os bots pesquisarem as coisas.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.settings.webSearch.t.en: Turn on web search to let bots look things up.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.settings.webSearch.w.text: Coisas extras que seus bots podem fazer.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.settings.webSearch.w.en: Extra things your bots can do.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.settings.connections.text: Deixe os bots usarem Gmail, Slack, Notion e outros apps.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.settings.connections.en: Let bots use Gmail, Slack, Notion and other apps.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.settings.connections.text: Conecte um app uma vez e depois dê a cada bot permissão para usá-lo.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.settings.connections.en: Connect an app once, then give each bot permission to use it.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.settings.connections.text: Uma só lista de todos os apps que seus bots podem usar.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.settings.connections.en: One list of every app your bots can use.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.settings.channels.in.text: Fale com seus bots pelo Telegram, Slack ou Discord.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.settings.channels.in.en: Talk to your bots from Telegram, Slack or Discord.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.settings.channels.ti.text: As mensagens enviadas lá chegam primeiro ao seu Chief of Staff.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.settings.channels.ti.en: Messages there reach your Chief of Staff first.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.settings.channels.wh.text: Fale com seus bots sem abrir o Murage.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.settings.channels.wh.en: Reach your bots without opening Murage.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.settings.companion.i.text: Use o Murage no celular e em outros dispositivos, e configure o computador e o navegador que seus bots podem usar.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.settings.companion.i.en: Use Murage on your phone and other devices, and set up the computer and browser your bots can use.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.settings.companion.t.text: Conecte seu celular para responder aos bots quando estiver fora.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.settings.companion.t.en: Pair your phone to answer bots when you are away.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.settings.companion.w.text: O Murage no seu celular e seus bots em um computador.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.settings.companion.w.en: Murage on your phone, and your bots on a computer.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.settings.backups.int.text: Guarde uma cópia de tudo e recupere se precisar.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.settings.backups.int.en: Keep a copy of everything, and get it back if you need to.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.settings.backups.tip.text: Um backup que você já restaurou uma vez é um backup em que dá para confiar.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.settings.backups.tip.en: A backup you have restored once is one you can trust.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.settings.backups.why.text: Nada se perde se este computador se perder.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.settings.backups.why.en: Nothing is lost if this computer is.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.settings.usage.intro.text: O que seus bots usaram neste mês. Os valores aparecem quando o Flux Router está conectado.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.settings.usage.intro.en: What your bots used this month. Money shows when Flux Router is connected.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.settings.usage.tip1.text: O uso com suas próprias chaves ou logins é mostrado por esses serviços, não aqui.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.settings.usage.tip1.en: Usage with your own keys or sign-ins is shown by those services, not here.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.settings.usage.tip2.text: Abra um bot para ver o que ele usou por conta própria.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.settings.usage.tip2.en: Open a bot to see what it used on its own.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.settings.about.intro.en: Updates, news from us, and help.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.settings.about.tip1.text: O Murage procura atualizações e avisa antes de instalar uma.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.settings.about.tip1.en: Murage checks for updates and tells you before it installs one.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.settings.about.why.text: Qual versão você tem e o que há de novo.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.settings.about.why.en: Which version you have and what is new.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.help.intro.text: Dicas para a tela em que você está, as páginas de ajuda e um jeito de nos contar o que podemos facilitar.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.help.intro.en: Tips for the screen you are on, the help pages, and a way to tell us what to make easier.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.help.tip1.text: {mod} / abre a ajuda de qualquer lugar, até enquanto você digita.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.help.tip1.en: {mod} / opens help from anywhere, even while typing.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.help.why.text: A resposta para "como eu faço" está sempre a uma tecla de distância.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.help.why.en: The answer to "how do I" is always one key away.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.first-run.hello.titl.en: Getting set up · who you are

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.first-run.hello.intr.text: Seu Chief of Staff diz olá e pergunta seu nome, para que todo bot saiba para quem trabalha.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.first-run.hello.intr.en: Your Chief of Staff says hello and asks your name, so every bot knows who it works for.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.first-run.hello.tip1.text: Responda no chat; você pode mudar depois em Configurações.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.first-run.hello.tip1.en: Answer in the chat; you can change it later in Settings.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.first-run.hello.tip2.text: Feche a lista no topo quando quiser. Nada nela impede você.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.first-run.hello.tip2.en: Close the list at the top whenever you like. Nothing in it stops you.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.first-run.hello.why.text: O que é o Murage: bots que trabalham para você, um chat de cada vez.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.first-run.hello.why.en: What Murage is: bots that work for you, one chat at a time.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.first-run.detect.tit.en: Getting set up · what is here

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.first-run.detect.int.text: O Murage olha o que este computador já tem e que um bot pode usar para pensar.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.first-run.detect.int.en: Murage looks at what this computer already has that a bot can think with.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.first-run.detect.tip.text: Tudo o que for encontrado é conectado para você; nada a mudar.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.first-run.detect.tip.en: Anything found is connected for you; nothing to change.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.first-run.detect.why.text: Use o que você já tem antes de pedir mais.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.first-run.detect.why.en: Use what you already have before asking for more.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.first-run.flux.title.en: Getting set up · switch it on

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.first-run.flux.intro.text: O Flux Router dá aos seus bots um modelo para pensar, com um só login.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.first-run.flux.intro.en: Flux Router gives your bots a model to think with, with one sign-in.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.first-run.flux.tip1.text: Você pode pular isto e conectar seu próprio motor depois.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.first-run.flux.tip1.en: You can pass on this and connect your own engine later.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.first-run.flux.why.text: Os bots precisam de algo para pensar antes de poderem responder.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.first-run.flux.why.en: Bots need something to think with before they can answer.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.first-run.chat.intro.text: Peça algo pequeno ao seu Chief of Staff e veja como ele trabalha.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.first-run.chat.intro.en: Ask your Chief of Staff for something small and watch it work.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.first-run.chat.tip1.text: Um cartão que pergunta é um rascunho. Nada acontece até você tocar no botão dele.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.first-run.chat.tip1.en: A card that asks is a draft. Nothing happens until you press its button.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.first-run.chat.why.text: Veja um bot fazer trabalho de verdade nos primeiros minutos.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.first-run.chat.why.en: See a bot do real work in the first few minutes.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.first-run.flow.title.en: Getting set up · do the thing

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.first-run.flow.intro.text: Dê um trabalho real a um bot, ou peça um em horário marcado.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.first-run.flow.intro.en: Give a bot a real job, or ask for one on a schedule.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.first-run.flow.tip1.text: Diga "toda manhã" e o trabalho vira uma rotina.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.first-run.flow.tip1.en: Say "every morning" and the job becomes a routine.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.first-run.flow.why.text: Saia da configuração com um trabalho já rodando.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.first-run.flow.why.en: Leave set-up with one job already running.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.first-run.strip.intr.text: A lista no topo mostra até onde você chegou na configuração.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.first-run.strip.intr.en: The list at the top shows where you have got to in setting up.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.first-run.strip.tip1.text: Feche a lista quando quiser; ela continua no seu chat.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.first-run.strip.tip1.en: Close the list whenever you like; it stays in your chat.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.first-run.strip.why.text: Mostra o que falta sem nunca bloquear você.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.first-run.strip.why.en: Shows what is left without ever blocking you.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.phone-setup.intro.text: Use o Murage no celular, por meio deste computador.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.phone-setup.intro.en: Use Murage on your phone, through this computer.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.phone-setup.tip1.text: Este computador precisa estar ligado e online para o celular alcançá-lo.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.phone-setup.tip1.en: This computer has to be on and online for the phone to reach it.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.phone-setup.why.text: Responda aos seus bots quando estiver longe da mesa.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.phone-setup.why.en: Answer your bots when you are away from your desk.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.cloud.intro.text: Seus bots, rodando em um computador próprio online, acessados de qualquer navegador.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.cloud.intro.en: Your bots, running on a computer of their own online, reached from any browser.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.cloud.tip1.text: Tudo o que você faz aqui acontece no seu espaço Cloud, não neste dispositivo.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.cloud.tip1.en: Everything you do here happens on your Cloud home, not this device.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.cloud.why.text: Seus bots continuam trabalhando quando seu computador está desligado.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.cloud.why.en: Your bots keep working when your own computer is off.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.files.intro.text: Os arquivos da pasta de trabalho deste bot.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.files.intro.en: The files in this bot's working folder.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.files.tip1.text: Clique em um arquivo para ver uma prévia ao lado do chat.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.files.tip1.en: Click a file to preview it beside the chat.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.files.why.text: Veja o que um bot criou sem sair do chat.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.files.why.en: See what a bot made without leaving the chat.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.map.intro.text: Quem trabalha com quem: cada bot, seu papel e quem ele pode contatar.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.map.intro.en: Who works with whom: every bot, its role and who it can reach.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.map.tip1.text: Clique em um bot para abrir o chat dele.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.map.tip1.en: Click a bot to open its chat.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.map.why.text: Veja de relance como seus bots trabalham juntos.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.map.why.en: See how your bots work together at a glance.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.apps.intro.text: Apps que seus bots podem usar por você, como Gmail, Slack e Notion.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.apps.intro.en: Apps your bots can use for you, like Gmail, Slack and Notion.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.apps.tip1.text: Conecte um app uma vez e depois dê a cada bot o próprio sim.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.apps.tip1.en: Connect an app once, then give each bot its own yes.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.apps.tip2.text: Desconecte um app aqui e nenhum bot poderá usá-lo.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.apps.tip2.en: Disconnect an app here and no bot can use it.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.apps.why.text: Um só lugar para ver todos os apps que seus bots alcançam.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.apps.why.en: One place to see every app your bots can reach.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.skill-recorder.intro.text: Mostre a um bot como você faz algo uma vez. O Murage escreve isso como uma skill para você conferir.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.skill-recorder.intro.en: Show a bot how you do something once. Murage writes it up as a skill for you to check.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.skill-recorder.tip1.text: Dê uma olhada na skill antes de qualquer bot usá-la.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.skill-recorder.tip1.en: Look through the skill before any bot uses it.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.skill-recorder.why.text: Ensine mostrando em vez de escrever instruções.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.skill-recorder.why.en: Teach by showing instead of writing instructions.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.computer.intro.text: A tela e o navegador que este bot está usando, ao vivo.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.computer.intro.en: The screen and browser this bot is using, live.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.computer.tip1.text: Assuma o controle quando quiser; o bot espera até você devolver.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.computer.tip1.en: Take over at any time; the bot waits until you hand back.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.computer.why.text: Veja um bot trabalhar em um computador e entre quando precisar.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.computer.why.en: Watch a bot work on a computer, and step in.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.inspector.intro.text: Cada passo que este bot deu neste chat, em ordem.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.inspector.intro.en: Every step this bot took in this chat, in order.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.inspector.tip1.text: Útil quando um bot fez algo que você não esperava.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.inspector.tip1.en: Useful when a bot did something you did not expect.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.inspector.why.text: Veja exatamente o que um bot fez.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.inspector.why.en: See exactly what a bot did.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.no-engines.intro.text: Seus bots precisam de um motor antes de poderem responder. Conecte um e eles começam na hora.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.no-engines.intro.en: Your bots need an engine before they can answer. Connect one and they start at once.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.no-engines.tip1.text: O Flux Router é o jeito mais rápido: um login, todos os modelos.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.no-engines.tip1.en: Flux Router is the quickest way: one sign-in, every model.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.no-engines.why.text: Faça um bot responder em poucos minutos.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.no-engines.why.en: Get a bot answering in a few minutes.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.rail-fold.intro.text: Bots que você não usou ultimamente, recolhidos para a lista ficar curta.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.rail-fold.intro.en: Bots you have not used lately, folded so the list stays short.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.rail-fold.tip1.text: A linha dos bots recolhidos ainda mostra quais estão trabalhando ou precisam de você.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.rail-fold.tip1.en: The row for collapsed bots still shows which ones are working or need you.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.rail-fold.why.text: Uma lista longa de bots continua fácil de percorrer.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.rail-fold.why.en: A long list of bots stays easy to scan.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.client-header.intro.text: Você está vendo o espaço de um cliente. Tudo aqui pertence a esse cliente.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.client-header.intro.en: You are looking at a client's workspace. Everything here belongs to that client.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.client-header.tip1.text: Volte ao seu próprio espaço pelo menu Você.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.client-header.tip1.en: Switch back to your own workspace from the You menu.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.client-header.why.text: Saiba sempre de quem é o espaço em que você está.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.client-header.why.en: Always know whose workspace you are in.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.clients-card.intro.text: Cada espaço de cliente, quanto gastou e o que está esperando.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.clients-card.intro.en: Every client workspace, what it spent and what is waiting.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.clients-card.tip1.text: Clique em um cliente para abrir o espaço dele.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.clients-card.tip1.en: Click a client to open its workspace.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.clients-card.why.text: Cuide de todos os clientes em um só lugar.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.clients-card.why.en: Look after every client from one place.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.other-workspaces.int.text: Clientes com algo esperando por você, fora do espaço em que você está.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.other-workspaces.int.en: Clients with something waiting on you, beyond the workspace you are in.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.other-workspaces.tip.text: Clique em um cliente para ver o que ele está esperando.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.other-workspaces.tip.en: Click a client to see what it is waiting on.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.other-workspaces.why.text: Nada que espera em outro espaço passa despercebido.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.other-workspaces.why.en: Nothing waiting in another workspace gets missed.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.add-client.intro.text: Conecte o espaço Cloud de um cliente para cuidar dele daqui.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.add-client.intro.en: Pair a client's Cloud home so you can look after it from here.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.add-client.tip1.text: Os bots e chats do cliente ficam no espaço dele.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.add-client.tip1.en: The client's bots and chats stay in their own workspace.

pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.add-client.why.text: Atenda vários clientes de um só desktop.
pt-br:ux.l4a.screen.add-client.why.en: Run several clients from one desktop.

zh:providerError.payment.title.text: 需要处理付款或账户访问权限

zh:providerError.payment.summary.text: 你的 AI 服务提示需要处理付款或账户访问权限。这并不一定表示额度已用完。
zh:providerError.payment.summary.en: Your AI service said payment or account access is needed. That does not always mean you are out of credit.

zh:providerError.payment.resolution.text: 请向你的 AI 服务确认账单和访问权限（如果使用自己的密钥，也请一并检查），并确认你的账户可以使用所选模型，然后重试。
zh:providerError.payment.resolution.en: Check billing and access with your AI service, including your own key if you use one, and that your account can use the model you picked. Then try again.

zh:claudeAccounts.added.text: 账户已添加。请在下方自行登录，然后在模型选择器中选择此账户。现有机器人的选择保持不变。
zh:claudeAccounts.added.en: Account added. Sign in explicitly below, then select this account in a model picker. Existing bot choices are unchanged.

zh:claudeAccounts.removed.text: 已从 Murage 移除。登录状态和凭据文件已保留。
zh:claudeAccounts.removed.en: Removed from Murage. Login and credential files were retained.

zh:claudeAccounts.refreshError.text: 已保存，但无法刷新账户列表。请使用“刷新账户”检查当前状态。
zh:claudeAccounts.refreshError.en: Saved, but the account list could not refresh. Use Refresh accounts to check its current state.

zh:claudeAccounts.fleetRefreshError.text: 已保存，但无法刷新引擎列表。请切换到其他窗口再切回，以重新检查引擎。
zh:claudeAccounts.fleetRefreshError.en: Saved, but the engine list could not refresh. Switch to another window and back to check the engines again.

zh:modelPicker.partialRefresh.text: 部分模型列表无法刷新。已保留其上次保存的模型；详情请查看“模型”设置。
zh:modelPicker.partialRefresh.en: Some model lists could not refresh. Their last saved models are preserved; check Models settings for details.

zh:modelPicker.fleetRefreshError.text: 引擎列表无法刷新；当前显示的是最近一次已知的引擎。请切换到其他窗口再切回，以重新检查引擎。
zh:modelPicker.fleetRefreshError.en: The engine list could not refresh; the engines shown are the last known ones. Switch to another window and back to check the engines again.

zh:claudeAccounts.listUnreadable.text: 无法读取 Claude 账户列表。请使用“刷新账户”重试。
zh:claudeAccounts.listUnreadable.en: Could not read the Claude account list. Use Refresh accounts to try again.

zh:claudeAccounts.copied.text: 已复制 {name} 的登录命令。

zh:claudeAccounts.copyError.text: 无法复制。请选中并复制上方命令。
zh:claudeAccounts.copyError.en: Could not copy. Select and copy the command above.

zh:claudeAccounts.keepsLogin.text: 你默认的 Claude 登录和设置保持不变。每个额外账户都有自己的设置文件夹，不会复制任何凭据。只要没有任务在运行，你随时可以切换账户。
zh:claudeAccounts.keepsLogin.en: Your default Claude login and settings stay as they are. Each extra account gets its own settings folder, and no credentials are copied. You can change accounts whenever no work is running.

zh:claudeAccounts.instructions.text: 请在{shell}中运行此命令，并自行完成 Claude 登录。此操作不会自动登录。然后刷新账户。
zh:claudeAccounts.instructions.en: Run this command in {shell} and complete Claude's sign-in yourself. This does not sign in automatically. Then refresh accounts.

zh:claudeAccounts.removeConfirm.text: 要从 Murage 移除 {name} 吗？此操作不会撤销其登录，也不会删除凭据文件。被机器人或对话历史引用的账户无法移除。
zh:claudeAccounts.removeConfirm.en: Remove {name} from Murage? This does not revoke its login or delete credential files. Accounts referenced by bots or thread history cannot be removed.

zh:source.openError.en: The source conversation could not be opened.

zh:inbox.conversationUnavailable.en: This conversation is no longer available.

zh:inbox.openResultError.text: 无法打开此结果。请重试。
zh:inbox.openResultError.en: Could not open this result. Try again.

zh:files.sourceUnavailableRetained.text: 原始对话已不可用。已保存的文件仍被保留。
zh:files.sourceUnavailableRetained.en: The source conversation is no longer available. The saved file is retained.

zh:files.workingFolderError.text: 无法打开工作文件夹。请刷新文件页面。
zh:files.workingFolderError.en: The working folder could not be opened. Refresh Files.

zh:files.nativeActionError.text: 无法完成所请求的文件操作。
zh:files.nativeActionError.en: The requested file action could not be completed.

zh:filesWorkspace.subtitle.text: 此对话文件夹中当前的文件。并非已保存的副本。
zh:filesWorkspace.subtitle.en: The files in this conversation's folder right now. Not saved copies.

zh:filesWorkspace.chooseBot.text: 在上方选择一个机器人，以浏览 Murage 为其对话使用的文件夹。
zh:filesWorkspace.chooseBot.en: Choose a bot above to browse the folder Murage uses for its conversation.

zh:filesWorkspace.managed.text: 由 Murage 管理的工作区

zh:filesWorkspace.loadError.en: This folder could not be read.

zh:filesWorkspace.resultsList.text: 此工作区中的搜索结果

zh:filesWorkspace.searchPlaceholder.text: 搜索文件和文件夹名称

zh:filesWorkspace.searchResults.text: 此工作区中与“{query}”匹配的名称。

zh:filesWorkspace.searchEmpty.text: 没有与该搜索匹配的文件或文件夹名称。
zh:filesWorkspace.searchEmpty.en: No file or folder name matches that search.

zh:filesWorkspace.rootEmpty.en: This workspace has no files yet.

zh:filesWorkspace.searchPartial.text: 目前已搜索 {scanned} 个条目。可能还有更多。
zh:filesWorkspace.searchPartial.en: Searched {scanned} entries so far. There may be more.

zh:filesWorkspace.searchSkipped.text: 搜索在检查完整个工作区之前已达到上限。请浏览文件夹以查看其余内容。
zh:filesWorkspace.searchSkipped.en: The search reached its limit before checking the whole workspace. Browse the folders to reach the rest.

zh:filesWorkspace.folderTruncated.text: 此文件夹中的条目数超过了 Murage 一次可列出的数量。请打开子文件夹或按名称搜索。
zh:filesWorkspace.folderTruncated.en: This folder holds more entries than Murage lists at once. Open a subfolder or search by name.

zh:filesWorkspace.fileMeta.text: 工作区文件 · {size} · 修改于 {modified}

zh:filesWorkspace.saveUnavailable.text: 此条目不是 Murage 可以保存的文件。
zh:filesWorkspace.saveUnavailable.en: This entry is not a file Murage can save.

zh:filesWorkspace.saveError.en: This version could not be saved.

zh:filesWorkspace.saved.text: 已保存 {name} 的此版本。它已列在“已保存版本”下，内容会与保存时完全一致。
zh:filesWorkspace.saved.en: Saved this version of {name}. It is listed under Saved versions and keeps the contents exactly as saved.

zh:filesWorkspace.savedUnpinned.text: 已从工作区保存 {name}。此版本的 Murage 保存的是文件的当前状态，而非上方列出的精确版本。
zh:filesWorkspace.savedUnpinned.en: Saved {name} from the workspace. This version of Murage saved the file as it is now rather than the exact version listed above.

zh:filesWorkspace.viewNote.text: 显示的是磁盘上文件的当前内容。在你保存此版本之前，它不是已保存的副本。
zh:filesWorkspace.viewNote.en: Shown from the file on disk right now. It is not a saved copy until you save this version.

zh:filesWorkspace.viewError.en: This file could not be opened.

zh:filesWorkspace.viewSaveHint.text: 保存此版本以保留一份经验证的副本。
zh:filesWorkspace.viewSaveHint.en: Save this version to keep a verified copy.

zh:filesWorkspace.viewUnavailable.text: 此版本的 Murage 不支持查看工作区文件。请保存此版本，然后在“文件”中阅读。
zh:filesWorkspace.viewUnavailable.en: Viewing workspace files is not available in this version of Murage. Save this version to read it in Files.

zh:filesWorkspace.nativeUnavailable.text: 此条目不是 Murage 可以打开的文件。
zh:filesWorkspace.nativeUnavailable.en: This entry is not a file Murage can open.

zh:filesWorkspace.nativeError.en: The file could not be opened.

zh:filesWorkspace.entry.link.text: 链接。Murage 从不跟随或打开链接。
zh:filesWorkspace.entry.link.en: Link. Murage never follows or opens links.

zh:filesWorkspace.entry.unsupportedFile.text: Murage 无法验证此文件，因此无法查看或保存。
zh:filesWorkspace.entry.unsupportedFile.en: Murage cannot verify this file, so it cannot be viewed or saved.

zh:filesWorkspace.entry.unsupported.text: 不是普通文件或文件夹。
zh:filesWorkspace.entry.unsupported.en: Not an ordinary file or folder.

zh:filesWorkspace.entry.other.text: 不是普通文件或文件夹。
zh:filesWorkspace.entry.other.en: Not an ordinary file or folder.

zh:filesWorkspace.state.legacy.text: 这个较早的对话没有专用工作区，因此 Murage 没有可列出的文件夹。其已保存版本见下方。开始一个新任务即可为其创建工作区。
zh:filesWorkspace.state.legacy.en: This older conversation has no dedicated workspace, so Murage has no folder to list. Its saved versions are below. Start a new task to give it one.

zh:filesWorkspace.state.remote.text: 存储在远程计算机上；本地不可用。已带回文件的已保存版本见下方。
zh:filesWorkspace.state.remote.en: Stored on a remote computer; not available locally. Saved versions of files already brought back are below.

zh:filesWorkspace.state.unavailable.text: Murage 目前找不到此对话的文件夹。其已保存版本见下方。
zh:filesWorkspace.state.unavailable.en: Murage could not find this conversation's folder right now. Its saved versions are below.

zh:filesWorkspace.savedSubtitle.text: Murage 保留的经验证副本。即使原文件发生更改，这些副本的内容也永不改变。
zh:filesWorkspace.savedSubtitle.en: Verified copies Murage keeps. Their contents never change, even when the original does.

zh:filesWorkspace.noFilters.text: 显示所有已保存的文件。

zh:workspacePane.resizeHint.text: 拖动或使用方向键来更改宽度。
zh:workspacePane.resizeHint.en: Drag, or use the arrow keys, to change the width.

zh:workspacePane.noScope.text: 选择一个对话以查看其工作区。
zh:workspacePane.noScope.en: Select a conversation to see its workspace.

zh:workspacePane.loadError.en: This folder could not be read.

zh:workspacePane.resultsList.text: 此工作区中的搜索结果

zh:workspacePane.searchEmpty.text: 没有与该搜索匹配的文件或文件夹名称。
zh:workspacePane.searchEmpty.en: No file or folder name matches that search.

zh:workspacePane.rootEmpty.text: 这里还没有文件。机器人写入此文件夹的文件一经创建就会显示在这里。
zh:workspacePane.rootEmpty.en: No files here yet. A file a bot writes into this folder appears as soon as it exists.

zh:workspacePane.searchPartial.text: 目前已搜索 {scanned} 个条目。可能还有更多。
zh:workspacePane.searchPartial.en: Searched {scanned} entries so far. There may be more.

zh:workspacePane.searchSkipped.text: 搜索在检查完整个工作区之前已达到上限。
zh:workspacePane.searchSkipped.en: The search reached its limit before checking the whole workspace.

zh:workspacePane.folderTruncated.text: 此文件夹中的条目数超过了 Murage 一次可列出的数量。请打开子文件夹或按名称搜索。
zh:workspacePane.folderTruncated.en: This folder holds more entries than Murage lists at once. Open a subfolder or search by name.

zh:workspacePane.noTabs.text: 从列表中打开一个文件即可在此预览。单击会复用预览标签页；“保持打开”或“编辑”会让标签页保留。
zh:workspacePane.noTabs.en: Open a file from the list to preview it here. A single click reuses the preview tab; Keep open or Edit makes a tab stay.

zh:workspacePane.previewTab.text: {name}（预览标签页，将被你打开的下一个文件替换）
zh:workspacePane.previewTab.en: {name} (preview tab, replaced by the next file you open)

zh:workspacePane.closeUnsaved.body.text: {name} 有未保存的更改。磁盘上的文件保持原样；草稿会保留在这台电脑上，并在下次打开该文件时再次提供。
zh:workspacePane.closeUnsaved.body.en: {name} has unsaved changes. The file on disk stays as it is; the draft is preserved on this computer and offered again when the file is opened.

zh:workspacePane.readError.tooLarge.text: 此文件超出了预览大小限制。请在对应应用中打开，或在所在文件夹中显示。
zh:workspacePane.readError.tooLarge.en: This file is larger than the preview limit. Open it in its app or show it in its folder.

zh:workspacePane.readError.encoding.text: 此文件不是以 UTF-8 保存的，而 UTF-8 是此查看器支持的文本格式。请在对应应用中打开，或在所在文件夹中显示。
zh:workspacePane.readError.encoding.en: This file is not saved as UTF-8, the text format this viewer supports. Open it in its app or show it in its folder.

zh:workspacePane.readError.missing.en: This file is no longer at that location.

zh:workspacePane.readError.scope.text: 此对话的工作区目前不可用。
zh:workspacePane.readError.scope.en: This conversation's workspace is not available right now.

zh:workspacePane.binary.text: 此格式无法预览。请在对应应用中打开，或在所在文件夹中显示。
zh:workspacePane.binary.en: No preview for this format. Open it in its app or show it in its folder.

zh:workspacePane.imageUnavailable.text: 无法在此处显示此图片。请在对应应用中打开，或在所在文件夹中显示。
zh:workspacePane.imageUnavailable.en: This image could not be shown here. Open it in its app or show it in its folder.

zh:workspacePane.htmlNote.text: 受保护的预览：脚本、外部资源和应用访问均已被阻止。
zh:workspacePane.htmlNote.en: Protected preview: scripts, external resources and app access are blocked.

zh:workspacePane.workingFileNote.text: 工作区中的实时文件，而非已保存版本。
zh:workspacePane.workingFileNote.en: The live file in the workspace, not a saved version.

zh:workspacePane.savedVersion.text: 已将此版本保存到“文件”，名称为 {name}。
zh:workspacePane.savedVersion.en: Saved this version to Files as {name}.

zh:workspacePane.saveCopyPrompt.text: 将副本保存为（此工作区内的路径）
zh:workspacePane.saveCopyPrompt.en: Save a copy as (path inside this workspace)

zh:workspacePane.saveCopyExists.text: {path} 处已存在文件。请选择另一个名称。
zh:workspacePane.saveCopyExists.en: A file already exists at {path}. Choose another name.

zh:workspacePane.saveCopyInvalid.text: 这不是此工作区内的有效路径。
zh:workspacePane.saveCopyInvalid.en: That is not a valid path inside this workspace.

zh:workspacePane.reloaded.text: 已根据磁盘上的文件更新。
zh:workspacePane.reloaded.en: Updated from the file on disk.

zh:workspacePane.missingOnDisk.text: 此文件已在磁盘上被删除或重命名。显示的文本仍在此处；“保存副本”可将其保留。
zh:workspacePane.missingOnDisk.en: This file was removed or renamed on disk. The text shown is still here; Save a copy keeps it.

zh:media.source.attachment.text: 由 Murage 保存在本地

zh:media.source.screenFrame.text: 机器人已共享的屏幕画面。未保存。
zh:media.source.screenFrame.en: Screen the bot already shared. Not saved.

zh:media.source.external.text: 外部图片，应你的请求加载
zh:media.source.external.en: External image, loaded at your request

zh:media.lightbox.position.text: 第 {index} 张图片，共 {count} 张

zh:media.lightbox.unavailable.en: This image is no longer available.

zh:media.artifact.unavailable.text: 无法预览此已保存的图片。请下载已保存的副本以查看。
zh:media.artifact.unavailable.en: This saved image cannot be previewed. Download the saved copy to review it.

zh:media.external.notLoaded.text: 来自 {host} 的图片未加载。

zh:media.local.notLoaded.text: 本地图片路径不会在聊天中加载。
zh:media.local.notLoaded.en: Local image paths are not loaded in chat.

zh:media.source.workspace.text: 位于此对话的工作区中

zh:media.player.downloadTitle.en: Save a copy of this file

zh:media.player.unsupportedHere.text: 这台电脑无法播放此格式。请保存副本，然后在其他应用中打开。
zh:media.player.unsupportedHere.en: This computer cannot play this format. Save a copy to open it in another app.

zh:media.player.unsupportedType.text: Murage 没有适用于此文件类型的播放器。
zh:media.player.unsupportedType.en: Murage has no player for this file type.

zh:media.player.errorNetwork.text: 播放已停止：无法读取该文件。
zh:media.player.errorNetwork.en: Playback stopped: the file could not be read.

zh:media.player.errorDecode.text: 播放已停止，因为播放器无法读取此媒体文件。
zh:media.player.errorDecode.en: Playback stopped because the player could not read this media file.

zh:media.player.errorFormat.text: 这台电脑无法播放此格式。请保存副本，然后在其他应用中打开。
zh:media.player.errorFormat.en: This computer cannot play this format. Save a copy to open it in another app.

zh:media.player.errorUnknown.en: Playback stopped for an unknown reason.

zh:media.player.missing.text: 该文件已不在此对话的工作区中。
zh:media.player.missing.en: That file is no longer in this conversation's workspace.

zh:media.player.changed.text: 该文件自共享以来已发生更改。
zh:media.player.changed.en: That file changed since it was shared.

zh:media.player.denied.text: 无法从此对话访问该文件。
zh:media.player.denied.en: That file is not available from this conversation.

zh:noEngines.title.text: 安装一个 AI 引擎，开始使用
zh:noEngines.title.en: Install an AI engine to get started

zh:noEngines.intro.text: Murage 本身不内置 AI：你的机器人运行在这台电脑上已安装的 AI 应用之上，并使用你已有的登录信息。只需设置以下任意一项，你的机器人就能开始工作。
zh:noEngines.intro.en: Murage does not include an AI of its own: your bots run on an AI app installed on this computer, using the sign-in you already have. Set up any one of these and your bots come alive.

zh:providerError.credits.summary.text: 你的 AI 服务提示账户额度已用完，因此此请求未能完成。
zh:providerError.credits.summary.en: Your AI service says the account is out of credit, so this request did not finish.

zh:providerError.credits.resolution.text: 如果你刚刚充值，请稍后重试。你也可以在“模型与引擎”中选择其他 AI。
zh:providerError.credits.resolution.en: If you just added credit, try again in a moment. You can also pick another AI in Models & engines.

zh:providerError.spend-cap.title.en: {provider} has reached its monthly spending limit

zh:providerError.spend-cap.summary.text: 该账户已达到本月设定的支出上限，在上限重置或提高之前，不会再执行任何请求。
zh:providerError.spend-cap.summary.en: The account reached the spending limit set for it this month, so no further requests will run until that limit resets or is raised.

zh:providerError.spend-cap.resolution.text: 随着账户付款记录的积累，此限额会自动提高，因此充值并不能解除限制。你可以请 AI 服务提前提高限额，或在“模型与引擎”中选择其他 AI。
zh:providerError.spend-cap.resolution.en: The limit rises on its own as the account builds up payment history, so adding credit will not lift it. Ask your AI service to raise it sooner, or pick another AI in Models & engines.

zh:providerError.authentication.summary.text: 你的 AI 服务未接受此请求使用的登录信息或密钥。
zh:providerError.authentication.summary.en: Your AI service did not accept the sign-in or key used for this request.

zh:providerError.authentication.resoluti.text: 请在“模型与引擎”中检查登录信息或密钥，然后重试。
zh:providerError.authentication.resoluti.en: Check the sign-in or key in Models & engines, then try again.

zh:providerError.permission.summary.text: 你的 AI 服务不允许此请求。这并不一定表示你已退出登录。
zh:providerError.permission.summary.en: Your AI service did not allow this request. That does not always mean you are signed out.

zh:providerError.permission.resolution.text: 请确认你的账户可以使用所选模型，或在“模型与引擎”中选择其他 AI。
zh:providerError.permission.resolution.en: Check that your account can use the model you picked, or pick another AI in Models & engines.

zh:providerError.rate-limit.summary.text: 你的 AI 服务提示请求次数已达上限。这可能是短期限制，也可能是账户限制。
zh:providerError.rate-limit.summary.en: Your AI service says you reached a limit on requests. It may be short-term, or a limit on your account.

zh:providerError.rate-limit.resolution.text: 请查看 AI 服务的限额及其重置时间，然后重试，或在“模型与引擎”中选择其他 AI。
zh:providerError.rate-limit.resolution.en: Check your AI service's limit and when it resets, then try again, or pick another AI in Models & engines.

zh:providerError.unavailable.summary.text: 你的 AI 服务当前繁忙。
zh:providerError.unavailable.summary.en: Your AI service is busy right now.

zh:providerError.unavailable.resolution.text: 请稍候重试，或在“模型与引擎”中选择其他 AI。
zh:providerError.unavailable.resolution.en: Wait a moment, then try again, or pick another AI in Models & engines.

zh:providerError.unknown.title.text: 你的 AI 服务无法完成此操作
zh:providerError.unknown.title.en: Your AI service could not finish this

zh:providerError.unknown.summary.text: 此错误没有保存更多详细信息。
zh:providerError.unknown.summary.en: There are no more details saved for this error.

zh:providerError.unknown.resolution.text: 请重试。如果问题再次出现，请在“模型与引擎”中检查所选的 AI。
zh:providerError.unknown.resolution.en: Try again. If it happens again, check the AI you picked in Models & engines.

zh:providerError.status.en: Reply from your AI service: code {status}

zh:runtimeError.busy.working-folder.titl.text: 另一个线程正在使用此工作文件夹
zh:runtimeError.busy.working-folder.titl.en: Another thread is using this working folder

zh:runtimeError.busy.computer.title.text: 另一个线程正在使用此计算机
zh:runtimeError.busy.computer.title.en: Another thread is using this computer

zh:runtimeError.busy.browser.title.text: 另一个线程正在使用此浏览器配置文件
zh:runtimeError.busy.browser.title.en: Another thread is using this browser profile

zh:runtimeError.busy.shared.title.text: 另一个线程正在使用此浏览器、计算机或工作文件夹
zh:runtimeError.busy.shared.title.en: Another thread is using this browser, computer or working folder

zh:runtimeError.busy.summary.text: 同一时间只能有一个线程使用它，因此此线程在开始前已停止。你的设置无需任何更改。
zh:runtimeError.busy.summary.en: Only one thread can use it at a time, so this thread stopped before it started. Nothing needs to change in your settings.

zh:runtimeError.busy.resolution.text: 等待另一个线程完成或将其停止，然后重试。
zh:runtimeError.busy.resolution.en: Wait for the other thread to finish, or stop it, then retry.

zh:runtimeError.busy.resolutionSend.text: 等待另一个线程完成或将其停止，然后重新发送你的消息。
zh:runtimeError.busy.resolutionSend.en: Wait for the other thread to finish, or stop it, then send your message again.

zh:runtimeError.local.browser.title.en: The built-in browser could not start

zh:runtimeError.local.computer.title.text: 此机器人的电脑尚未就绪
zh:runtimeError.local.computer.title.en: This bot's computer was not ready

zh:runtimeError.local.working-folder.tit.text: 无法使用此机器人的工作文件夹
zh:runtimeError.local.working-folder.tit.en: This bot's working folder could not be used

zh:runtimeError.local.summary.text: 这是此设备上的问题，与你的 AI 服务无关。更换模型或 AI 服务无法解决。
zh:runtimeError.local.summary.en: This is a problem on this device, not with your AI service. Changing the model or AI service will not fix it.

zh:runtimeError.local.browser.resolution.text: 请重试。如果浏览器无法启动，本轮将在不使用浏览器的情况下运行，并会予以说明。
zh:runtimeError.local.browser.resolution.en: Retry. When the browser cannot start, the turn now runs without it and says so.

zh:runtimeError.local.computer.resolutio.text: 请按照上方关于此机器人电脑的说明操作，然后重试。
zh:runtimeError.local.computer.resolutio.en: Follow the note above for this bot's computer, then retry.

zh:runtimeError.local.working-folder.res.text: 请确认该文件夹仍然存在且未处于恢复过程中，然后重试。
zh:runtimeError.local.working-folder.res.en: Check that the folder still exists and is not being restored, then retry.

zh:runtimeError.local.engine-folder-busy.text: {engine} 正在准备此机器人的文件夹
zh:runtimeError.local.engine-folder-busy.en: {engine} is getting this bot's folder ready

zh:runtimeError.local.engine-folder-busy.text: Murage 的另一部分仍在此机器人存放自己的 {engine} 文件的文件夹中工作，因此本轮没有开始。你自己的 {engine} 设置保持原样。
zh:runtimeError.local.engine-folder-busy.en: Another part of Murage is still working in the folder where this bot keeps its own {engine} files, so the turn did not start. Your own {engine} setup was left untouched.
Give it a moment, then retry.

zh:runtimeError.local.engine-folder-unav.text: 此机器人的 {engine} 文件夹尚未就绪
zh:runtimeError.local.engine-folder-unav.en: This bot's {engine} folder is not ready

zh:runtimeError.local.engine-folder-unav.text: Murage 会把每个机器人的 {engine} 文件放在各自的文件夹中，而该文件夹未能准备好，因此本轮没有开始。你自己的 {engine} 设置保持原样。
zh:runtimeError.local.engine-folder-unav.en: Murage keeps each bot's {engine} files in a folder of their own, and that folder could not be prepared, so the turn did not start. Your own {engine} setup was left untouched.

zh:runtimeError.local.engine-folder-unav.text: 请确认磁盘有可用空间，且 Murage 可以写入其数据文件夹，然后重试。
zh:runtimeError.local.engine-folder-unav.en: Check that the disk has free space and that Murage can write to its data folder, then retry.

zh:runtimeError.local.engine-update-requ.text: {engine} 需要更新才能用于机器人
Murage 会把每个机器人的 {engine} 文件放在各自的文件夹中。已安装的 {engine} 版本过旧，无法做到这一点，或无法读取其版本，因此本轮没有开始。你自己的 {engine} 设置保持原样。
zh:runtimeError.local.engine-update-requ.en: Murage keeps each bot's {engine} files in a folder of their own. The installed version of {engine} is too old to do that, or its version could not be read, so the turn did not start. Your own {engine} setup was left untouched.

zh:runtimeError.local.engine-symlink-req.text: {engine} 无法链接到这个机器人的文件夹
zh:runtimeError.local.engine-symlink-req.en: {engine} cannot be linked to this bot's folder

zh:runtimeError.local.engine-symlink-req.text: Murage 会把每个机器人的 {engine} 文件放在各自的文件夹中，并通过文件链接与它共享你的 {engine} 登录。这台电脑不允许创建该链接，因此本轮没有开始。你自己的 {engine} 设置保持原样。
zh:runtimeError.local.engine-symlink-req.en: Murage keeps each bot's {engine} files in a folder of their own and shares your {engine} sign-in with it through a file link. This computer did not allow that link, so the turn did not start. Your own {engine} setup was left untouched.

zh:runtimeError.local.engine-symlink-req.text: 在 Windows 中打开开发者模式（设置、系统、开发者选项），使链接可以创建，然后重试。
zh:runtimeError.local.engine-symlink-req.en: On Windows, turn on Developer Mode (Settings, System, For developers) so links can be made, then retry.

zh:runtimeError.local.engine-login-link-.text: 这个机器人的 {engine} 登录与你的登录不再一致
zh:runtimeError.local.engine-login-link-.en: This bot's {engine} sign-in no longer matches yours

zh:runtimeError.local.engine-login-link-.text: 这个机器人的 {engine} 文件夹中的登录文件与你自己的 {engine} 登录文件已不再是同一个文件，Murage 不会替你在两个登录之间做选择，因此本轮没有开始。你自己的 {engine} 设置保持原样。
zh:runtimeError.local.engine-login-link-.en: The sign-in file in this bot's {engine} folder and your own {engine} sign-in file are no longer the same file, and Murage does not choose between two sign-ins for you, so the turn did not start. Your own {engine} setup was left untouched.

zh:runtimeError.local.engine-login-link-.text: 如果你已退出 {engine} 或替换了它的登录文件，请重新登录 {engine}。如果这种情况反复出现，请在 Windows 中打开开发者模式，使链接可以创建，然后重试。
zh:runtimeError.local.engine-login-link-.en: If you signed out of {engine} or replaced its sign-in file, sign in to {engine} again. If this keeps happening, turn on Developer Mode in Windows so a link can be made, then retry.

zh:runtimeError.local.engine-config-inva.text: Murage 无法读取 {engine} 的一个设置文件
zh:runtimeError.local.engine-config-inva.en: {engine} has a setup file Murage cannot read

zh:runtimeError.local.engine-config-inva.text: Murage 会为每个机器人单独保留一份你的 {engine} 设置副本。由于你的某个 {engine} 设置文件无法读取（可能已损坏），为避免使用过期设置运行，本轮未启动。你自己的 {engine} 配置未受影响。
zh:runtimeError.local.engine-config-inva.en: Murage gives each bot its own copy of your {engine} settings, and one of your {engine} settings files could not be read (it may be damaged), so the turn did not start rather than run with out-of-date settings. Your own {engine} setup was left untouched.

zh:runtimeError.local.engine-config-inva.text: 请修正或删除你的 {engine} 文件夹中的该设置文件，然后重试。
zh:runtimeError.local.engine-config-inva.en: Fix or remove the setup file in your {engine} folder, then retry.

zh:runtimeError.local.windows-helper.tit.text: Claude 需要 Murage 的 Windows 辅助程序

zh:runtimeError.local.windows-helper.mes.text: Claude 需要 Murage 的 Windows 辅助程序（murage-browser-host.exe）才能启动。如果杀毒软件已将其隔离，请将其恢复，或重新安装 Murage，然后重新发送消息。Fuigo 和 Codex 不受影响，可继续使用。
zh:runtimeError.local.windows-helper.mes.en: Claude needs Murage's Windows helper (murage-browser-host.exe) to start. If your antivirus moved it to quarantine, restore it, or reinstall Murage. Then send your message again. Fuigo and Codex keep working.

zh:runtimeError.local.windows-helper.res.text: 请从杀毒软件的隔离区中恢复 murage-browser-host.exe，或重新安装 Murage，然后重新发送消息。
zh:runtimeError.local.windows-helper.res.en: Restore murage-browser-host.exe from your antivirus quarantine, or reinstall Murage. Then send your message again.

zh:runtimeError.waiting.working-folder.n.text: 正在等待“{title}”使用完工作文件夹
zh:runtimeError.waiting.working-folder.n.en: Waiting for '{title}' to finish using the working folder

zh:runtimeError.waiting.working-folder.u.text: 正在等待其他会话使用完工作文件夹
zh:runtimeError.waiting.working-folder.u.en: Waiting for another thread to finish using the working folder

zh:runtimeError.waiting.computer.named.en: Waiting for '{title}' to finish using the computer

zh:runtimeError.waiting.computer.unnamed.text: 正在等待其他会话使用完电脑
zh:runtimeError.waiting.computer.unnamed.en: Waiting for another thread to finish using the computer

zh:runtimeError.waiting.browser.named.text: 正在等待“{title}”使用完浏览器配置文件
zh:runtimeError.waiting.browser.named.en: Waiting for '{title}' to finish using the browser profile

zh:runtimeError.waiting.browser.unnamed.text: 正在等待其他会话使用完浏览器配置文件
zh:runtimeError.waiting.browser.unnamed.en: Waiting for another thread to finish using the browser profile

zh:runtimeError.waiting.shared.named.text: 正在等待“{title}”使用完电脑、浏览器或工作文件夹
zh:runtimeError.waiting.shared.named.en: Waiting for '{title}' to finish using the computer, browser or working folder

zh:runtimeError.waiting.shared.unnamed.text: 正在等待其他会话使用完电脑、浏览器或工作文件夹
zh:runtimeError.waiting.shared.unnamed.en: Waiting for another thread to finish using the computer, browser or working folder

zh:runtimeError.waiting.thread-slot.name.text: 正在等待空闲名额：此机器人已在处理三个会话
zh:runtimeError.waiting.thread-slot.name.en: Waiting for a free slot: this bot is already working on three threads

zh:runtimeError.waiting.thread-slot.unna.text: 正在等待空闲名额：此机器人已在处理三个会话
zh:runtimeError.waiting.thread-slot.unna.en: Waiting for a free slot: this bot is already working on three threads

zh:runtimeError.waiting.working-folder.i.text: 排队使用工作文件夹：{place}。前面的轮次完成后会自动开始。
zh:runtimeError.waiting.working-folder.i.en: {place} in line for the working folder. Starts by itself when the turns ahead finish.

zh:runtimeError.waiting.computer.inLine.text: 排队使用电脑：{place}。前面的轮次完成后会自动开始。
zh:runtimeError.waiting.computer.inLine.en: {place} in line for the computer. Starts by itself when the turns ahead finish.

zh:runtimeError.waiting.browser.inLine.text: 排队使用浏览器配置文件：{place}。前面的轮次完成后会自动开始。
zh:runtimeError.waiting.browser.inLine.en: {place} in line for the browser profile. Starts by itself when the turns ahead finish.

zh:runtimeError.waiting.shared.inLine.text: 排队使用电脑、浏览器或工作文件夹：{place}。前面的轮次完成后会自动开始。
zh:runtimeError.waiting.shared.inLine.en: {place} in line for the computer, browser or working folder. Starts by itself when the turns ahead finish.

zh:runtimeError.engineKind.empty_respons.text: 模型返回了空回复，重试也没有解决。这通常是暂时的：请重试，或换一个模型。
zh:runtimeError.engineKind.empty_respons.en: The model returned an empty reply, and retrying did not help. This is usually temporary: retry, or choose another model.

zh:runtimeError.engineKind.idle_timeout.text: 模型停止响应，引擎因此不再等待。请重试，或换一个模型。
zh:runtimeError.engineKind.idle_timeout.en: The model stopped responding, so the engine stopped waiting. Retry, or choose another model.

zh:runtimeError.engineKind.cancelled.text: 请求在模型完成前被取消。
zh:runtimeError.engineKind.cancelled.en: The request was cancelled before the model finished.

zh:runtimeError.engineKind.session_unava.text: 引擎会话已无响应。请重试以开启新的会话。
zh:runtimeError.engineKind.session_unava.en: The engine session stopped responding. Retry to start a fresh one.

zh:runtimeError.engineKind.rate_limited.text: 你的 AI 服务当前正在限制请求。请稍候重试。
zh:runtimeError.engineKind.rate_limited.en: Your AI service is limiting requests right now. Wait a moment, then retry.

zh:runtimeError.engineKind.auth.text: 你的 AI 服务未接受登录信息。请检查登录信息或密钥。
zh:runtimeError.engineKind.auth.en: Your AI service did not accept the sign-in. Check the sign-in or key.

zh:runtimeError.engineKind.http.text: Murage 无法连接到你的 AI 服务。请检查网络连接，然后重试。
zh:runtimeError.engineKind.http.en: Murage could not reach your AI service. Check the connection, then retry.

zh:runtimeError.engineKind.api.text: 你的 AI 服务拒绝了此请求。
zh:runtimeError.engineKind.api.en: Your AI service turned down the request.

zh:runtimeError.engineKind.max_tokens_tr.text: 回复在完成前已达到模型的输出上限。
zh:runtimeError.engineKind.max_tokens_tr.en: The reply reached the model output limit before it finished.

zh:runtimeError.engineKind.doom_loop_det.text: 引擎停止了模型，因为它不断重复相同的步骤。
zh:runtimeError.engineKind.doom_loop_det.en: The engine stopped the model because it kept repeating the same steps.

zh:runtimeError.engineKind.serialization.text: Murage 无法读取你的 AI 服务返回的回复。
zh:runtimeError.engineKind.serialization.en: Murage could not read the reply from your AI service.

zh:runtimeError.engineKind.internal.text: 引擎没有为此错误指定更具体的类型。请重试；若反复出现，请查看引擎自己的错误记录。
zh:runtimeError.engineKind.internal.en: The engine did not give this error a more specific type. Try again, and check the engine's own record of errors if it keeps happening.

zh:runtimeError.engineKind.invalid_reque.text: 引擎无法接受此次请求，因此予以拒绝。请重试；若反复出现，请查看引擎的日志。
zh:runtimeError.engineKind.invalid_reque.en: The engine rejected this request as one it could not accept. Retry, and check the engine's own logs if it keeps happening.

zh:runtimeError.engineKind.not_found.text: 引擎找不到此次请求指定的会话或文件。请新建线程，然后重试。
zh:runtimeError.engineKind.not_found.en: The engine could not find the session or file this request named. Start a new thread, then retry.

zh:runtimeError.engineKind.session_stora.text: 引擎无法读写自己的会话文件。请检查磁盘可用空间和它的文件夹权限，然后重试。
zh:runtimeError.engineKind.session_stora.en: The engine could not read or write its own session files. Check free disk space and the engine's folder permissions, then retry.

zh:runtimeError.engineKind.compaction.text: 引擎无法把此对话的历史缩短到足以符合模型一次可处理文本量的上限。请新建对话以继续。
zh:runtimeError.engineKind.compaction.en: The engine could not shorten this conversation's history enough to fit the model's limit on how much text it can process at once. Start a new conversation to continue.

zh:runtimeError.engineKind.execution_inc.text: 引擎在工作完成前停止了本次运行，通常是因为额度已用尽。请查看已完成的部分，如需其余内容再继续。
zh:runtimeError.engineKind.execution_inc.en: The engine stopped this run before its work finished, usually because a budget ran out. Review what it did, then continue if you need the rest.

zh:connectedApps.cachedCatalogError.text: 无法读取已保存的应用目录。正在检查更新后的目录。
zh:connectedApps.cachedCatalogError.en: Could not read the saved app catalog. Checking for an updated catalog.

zh:connectedApps.alias.anotherLabel.text: 另一个 {service} 账户的标签

zh:connectedApps.alias.firstHint.text: 登录前请为此账户命名，例如“工作”或“个人”。“已连接的应用”中会显示此标签。
zh:connectedApps.alias.firstHint.en: Name this account before you sign in, such as work or personal. Connected apps shows this label.

zh:connectedApps.alias.anotherHint.text: 为此账户设置一个唯一标签，例如“工作”或“个人”，以便与你的其他账户区分开来。
zh:connectedApps.alias.anotherHint.en: Give this account a unique label, such as work or personal, so it stays separate from your other accounts.

zh:connectedApps.lock.body.text: 你的机器人可以使用数百款应用，包括 Gmail、Slack、Notion 和 GitHub。添加你的 Flux Router 密钥即可解锁，并附带每日额度。
zh:connectedApps.lock.body.en: Your bots can use hundreds of apps, including Gmail, Slack, Notion and GitHub. Add your Flux Router key to unlock them, with a daily allowance included.

zh:connectedApps.lock.button.text: 添加 Flux Router 密钥

zh:connectedApps.lock.loading.text: 正在检查你的应用连接设置…

zh:connectedApps.ownKeyRetired.text: 已连接的应用现在通过 Flux Router 运行。请在此重新连接你的应用。
zh:connectedApps.ownKeyRetired.en: Connected apps now run through Flux Router. Reconnect your apps here.

zh:connectedApps.lock.retiredTitle.text: 你的已连接应用现在需要 Flux Router
zh:connectedApps.lock.retiredTitle.en: Your connected apps need Flux Router now

zh:connectedApps.lock.retiredBody.text: Murage 原有的应用连接服务已停用。请添加你的 Flux Router 密钥，然后在此重新连接你的应用。
zh:connectedApps.lock.retiredBody.en: Murage's original connected-apps service has retired. Add your Flux Router key, then reconnect your apps here.

zh:connectedApps.flux.ctaTitle.text: 通过 Flux Router 连接你的应用
zh:connectedApps.flux.ctaTitle.en: Connect your apps with Flux Router

zh:connectedApps.flux.ctaBody.text: 包括 Gmail、Slack、Notion 和 GitHub 在内的数百款应用将通过你的 Flux Router 账户运行，并附带每日额度。
zh:connectedApps.flux.ctaBody.en: Hundreds of apps, including Gmail, Slack, Notion and GitHub, run through your Flux Router account, with a daily allowance.

zh:connectedApps.flux.unreachable.text: 暂时无法访问 Flux Router 的已连接应用，请稍后再试。
zh:connectedApps.flux.unreachable.en: Flux Router connected apps aren't reachable right now. Try again shortly.

zh:connectedApps.flux.takenOver.text: 另一台电脑登录了 Flux Router，并接管了已连接的应用。请重新连接，以便在这里使用它们。
zh:connectedApps.flux.takenOver.en: Another computer signed in to Flux Router and took over connected apps. Reconnect to use them here.

zh:connectedApps.flux.notInBuild.text: 本次启动无法使用已连接的应用。请重启后重试。
zh:connectedApps.flux.notInBuild.en: Connected apps aren't available on this launch. Try again after restarting.

zh:connectedApps.flux.legacyPlain.text: 通过 Murage 的服务连接。

zh:connectedApps.flux.tokenBudget.text: 你的 Flux Router 密钥本月额度已用完。请前往你的 Flux Router 账户查看，以继续使用已连接应用。
zh:connectedApps.flux.tokenBudget.en: Your Flux Router key has used its allowance for this month. Check your Flux Router account to keep using connected apps.

zh:connectedApps.flux.tokenReconnect.text: 请在“设置 → 模型”中重新连接 Flux Router，以使用已连接应用。
zh:connectedApps.flux.tokenReconnect.en: Reconnect Flux Router in Settings → Models to use connected apps.

zh:connectedApps.flux.tokenBlocked.text: 此 Flux Router 密钥已被封禁。请联系 support@fluxrouter.ai。
zh:connectedApps.flux.tokenBlocked.en: This Flux Router key is blocked. Contact support@fluxrouter.ai.

zh:connectedApps.flux.modeFlux.text: 已通过你的 Flux Router 账户连接。
zh:connectedApps.flux.modeFlux.en: Connected through your Flux Router account.

zh:connectedApps.flux.shared.text: 任何使用此 Flux Router 账户密钥的人都可以使用这些已连接应用。
zh:connectedApps.flux.shared.en: Anyone using this Flux Router account's keys can use these connected apps.

zh:connectedApps.flux.legacyUntil.text: 已通过 Murage 的服务连接，该服务将于 {date} 终止。请连接 Flux Router 以保留这些应用。
zh:connectedApps.flux.legacyUntil.en: Connected through Murage's service, which ends {date}. Connect Flux Router to keep these apps.

zh:connectedApps.flux.legacyNoDate.text: 已通过 Murage 的服务连接。请连接 Flux Router 以保留这些应用。
zh:connectedApps.flux.legacyNoDate.en: Connected through Murage's service. Connect Flux Router to keep these apps.

zh:connectedApps.flux.consent.text: 将你的已连接应用迁移到 Flux Router。任何使用此 Flux Router 账户密钥的人都将能够使用这些应用。此操作无法在应用内撤销。
zh:connectedApps.flux.consent.en: Move your connected apps to Flux Router. Anyone using this Flux Router account's keys will be able to use them. This can't be undone from the app.

zh:connectedApps.flux.consentKeep.text: 在 {date} 之前保留在此处

zh:connectedApps.flux.claimPending.text: 目前无法迁移你已连接的应用。Murage 会在运行期间持续重试。
zh:connectedApps.flux.claimPending.en: Your connected apps couldn't be moved just now. Murage will keep trying while it's open.

zh:connectedApps.flux.claimed.text: 你的已连接应用已迁移到 Flux Router。
zh:connectedApps.flux.claimed.en: Your connected apps moved to Flux Router.

zh:connectedApps.flux.conflict.accountAl.text: 你的 Flux Router 账户已包含来自其他安装的已连接应用。此设备上的应用在 {date} 之前仍可在此使用；如需之后继续使用，请在 Flux Router 下重新连接。
zh:connectedApps.flux.conflict.accountAl.en: Your Flux Router account already holds connected apps from another install. Apps on this device keep working here until {date}; reconnect them under Flux Router to keep them after that.

zh:connectedApps.flux.conflict.accountAl.text: 你的 Flux Router 账户已包含来自其他安装的已连接应用。此设备上的应用目前仍可在此使用；如需保留，请在 Flux Router 下重新连接。
zh:connectedApps.flux.conflict.accountAl.en: Your Flux Router account already holds connected apps from another install. Apps on this device keep working here for now; reconnect them under Flux Router to keep them.

zh:connectedApps.flux.conflict.accountHa.text: 你的 Flux Router 账户已有其自己的已连接应用。此安装中的应用在 {date} 之前仍可在此使用；如需之后继续使用，请在 Flux Router 下重新连接。
zh:connectedApps.flux.conflict.accountHa.en: Your Flux Router account already has its own connected apps. Apps from this install keep working here until {date}; reconnect them under Flux Router to keep them after that.

zh:connectedApps.flux.conflict.accountHa.text: 你的 Flux Router 账户已有其自己的已连接应用。此安装中的应用目前仍可在此使用；如需保留，请在 Flux Router 下重新连接。
zh:connectedApps.flux.conflict.accountHa.en: Your Flux Router account already has its own connected apps. Apps from this install keep working here for now; reconnect them under Flux Router to keep them.

zh:connectedApps.flux.conflict.installAl.text: 此设备的已连接应用已归属于另一个 Flux Router 账户。如果这不是你本人的操作，请联系 support@fluxrouter.ai，并提供安装 ID {installationId}。
zh:connectedApps.flux.conflict.installAl.en: This device's connected apps are already on a different Flux Router account. If that wasn't you, contact support@fluxrouter.ai and quote install id {installationId}.

zh:connectedApps.flux.conflict.claimsClo.text: 迁移已连接应用的期限已过。请在 Flux Router 下重新连接。
zh:connectedApps.flux.conflict.claimsClo.en: The window to move connected apps has closed. Reconnect them under Flux Router.

zh:connectedApps.flux.conflict.other.text: 无法将你的已连接应用迁移到此 Flux Router 账户。请在 Flux Router 下重新连接。
zh:connectedApps.flux.conflict.other.en: Your connected apps couldn't be moved to this Flux Router account. Reconnect them under Flux Router.

zh:connectedApps.flux.legacyRetired.text: Murage 原有的应用连接服务已停用。请在此重新连接你的应用，它们将通过你的 Flux Router 账户运行。
zh:connectedApps.flux.legacyRetired.en: Murage's original connected-apps service has retired. Reconnect your apps here and they'll run through your Flux Router account.

zh:connectedApps.flux.movedElsewhere.text: 你的已连接应用已迁移到另一个 Flux Router 账户，而非当前账户。如果这不是你本人的操作，请联系 support@fluxrouter.ai，并提供安装 ID {installationId}。
zh:connectedApps.flux.movedElsewhere.en: Your connected apps were moved to a Flux Router account that isn't this one. If that wasn't you, contact support@fluxrouter.ai and quote install id {installationId}.

zh:searchSettings.intro.text: 使用引擎自带的搜索工具，或选择独立的搜索服务商。保存这些设置不会执行搜索。
zh:searchSettings.intro.en: Use your engine's search tools, or choose a separate search provider. Saving these settings does not run a search.

zh:searchSettings.unavailable.text: 搜索设置暂时不可用。请在连接恢复后重新打开设置。
zh:searchSettings.unavailable.en: Search settings are not available yet. Reopen Settings after the connection is restored.

zh:searchSettings.engineOption.text: 引擎工具：无需单独的搜索账户
zh:searchSettings.engineOption.en: Engine tools: no separate search account

zh:searchSettings.offOption.text: 关闭：不使用 Murage 网页搜索

zh:searchSettings.fluxOption.text: Flux Router，使用你的 Flux 密钥
zh:searchSettings.fluxOption.en: Flux Router, with your Flux key

zh:searchSettings.fluxHelp.text: 搜索将通过 Flux Router 进行，使用“模型”中保存的 Flux 密钥。你的机器人会在实时网络上查找信息，并给出最新的回答。
zh:searchSettings.fluxHelp.en: Searches go through Flux Router using the Flux key saved under Models. Your bots look things up on the live web and answer with what is current.

zh:searchSettings.fluxNoKey.text: Flux 搜索使用“模型”中保存的 Flux 密钥。请先在那里添加密钥；在此之前，网页搜索会提示尚未设置。
zh:searchSettings.fluxNoKey.en: Flux search uses the Flux key saved under Models. Add one there first; until then web search reports that it is not set up.

zh:searchSettings.offHelp.text: 关闭只会停用 Murage 内置的搜索。由引擎或已连接工具（MCP）单独提供的搜索工具可能仍然可用。
zh:searchSettings.offHelp.en: Off disables only the search built into Murage. Search tools provided separately by engines or connected tools (MCP) may still be available.

zh:searchSettings.engineHelp.text: 引擎继续使用现有工具，无需 Tavily 或 Exa 账户。
zh:searchSettings.engineHelp.en: Your engine keeps its existing tools. No Tavily or Exa account is required.

zh:searchSettings.externalHelp.text: 搜索查询会按所选第三方服务商自己的账户和条款发送给该服务商。系统不会自动切换到其他服务商。
zh:searchSettings.externalHelp.en: Search queries are sent to the selected third-party provider, under that provider's own account and terms. There is no automatic fallback to another provider.

zh:searchSettings.pasteReplacement.text: 粘贴新密钥以替换现有密钥

zh:searchSettings.keyPrivacy.text: 已保存的密钥不会在此显示。密钥已保存并不代表已确认能够访问服务。
zh:searchSettings.keyPrivacy.en: Saved keys are never shown here. Key saved does not confirm service access.

zh:searchSettings.charges.text: 选择 Tavily 或 Exa 后，搜索查询会发送给相应服务商。添加或删除密钥不会改变你选择的服务商。
zh:searchSettings.charges.en: Tavily and Exa receive search queries when selected. Adding or removing a key does not change your provider choice.

zh:searchSettings.providerSaveError.text: 无法保存搜索服务商。请检查连接后重试。
zh:searchSettings.providerSaveError.en: Could not save the search provider. Check your connection and try again.

zh:searchSettings.keySavedNotice.text: {provider} 密钥已保存。尚未测试搜索功能。
zh:searchSettings.keySavedNotice.en: {provider} key saved. Search has not been tested.

zh:searchSettings.keySaveError.text: 无法保存 {provider} 密钥。请检查连接后重试。
zh:searchSettings.keySaveError.en: Could not save the {provider} key. Check your connection and try again.

zh:searchSettings.keyRemoveError.text: 无法删除 {provider} 密钥。请检查连接后重试。
zh:searchSettings.keyRemoveError.en: Could not remove the {provider} key. Check your connection and try again.

zh:notificationSettings.intro.text: 这些设置仅控制是否发送通知。任务和审批卡片仍然有效。已单独关闭通知的机器人仍保持关闭。
zh:notificationSettings.intro.en: These settings mute notifications only. Tasks and approval cards stay active. A bot whose notifications you turned off stays muted.

zh:notificationSettings.attentionHelp.text: 审批、提问和接管操作请求。
zh:notificationSettings.attentionHelp.en: Approvals, questions and requests for takeover.

zh:notificationSettings.failuresHelp.text: 任务或例行任务失败后需要查看。
zh:notificationSettings.failuresHelp.en: A task or routine needs review after a failure.

zh:notificationSettings.memoriesHelp.text: 有个机器人想记住一些内容，正在等你决定。只显示数量，不显示记忆本身。
zh:notificationSettings.memoriesHelp.en: A bot has things it would like to remember and is waiting for your say. Shows a count only, never the memories themselves.

zh:notificationSettings.previewHelp.text: 关闭后将使用通用的 Murage 标题和消息。点击通知仍会打开对应的对话。
zh:notificationSettings.previewHelp.en: Turn off to use a generic Murage title and message. Clicking still opens the right conversation.

zh:notificationSettings.soundHelp.text: 仅对这台电脑生效，并立即应用。关闭后仍会显示横幅通知，但不发出声音，例如在通话中机器人已在与你交谈时。
zh:notificationSettings.soundHelp.en: For this computer only, and it changes right away. Turn it off to keep the banners without the sound, for example on a call where the bot is already talking to you.

zh:notificationSettings.quietHelp.text: 在此时段内屏蔽所有类别的通知。被屏蔽的通知不会在之后补发。
zh:notificationSettings.quietHelp.en: Suppress all notification categories during this window. Muted notifications are not replayed later.

zh:notificationSettings.permissionGrante.text: 已获准发送通知。实际通知仍取决于这些偏好设置和系统设置。
zh:notificationSettings.permissionGrante.en: Notification permission is granted. Delivery still follows these preferences and your system settings.

zh:notificationSettings.permissionDenied.text: 通知权限已被禁止。请在浏览器或系统通知设置中允许 Murage 发送通知。
zh:notificationSettings.permissionDenied.en: Notification permission is blocked. Allow Murage in your browser or system notification settings.

zh:notificationSettings.permissionUnavai.text: 当前环境不支持管理通知权限。
zh:notificationSettings.permissionUnavai.en: Notification permission controls are unavailable in this environment.

zh:notificationSettings.permissionDefaul.text: 尚未获得通知权限。你可以在需要时申请。
zh:notificationSettings.permissionDefaul.en: Notification permission has not been granted. You can request it when you are ready.

zh:notificationSettings.errorTimes.text: 免打扰的开始和结束时间不能相同。
zh:notificationSettings.errorTimes.en: Quiet hours need different start and end times.

zh:notificationSettings.errorTimeFormat.text: 请以 HH:MM 格式输入有效的免打扰时间。
zh:notificationSettings.errorTimeFormat.en: Enter valid quiet-hour times in HH:MM format.

zh:notificationSettings.errorZone.text: 请选择有效的时区名称，例如 Asia/Bangkok 或 Europe/London。
zh:notificationSettings.errorZone.en: Choose a valid named time zone, such as Asia/Bangkok or Europe/London.

zh:notificationSettings.errorSave.text: 无法保存通知偏好。你的修改仍然保留，请再次尝试保存。
