zh:notificationSettings.errorSave.en: Could not save notification preferences. Your edits are still here; try saving again.

zh:notificationSettings.errorPermission.text: 无法完成通知权限请求。请检查浏览器或系统设置。
zh:notificationSettings.errorPermission.en: The notification permission request could not be completed. Check your browser or system settings.

zh:updates.verificationRefused.text: 无法验证此更新，因此 Murage 未安装它。
zh:updates.verificationRefused.en: This update could not be verified, so Murage did not install it.

zh:chatLinks.github.open.en: Click to open in your browser

zh:calls.macOnly.text: 通话目前需要 macOS 桌面应用
zh:calls.macOnly.en: Calls currently need the macOS desktop app

zh:memoryCorrection.effect.text: 批准后，此候选内容将成为当前记忆。被替换的版本将不再用于回忆，但会保留在历史记录中。
zh:memoryCorrection.effect.en: Approving makes this candidate the current memory. The replaced version stops being used for recall and stays in history.

zh:memoryCorrection.changed.text: 此提案所修正的记忆在提案提出后已发生更改，因此无法批准。请改为查看当前记忆。
zh:memoryCorrection.changed.en: The memory this proposal corrects has changed since it was proposed, so it cannot be approved. Inspect the current memory instead.

zh:memoryCorrection.unavailable.text: 此提案所修正的记忆已不可用（已被遗忘、归档或移除），因此无法批准。
zh:memoryCorrection.unavailable.en: The memory this proposal corrects is no longer available (it was forgotten, archived or removed), so it cannot be approved.

zh:memoryCorrection.pinLegend.text: 被替换的记忆已置顶。请选择如何处理其置顶状态：
zh:memoryCorrection.pinLegend.en: The memory being replaced is pinned. Choose what happens to its pin:

zh:memoryCorrection.pinTransfer.text: 改为置顶修正后的记忆

zh:memoryCorrection.pinRequired.text: 请选择一个置顶选项以批准此修正。
zh:memoryCorrection.pinRequired.en: Choose a pin option to approve this correction.

zh:memoryCorrection.approved.text: 修正已批准。被替换的版本已保留在历史记录中。
zh:memoryCorrection.approved.en: Correction approved. The replaced version is kept in history.

zh:markdownEditor.status.conflict.text: 未保存：文件已在磁盘上更改
zh:markdownEditor.status.conflict.en: Not saved: the file changed on disk

zh:markdownEditor.draftError.countExceed.text: 草稿未保留：最多只能有 {count} 个文档保留未保存的草稿。请保存或放弃其他文档中的更改。
zh:markdownEditor.draftError.countExceed.en: Draft not preserved: at most {count} documents can keep unsaved drafts. Save or discard changes in another document.

zh:markdownEditor.draftError.bytesExceed.text: 草稿未保留：未保存草稿的总大小上限为 {size}。请保存或放弃其他文档中的更改。
zh:markdownEditor.draftError.bytesExceed.en: Draft not preserved: unsaved drafts are limited to {size} in total. Save or discard changes in another document.

zh:markdownEditor.draftError.storageQuot.text: 草稿未保留：此设备的应用存储空间已满。你的更改仍在此处打开。
zh:markdownEditor.draftError.storageQuot.en: Draft not preserved: this device's app storage is full. Your changes are still open here.

zh:markdownEditor.draftError.storageUnav.text: 草稿未保留：草稿存储不可用。你的更改仍在此处打开。
zh:markdownEditor.draftError.storageUnav.en: Draft not preserved: draft storage is not available. Your changes are still open here.

zh:markdownEditor.richOff.tooLarge.text: 超过 {size} 的文件已关闭格式化编辑。Markdown 文本模式会原样保留文件内容。
zh:markdownEditor.richOff.tooLarge.en: Formatted editing is off for files over {size}. Markdown text mode preserves the file's contents exactly.

zh:markdownEditor.richOff.mixedNewlines.text: 格式化编辑已关闭：此文件用了不止一种方式来标记行尾。Markdown 文本模式会将这些标记原样保留。
zh:markdownEditor.richOff.mixedNewlines.en: Formatted editing is off: this file uses more than one way to mark where lines end. Markdown text mode preserves those markers exactly.

zh:markdownEditor.richOff.unsupportedSyn.text: 格式化编辑已关闭：此文件使用了格式化编辑器会更改的 Markdown 格式（{syntax}）。Markdown 文本模式会原样保留文件内容。
zh:markdownEditor.richOff.unsupportedSyn.en: Formatted editing is off: this file uses Markdown formatting that the formatted editor would change ({syntax}). Markdown text mode preserves the file's contents exactly.

zh:markdownEditor.richOff.roundTripChang.text: 格式化编辑已关闭：格式化编辑器会重写此文件的格式。Markdown 文本模式会原样保留文件内容。
zh:markdownEditor.richOff.roundTripChang.en: Formatted editing is off: the formatted editor would rewrite this file's formatting. Markdown text mode preserves the file's contents exactly.

zh:markdownEditor.richOff.parseFailed.text: 格式化编辑已关闭：格式化编辑器无法读取此 Markdown。Markdown 文本模式会原样保留文件内容。
zh:markdownEditor.richOff.parseFailed.en: Formatted editing is off: the formatted editor could not read this Markdown. Markdown text mode preserves the file's contents exactly.

zh:markdownEditor.saveError.botWriting.text: 文件未保存：有机器人正在写入此工作区。你的更改仍在此处；请在其完成后重试。
zh:markdownEditor.saveError.botWriting.en: File not saved: a bot is writing to this workspace. Your changes are still here; try again when it finishes.

zh:markdownEditor.saveError.stoppedTurnC.text: 文件未保存：机器人在此工作区被停止后仍在收尾。你的更改仍然保留；请稍候再重新保存。
zh:markdownEditor.saveError.stoppedTurnC.en: File not saved: the bot is still finishing up after being stopped in this workspace. Your changes are still here; wait a moment and save again.

zh:markdownEditor.saveError.tooLarge.text: 文件未保存：文件超出了编辑器可保存的大小。你的更改仍在此处。
zh:markdownEditor.saveError.tooLarge.en: File not saved: it is larger than the editor can save. Your changes are still here.

zh:markdownEditor.saveError.notFound.text: 文件未保存：该文件已不在此工作区中。你的更改仍在此处。
zh:markdownEditor.saveError.notFound.en: File not saved: the file is no longer in this workspace. Your changes are still here.

zh:markdownEditor.saveError.network.text: 文件未保存：无法连接到 Murage。你的更改仍在此处。
zh:markdownEditor.saveError.network.en: File not saved: Murage could not be reached. Your changes are still here.

zh:markdownEditor.saveError.diskFull.text: 文件未保存：磁盘已满。你的更改仍在此处。
zh:markdownEditor.saveError.diskFull.en: File not saved: the disk is full. Your changes are still here.

zh:markdownEditor.saveError.withDetail.text: 文件未保存：{detail}。你的更改仍在此处。
zh:markdownEditor.saveError.withDetail.en: File not saved: {detail}. Your changes are still here.

zh:markdownEditor.saveError.generic.text: 文件未保存。你的更改仍在此处。
zh:markdownEditor.saveError.generic.en: File not saved. Your changes are still here.

zh:markdownEditor.conflict.title.text: 此文件已在磁盘上更改

zh:markdownEditor.conflict.draftTitle.text: 恢复的草稿基于此文件的较早版本
zh:markdownEditor.conflict.draftTitle.en: A recovered draft is based on an older version of this file

zh:markdownEditor.conflict.body.text: 你的文本和磁盘上的版本都已保留。请选择要继续使用哪一个。
zh:markdownEditor.conflict.body.en: Both your text and the version on disk are kept. Choose which one to continue with.

zh:markdownEditor.conflict.reading.text: 正在读取磁盘上的版本…

zh:markdownEditor.conflict.readFailed.text: 无法读取磁盘上的版本，因此目前两种选择都无法应用。你的文本已保留。
zh:markdownEditor.conflict.readFailed.en: Could not read the version on disk, so neither choice can be applied yet. Your text is kept.

zh:markdownEditor.conflict.readFailedNet.text: 无法读取磁盘上的版本：无法连接到 Murage。你的文本已保留。
zh:markdownEditor.conflict.readFailedNet.en: Could not read the version on disk: Murage could not be reached. Your text is kept.

zh:markdownEditor.conflict.readUnavailab.text: 无法在此处读取磁盘上的版本，因此目前两种选择都无法应用。你的文本已保留。
zh:markdownEditor.conflict.readUnavailab.en: The version on disk cannot be read here, so neither choice can be applied yet. Your text is kept.

zh:markdownEditor.heldDraft.title.text: 发现了来自较早会话的未保存草稿
zh:markdownEditor.heldDraft.title.en: An unsaved draft from an earlier session was found

zh:markdownEditor.heldDraft.body.text: 你在草稿加载完成前已开始输入。两份文本都已保留，在你选择要继续使用哪一份之前，新输入的内容不会存储为草稿。
zh:markdownEditor.heldDraft.body.en: You started typing before it loaded. Both texts are kept, and your new typing is not stored as a draft until you choose which one to continue with.

zh:chatCode.saveFailed.text: 无法保存此代码。请改为复制。
zh:chatCode.saveFailed.en: Could not save this code. Copy it instead.

zh:imageReference.useLabel.text: 在下一条消息中将 {name} 用作参考图片
zh:imageReference.useLabel.en: Use {name} as a reference image in your next message

zh:imageReference.useTitle.text: 将这张图片原样附加到你的下一条消息，以便机器人基于它进行编辑。在你批准图片请求之前，不会生成任何内容。
zh:imageReference.useTitle.en: Attach this exact image to your next message so the bot can edit from it. Nothing is generated until you approve an image request.

zh:imageReference.addedLabel.text: {name} 已作为参考图片添加到你的下一条消息
zh:imageReference.addedLabel.en: {name} was added to your next message as a reference image

zh:imageReference.addedStatus.text: 已附加到你的下一条消息。

zh:imageReference.openConversation.text: 请打开此图片所属的对话，然后重试。
zh:imageReference.openConversation.en: Open the conversation this image belongs to, then try again.

zh:imageReference.notSaved.text: 在此设备上无法将附件添加到你的草稿。请重试。
zh:imageReference.notSaved.en: The attachment could not be added to your draft on this device. Try again.

zh:imageReference.failed.text: 无法将该图片添加为参考。
zh:imageReference.failed.en: The image could not be added as a reference.

zh:imageSettings.model.disabled.text: 此模型无法在此处生成图片。
zh:imageSettings.model.disabled.en: This model cannot generate images here.

zh:imageSettings.model.editUnavailable.en: Editing is unavailable with this model.

zh:imageSettings.model.referenceLimit.text: 每次编辑最多 {count} 张参考图片。
zh:imageSettings.model.referenceLimit.en: Up to {count} reference images per edit.

zh:imageSettings.model.referenceLimitOne.text: 每次编辑一张参考图片。

zh:imageSettings.model.referenceLimitUnk.text: 参考图片数量限制将在编辑运行时检查。
zh:imageSettings.model.referenceLimitUnk.en: The reference-image limit is checked when an edit runs.

zh:imageSettings.model.editNoQuality.en: Edits do not use the quality setting.

zh:imageSettings.model.editQualities.text: 编辑支持以下质量设置：{qualities}。

zh:questions.otherLabel.text: 你对以下问题的自定义回答：{question}

zh:questions.skipConfirm.text: 跳过此问题？{name} 将被告知你没有回答。
zh:questions.skipConfirm.en: Skip this question? {name} will be told you didn't answer.

zh:questions.keys.text: 1–9 选择 · Enter 发送 · Esc 跳过
zh:questions.keys.en: 1–9 to pick · Enter to send · Esc to skip

zh:questions.expiredNote.text: {name} 已停止等待回答。你的回答仍可作为消息发送给它。
zh:questions.expiredNote.en: {name} stopped waiting for an answer. Your answer can still reach it as a message.

zh:questions.secretExpired.text: 此回答为私密内容，因此无法作为消息发送。如仍需回答，请在聊天中回复。
zh:questions.secretExpired.en: This answer is private, so it can't be sent as a message. Answer in chat if you still want to.

zh:questions.closed.text: 此问题在得到回答前已关闭。
zh:questions.closed.en: This question closed before it was answered.

zh:chatHeader.inspectorDetail.text: 检查器：此对话的活动记录，以及与引擎交换的精确消息
zh:chatHeader.inspectorDetail.en: Inspector: activity records and exact messages exchanged with the engine for this conversation

zh:chatHeader.noDedicatedWorkspace.text: 没有专用工作区文件夹；改为列出为此机器人保存的文件。
zh:chatHeader.noDedicatedWorkspace.en: No dedicated workspace folder; files saved for this bot are listed instead.

zh:chatHeader.usageDetail.text: 打开机器人设置，可在“用量”卡片中查看完整明细。
zh:chatHeader.usageDetail.en: Opens Bot settings, where the Usage card has the full breakdown.

zh:artifactCard.truncated.text: 当前显示前 {shown} KB（共 {total} KB）。查看其余内容请使用“在此打开”或“下载”。
zh:artifactCard.truncated.en: Showing the first {shown} KB of {total} KB. Open here or Download for the rest.

zh:artifactCard.previewFailed.text: 无法在此显示预览。点击“预览”将在“文件”中打开。
zh:artifactCard.previewFailed.en: The preview could not be shown here. Preview opens it in Files.

zh:artifactCard.htmlNote.text: 受保护的预览：脚本、外部资源和应用访问均已被阻止。
zh:artifactCard.htmlNote.en: Protected preview: scripts, external resources and app access are blocked.

zh:composer.tooLarge.text: 未发送：这条消息有 {size}，而单条消息最多 {limit}。请缩短它，或拆成几条较小的消息。你的文字仍然保留在这里。
zh:composer.tooLarge.en: Not sent: this message is {size}, and one message can be up to {limit}. Shorten it or split it into smaller messages. Your text is still here.

zh:composer.refusedTooLarge.text: 未发送：Murage 拒绝了这条消息，因为它太大了（{size}）。请缩短它，或拆成几条较小的消息。你的文字仍然保留在这里。
zh:composer.refusedTooLarge.en: Not sent: Murage refused this message because it is too large ({size}). Shorten it or split it into smaller messages. Your text is still here.

zh:composer.uploadPending.text: 已暂缓：仍有图片正在上传。现在发送会将其附加到你的下一条消息。请在附件显示后再次按 Enter。
zh:composer.uploadPending.en: Held: an image is still uploading. Sending now would attach it to your next message instead. Press Enter again once the attachment appears.

zh:dictation.disabled.text: 请在“系统设置 → 键盘”中打开听写，然后重试。
zh:dictation.disabled.en: Turn on Dictation in System Settings → Keyboard, then try again.

zh:hostStop.description.text: Murage 已停止此回合。发送另一条消息以继续。
zh:hostStop.description.en: Murage stopped this turn. Send another message to continue.

zh:hostStop.byYouDescription.text: 你已停止本轮。发送新消息即可继续。
zh:hostStop.byYouDescription.en: You stopped this turn. Send another message to continue.

zh:hostStop.midDesktopAction.text: 停止时屏幕上仍有操作正在执行，该操作可能已经完成。重试前请先检查屏幕。
zh:hostStop.midDesktopAction.en: Stopped while an action was running on your screen. It may have finished anyway. Check the screen before retrying.

zh:folderTrust.withheldLabel.text: 文件夹未受信任：已忽略 {sources}

zh:folderTrust.withheldDescription.text: 由于此文件夹未受信任，其自身的指令、工具或技能未被应用。机器人在此仍可正常工作。
zh:folderTrust.withheldDescription.en: This folder's own instructions, tools or skills were not applied, because it is not trusted. The bot still works here.

zh:folderTrust.lateLabel.text: 文件夹已受信任：{sources} 将在此文件夹的新对话中生效
zh:folderTrust.lateLabel.en: Folder trusted: {sources} apply in a new conversation in this folder

zh:folderTrust.lateDescription.text: 引擎在对话开始时读取文件夹的指令，因此它们将在此文件夹的新对话中生效。
zh:folderTrust.lateDescription.en: The engine reads a folder's instructions when a conversation starts, so they apply in a new conversation in this folder.

zh:imagesLeftOut.one.text: {name} 无法查看图片，因此我没有附上这张图片。
zh:imagesLeftOut.one.en: {name} can't see images, so I left the picture out.

zh:imagesLeftOut.other.text: {name} 无法查看图片，因此我没有附上这些图片。
zh:imagesLeftOut.other.en: {name} can't see images, so I left the pictures out.

zh:browserUnavailable.description.text: 内置浏览器无法启动，因此本轮在没有浏览器工具的情况下运行。下一轮将重新尝试。
zh:browserUnavailable.description.en: The built-in browser could not be started, so this turn ran without browser tools. The next turn tries again.

zh:browserUnavailable.userChrome.text: 无法访问你的 Chrome，因此本轮在没有浏览器的情况下运行。请打开 Chrome，并在 chrome://inspect/#remote-debugging 中开启远程调试。
zh:browserUnavailable.userChrome.en: Your Chrome isn't reachable, so this turn ran without a browser. Open Chrome and turn on remote debugging at chrome://inspect/#remote-debugging.

zh:browserUnavailable.userChromeAllow.text: Chrome 正在请求你允许此机器人使用它。请在 Chrome 的“Allow remote debugging?”（允许远程调试？）提示中点击“Allow”（允许），机器人即可继续。
zh:browserUnavailable.userChromeAllow.en: Chrome is asking you to allow this bot to use it. Click Allow on "Allow remote debugging?" in Chrome, and the bot carries on.

zh:browserUnavailable.held.text: 此机器人的另一个对话正在使用浏览器并等待你的回复，因此本轮在没有浏览器的情况下运行。回复该请求后，下一轮即可使用浏览器。
zh:browserUnavailable.held.en: Another conversation with this bot is using the browser while it waits for your answer, so this turn ran without it. Answering that request lets the next turn use it.

zh:browserUnavailable.checking.text: 正在检查浏览器，然后开始本轮。第一次需要几秒钟。
zh:browserUnavailable.checking.en: Checking the browser before this turn starts. This takes a few seconds the first time.

zh:browserUnavailable.checked.text: 浏览器检查已完成，本轮可以使用浏览器。
zh:browserUnavailable.checked.en: The browser check finished, and this turn has its browser.

zh:browserUnavailable.unfinished.text: 浏览器检查尚未完成，所以本轮没有使用浏览器。下一轮会再试一次。
zh:browserUnavailable.unfinished.en: The browser check hadn't finished, so this turn didn't use the browser. It'll try again next turn.

zh:browserUnavailable.checkFailed.text: 浏览器检查没有完成。请稍后再试。
zh:browserUnavailable.checkFailed.en: The browser check didn't finish. Try again in a moment.

zh:browserUnavailable.timedOut.text: 浏览器未能及时启动，因此本轮在没有浏览器的情况下运行。下一轮将重新尝试。
zh:browserUnavailable.timedOut.en: The browser didn't start in time, so this turn ran without it. It'll try again next turn.

zh:browserUnavailable.failed.text: 浏览器无法启动，因此本轮在没有浏览器的情况下运行。下一轮将重新尝试。
zh:browserUnavailable.failed.en: The browser couldn't start, so this turn ran without it. It'll try again next turn.

zh:browserUnavailable.paused.text: {bot} 暂停了你的浏览器。打开 Murage for Chrome，按“继续”，然后再问一次。
zh:browserUnavailable.paused.en: {bot} paused your browser. Open Murage for Chrome and press Resume, then ask again.

zh:imagesNotSent.overCount.text: 仅发送了前 {limit} 张图片，其余 {over} 张未发送。
zh:imagesNotSent.overCount.en: Only the first {limit} images were sent. The other {over} were left out.

zh:imagesNotSent.overCountOne.text: 仅发送了前 {limit} 张图片，其余 1 张未发送。
zh:imagesNotSent.overCountOne.en: Only the first {limit} images were sent. The other one was left out.

zh:imagesNotSent.tooLarge.text: 已发送 {total} 张图片中的 {sent} 张。其余 {large} 张因过大未发送。
zh:imagesNotSent.tooLarge.en: {sent} of {total} images were sent. The other {large} were too large and were left out.

zh:imagesNotSent.tooLargeOne.text: 已发送 {total} 张图片中的 {sent} 张。有 1 张因过大未发送。
zh:imagesNotSent.tooLargeOne.en: {sent} of {total} images were sent. One was too large and was left out.

zh:imagesNotSent.both.text: 已发送 {total} 张图片中的 {sent} 张。其余图片未发送：{over} 张超出 {limit} 张的上限，{large} 张过大。
zh:imagesNotSent.both.en: {sent} of {total} images were sent. The rest were left out: {over} over the limit of {limit} and {large} too large.

zh:imagesNotSent.removed.text: {removed} 张图片已从存储中移除，未发送。
zh:imagesNotSent.removed.en: {removed} images were removed from storage and were not sent.

zh:imagesNotSent.removedOne.text: 1 张图片已从存储中移除，未发送。
zh:imagesNotSent.removedOne.en: 1 image was removed from storage and was not sent.

zh:composer.imagesOverLimit.text: 仅会发送前 {limit} 张图片，其余 {over} 张将不会发送。
zh:composer.imagesOverLimit.en: Only the first {limit} images will be sent. The other {over} will be left out.

zh:composer.imagesOverLimitOne.text: 仅会发送前 {limit} 张图片，其余 1 张将不会发送。
zh:composer.imagesOverLimitOne.en: Only the first {limit} images will be sent. The other one will be left out.

zh:folderTrust.expiredNote.text: 无人及时做出决定，因此本回合已停止。请重新发送消息以再次收到询问。
zh:folderTrust.expiredNote.en: Nobody decided in time, so this turn was stopped. Send the message again to be asked.

zh:folderTrust.lateFinishedNote.text: 本回合在有人回答之前已经结束，因此运行时未使用此文件夹的文件。请发送另一条消息以再次收到询问。
zh:folderTrust.lateFinishedNote.en: The turn finished before anyone answered, so it ran without this folder's files. Send another message to be asked again.

zh:folderTrust.lateStoppedNote.text: 本回合在有人回答之前已被停止；此前它一直在未使用此文件夹文件的情况下运行。请发送另一条消息以再次收到询问。
zh:folderTrust.lateStoppedNote.en: The turn was stopped before anyone answered; it had been running without this folder's files. Send another message to be asked again.

zh:folderTrust.lateFailedNote.text: 本回合在有人回答之前已失败；此前它一直在未使用此文件夹文件的情况下运行。请发送另一条消息以再次收到询问。
zh:folderTrust.lateFailedNote.en: The turn failed before anyone answered; it had been running without this folder's files. Send another message to be asked again.

zh:folderTrust.lateTimeoutNote.text: 本回合运行期间无人回答，因此运行时未使用此文件夹的文件。请发送另一条消息以再次收到询问。
zh:folderTrust.lateTimeoutNote.en: Nobody answered while the turn was running, so it ran without this folder's files. Send another message to be asked again.

zh:folderTrust.pickerNote.text: Fuigo 在使用文件夹自身的 AGENTS.md、CLAUDE.md、.mcp.json 和技能之前会先询问。信任该文件夹后，它们将在其中的新对话中生效。
zh:folderTrust.pickerNote.en: Fuigo asks before it uses a folder's own AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, .mcp.json and skills. Once you trust the folder, they apply in a new conversation in it.

zh:folderTrust.storedNoLabel.text: 你已拒绝信任此文件夹，因此其指令未被采用。
zh:folderTrust.storedNoLabel.en: This folder's instructions were left out because you said no to trusting it.

zh:folderTrust.statusUndecided.text: 尚未决定：在此进行的第一个回合将会询问
zh:folderTrust.statusUndecided.en: Not decided yet. The first turn here will ask

zh:folderTrust.statusUpstream.text: 已由你自己安装的 Fuigo 信任（fuigo --trust）：无论 Murage 记录如何，其文件都会被应用
zh:folderTrust.statusUpstream.en: Trusted by your own Fuigo install (fuigo --trust): its files apply whatever Murage remembers

zh:folderTrust.statusNothing.text: 此处暂无可信任的内容

zh:folderTrust.statusRefused.text: 此机器人的回合无法启动：{reason}
zh:folderTrust.statusRefused.en: This bot's turns would not start: {reason}

zh:folderTrust.statusNotGated.text: 此机器人的引擎不检查文件夹信任：它会照常继续使用文件夹中的文件
zh:folderTrust.statusNotGated.en: This bot's engine does not check folder trust: it continues to use the folder's files as before

zh:folderTrust.perMember.text: 按成员：由每个成员各自的引擎决定：
zh:folderTrust.perMember.en: Per member. Each member's own engine decides:

zh:folderTrust.forgetError.text: 无法忘记此文件夹的信任决定。
zh:folderTrust.forgetError.en: Could not forget this folder's trust decision.

zh:folderTrust.trustedNextTurn.text: 已信任。此文件夹的指令将从你的下一条消息起生效。子文件夹和技能中的指令将在新对话中生效。
zh:folderTrust.trustedNextTurn.en: Trusted. This folder's instructions apply from your next message. Instructions in subfolders and skills apply in a new chat.

zh:folderTrust.conversationNote.text: 这是此对话使用的工作文件夹。在未受信任期间，其自身的指令、已连接工具、自动操作和项目技能不会生效。机器人自身的文件和工具仍可正常使用。
zh:folderTrust.conversationNote.en: This is the folder this conversation works in. While it is not trusted, its own instructions, connected tools, automatic actions and project skills are left out. The bot's files and tools still work.

zh:chatLinks.findingFolder.text: 仍在查找此对话的文件夹，请稍后再试。
zh:chatLinks.findingFolder.en: Still finding this conversation's folder. Try again in a moment.

zh:chatLinks.folderUnavailable.text: {path} 位于此机器人的工作文件夹中，而该文件夹在此处不可用。
zh:chatLinks.folderUnavailable.en: {path} is in this bot's working folder, which is not available here.

zh:imageLibrary.error.text: 无法加载或修改已保存的提示词块和参考图包。
zh:imageLibrary.error.en: The saved blocks and packs could not be loaded or changed.

zh:imageLibrary.blocks.intro.text: 图片提示词中可复用的部分，例如让角色或品牌保持一致的指令。机器人会先发送这些内容，再发送场景描述。每次保存都会生成一个新版本。
zh:imageLibrary.blocks.intro.en: Reusable parts of image prompts, such as instructions to keep a character or brand consistent. Bots send them first, before the scene. Every save is a new version.

zh:imageLibrary.blocks.empty.text: 暂无已保存的提示词块。

zh:imageLibrary.block.name.text: 名称（小写字母、数字和连字符）

zh:imageLibrary.packs.intro.text: 机器人从对话中保存的参考图片集。每次使用图包时，都会将每张图片与其保存的副本进行核对。
zh:imageLibrary.packs.intro.en: Sets of reference images a bot saved from a conversation. Each image is checked against its saved copy every time the pack is used.

zh:imageLibrary.packs.empty.text: 暂无已保存的参考图包。

zh:imageLibrary.deleted.text: 已删除 {name}。之前生成的图片仍保留其所用的版本。
zh:imageLibrary.deleted.en: Deleted {name}. Earlier images keep the version they used.

zh:imageSettings.check.notOffered.text: 此密钥无法使用该模型：Flux 未在此账户的模型列表中列出它。
zh:imageSettings.check.notOffered.en: Not offered to this key: Flux does not list it for this account.

zh:imageSettings.check.confirm.text: 这将以最低质量和最小尺寸发送一次真实的图片请求，费用计入此连接的账户。生成的图片不会保留。
zh:imageSettings.check.confirm.en: This sends one real image request at the lowest quality and smallest size, on this connection's account. The image is not kept.

zh:imageSettings.check.daily.text: 每天检查一次默认模型
zh:imageSettings.check.daily.en: Check the default model once a day

zh:imageSettings.check.dailyNote.text: 默认关闭。每天最多生成一张小尺寸图片，且仅在启用图片请求时进行。
zh:imageSettings.check.dailyNote.en: Off by default. Generates at most one small image a day, only while image requests are on.

zh:imageSettings.library.open.text: 已保存的提示词块和参考图包
zh:imageSettings.library.open.en: Saved prompt blocks and reference packs

zh:imageSettings.check.listed.text: 已在服务商列表中。账户访问权限将在请求运行时检查。
zh:imageSettings.check.listed.en: Listed by the provider. Account access is checked when a request runs.

zh:imageSettings.limits.budget.text: 提示词长度上限：{count} 个字符。

zh:imageSettings.limits.budgetNote.text: 提示词长度上限：{count} 个字符（{note}）。

zh:imageSettings.loadFailed.text: 无法加载或保存图片设置。
zh:imageSettings.loadFailed.en: Could not load or save image settings.

zh:imageSettings.intro.text: 允许机器人使用现有连接创建或编辑图片。Flux 默认使用 GPT Image 2.5 Flare high。
zh:imageSettings.intro.en: Let bots create or edit images using an existing connection. Flux defaults to GPT Image 2.5 Flare high.

zh:imageSettings.noConnections.text: 没有可用的受支持图片连接。请先在 Murage 中设置图片服务商，然后刷新此列表。
zh:imageSettings.noConnections.en: No supported image connections are available. Set up an image provider in Murage, then refresh this list.

zh:imageSettings.xaiNoDefault.text: 此连接不支持 GPT Image 2。如需使用 xAI，请选择 Imagine 模型。
zh:imageSettings.xaiNoDefault.en: GPT Image 2 is not available on this connection. Choose an Imagine model to use xAI.

zh:imageSettings.chooseAvailable.text: 启用图片请求前，请先选择一个可用的模型。
zh:imageSettings.chooseAvailable.en: Choose an available model before enabling image requests.

zh:imageSettings.usesConnection.text: 图片将使用 {label}，费用计入该连接的账户。请求失败时，Murage 不会切换服务商。
zh:imageSettings.usesConnection.en: Images use {label}, with that connection’s account. Murage will not switch providers if a request fails.

zh:imageSettings.oneRequest.text: 每个机器人轮次最多发起一次图片请求。每次图片请求运行前都需要你审核并批准。仅当所选模型支持时才提供编辑功能。
zh:imageSettings.oneRequest.en: One image request per bot turn. You review and approve each image request before it runs. Editing is offered only when the selected model supports it.

zh:imageSettings.errorHint.text: 请刷新以查看已保存的设置，然后重试。
zh:imageSettings.errorHint.en: Refresh to check the saved settings, then try again.

zh:imageSettings.rule.free.text: 宽度和高度可为 {multiple} 的任意倍数，宽高比 {min} 至 {max}，像素数 {minPixels} 至 {maxPixels}，最长边不超过 {maxEdge}。
zh:imageSettings.rule.free.en: Any width and height in multiples of {multiple}, ratio {min} to {max}, {minPixels} to {maxPixels} pixels, longest side at most {maxEdge}.

zh:imageSettings.rule.experimental.text: 超过 {pixels} 像素的尺寸为实验性功能。

zh:imageSettings.rule.ratioTier.text: 支持的图片宽高比：{ratios}。可用的图片尺寸：{tiers}。
zh:imageSettings.rule.ratioTier.en: Supported image proportions: {ratios}. Available image sizes: {tiers}.

zh:imageSettings.rule.providerDefault.text: 仅支持服务商的默认尺寸。

zh:imageSettings.limits.tokens.text: Google 按 token（文本的小片段）而非字符计数；Murage 采用保守的 32,000 个字符上限。
zh:imageSettings.limits.tokens.en: Google counts tokens (small pieces of text), not characters; Murage uses a conservative limit of 32,000 characters.

zh:settings.appearance.note.text: 立即生效，并记在这台机器上。
zh:settings.appearance.note.en: Applies instantly and is remembered on this machine.

zh:settings.sidebar.autoRail.text: 窗口较窄时折叠侧边栏
zh:settings.sidebar.autoRail.en: Fold the sidebar on narrow windows

zh:settings.sidebar.autoRailNote.text: 窗口较窄时只显示图片。在那里展开它会关闭此选项。
zh:settings.sidebar.autoRailNote.en: On a narrow window it shows only pictures. Opening it there turns this off.

zh:settings.general.remoteNote.text: 语言、机器人默认设置和频道设置在桌面应用中管理。
zh:settings.general.remoteNote.en: Language, bot defaults and channel settings are managed in the desktop app.

zh:settings.models.pasteNote.text: 粘贴一个或多个密钥。Murage 会把每个密钥放到合适的位置。
zh:settings.models.pasteNote.en: Paste one or more keys. Murage files each one where it belongs.

zh:settings.voice.note.text: 把语音转成文字，用于录制的技能。
zh:settings.voice.note.en: Turns speech into text for recorded skills.

zh:settings.connections.note.text: 让机器人使用 Gmail、Slack、Notion 等应用。在这里添加密钥，然后连接每个应用。
zh:settings.connections.note.en: Let bots use Gmail, Slack, Notion and more. Add the key here, then connect each app.

zh:settings.connections.ready.text: 已连接应用服务已就绪

zh:settings.connections.moved.text: 在找图片、网页搜索或其他密钥？它们现在各有独立页面：
zh:settings.connections.moved.en: Looking for images, web search or other keys? They have their own pages now:

zh:settings.computer.remoteNote.text: 云电脑或你自己的服务器，供这台电脑无法满足需求的机器人使用。
zh:settings.computer.remoteNote.en: A cloud computer or your own server, for bots that need more than this machine.

zh:settings.about.whatsNewNote.text: 上次更新后打开的那个页面。
zh:settings.about.whatsNewNote.en: The page that opened after the last update.

zh:settings.about.shortcutsNote.en: Every shortcut, with a search box.

zh:settings.about.sourceNote.text: Murage 是遵循 GNU AGPL-3.0-or-later 的开源软件。此版本的源代码是公开的。
zh:settings.about.sourceNote.en: Murage is open source software under the GNU AGPL-3.0-or-later. The source for this version is public.

zh:settings.about.sourceOpen.text: 在 GitHub 上查看源代码

zh:settings.workspaceFeature.browser.not.text: 让支持的机器人使用一个你可以随时查看和接管的浏览器标签页。每个机器人也有自己的浏览器开关。
zh:settings.workspaceFeature.browser.not.en: Let supported bots use a browser tab you can watch and take over. Each bot also has its own browser switch.

zh:settings.workspaceFeature.browser.des.text: 需要 Murage 桌面应用。

zh:settings.workspaceFeature.recorder.no.text: 录制一个工作流程、使用 /learn，或让支持的机器人运行 /create-verification-skill。每项更改都会等你审核。
zh:settings.workspaceFeature.recorder.no.en: Record a workflow, use /learn, or ask a supported bot to run /create-verification-skill. Every change waits for your review.

zh:settings.stub.off.text: 已关闭。开启后，机器人可以{letsBots}。
zh:settings.stub.off.en: Off. Turn it on to let bots {letsBots}.

zh:settings.stub.needsAccount.text: 需要开启了邮件功能的 Flux Router 账户。请{chief}来设置，或打开 Flux Router。
zh:settings.stub.needsAccount.en: Needs a Flux Router account with email on. Ask {chief} to set it up, or open Flux Router.

zh:settings.stub.notYet.text: 你的账户尚未开启。我们正在分批开启。
zh:settings.stub.notYet.en: Not on for your account yet. We are turning it on in stages.

zh:settings.stub.otherSurface.text: 请在你的电脑上设置。在桌面端打开 Murage，然后进入 设置 > {path}。
zh:settings.stub.otherSurface.en: Set this on your computer. Open Murage on the desktop, then Settings > {path}.

zh:settings.stub.needsEngine.text: {engine}暂时无法做到这一点。请在模型中选择可以做到的引擎，或询问{chief}。
zh:settings.stub.needsEngine.en: {engine} cannot do this yet. Pick an engine that can under Model, or ask {chief}.

zh:settings.stub.checking.text: 正在检查你的账户是否已开启{feature}。
zh:settings.stub.checking.en: Checking if {feature} is on for your account.

zh:settings.stub.couldNotCheck.text: 暂时无法检查{feature}。关闭设置后重新打开即可重试。
zh:settings.stub.couldNotCheck.en: Could not check {feature} just now. Close Settings and open it again to try again.

zh:settings.stub.couldNotRead.text: 暂时无法读取{botName}的邮件。打开其他部分后再回来即可重试。
zh:settings.stub.couldNotRead.en: Could not read {botName}'s email just now. Open another section and come back to try again.

zh:settings.stub.letsBots.browser.text: 使用你可以查看和接管的浏览器标签页
zh:settings.stub.letsBots.browser.en: use a browser tab you can watch and take over

zh:settings.stub.letsBots.skillRecorder.text: 通过录制或 /learn 学习技能
zh:settings.stub.letsBots.skillRecorder.en: learn a skill from a recording or /learn

zh:settings.l6.usage.byBotHint.text: 回复数是机器人已完成的回答数量。用量是每个机器人本月的使用量，由所有已完成回复累计得出。
zh:settings.l6.usage.byBotHint.en: Replies are answers a bot finished. Usage is what each bot used this month, added up from every finished reply.

zh:settings.l6.usage.empty.text: 本月还没有用量。机器人首次回复后会显示数据。
zh:settings.l6.usage.empty.en: Nothing used this month yet. Figures appear after a bot's first reply.

zh:settings.l6.usage.sinceNote.text: 本月从 {date} 开始统计，这是此版本开始记录的第一天。在此之前的用量不包含在这些数字中。
zh:settings.l6.usage.sinceNote.en: This month started counting on {date}, the first day this version recorded it. Use before then is not in these figures.

zh:settings.l6.usage.exportFailed.text: 无法保存文件。请再试一次。
zh:settings.l6.usage.exportFailed.en: The file could not be saved. Try again.

zh:settings.l6.usage.cachedNote.text: 新令牌不包括从提供商缓存中重新读取的 {cached}。计入这些重新读取，共有 {total} 经过模型。
zh:settings.l6.usage.cachedNote.en: New tokens leave out {cached} re-read from the provider's cache. With those re-reads, {total} went through the model.

zh:settings.l6.usage.guard.text: 这个上限用来防止失控使用，设置得远高于正常用量。
zh:settings.l6.usage.guard.en: The limit is a guard against runaway use, set well above normal use.

zh:settings.l6.usage.paused.text: 本月剩余时间内学习已暂停。你的机器人仍会回答，并记得已经学到的内容。
zh:settings.l6.usage.paused.en: Learning is paused for the rest of the month. Your bots still answer and remember what is already learned.

zh:settings.l6.paused.title.text: 本月剩余时间内学习已暂停
zh:settings.l6.paused.title.en: Learning paused for the rest of the month

zh:settings.l6.paused.body.text: 已达到本月的学习上限。你的机器人仍会回答，并记得已经学到的内容。Murage 会继续记下新的聊天，让学习从停下的地方继续。
zh:settings.l6.paused.body.en: It reached this month's learning limit. Your bots still answer and remember what is already learned. Murage keeps noting new chats so learning picks up where it left off.

zh:settings.l6.paused.doubled.text: 上限已翻倍。学习现在恢复。

zh:settings.l6.paused.doubleFailed.text: 无法更改上限。请再试一次。
zh:settings.l6.paused.doubleFailed.en: The limit could not be changed. Try again.

zh:settings.l6.paused.leaveFailed.en: That could not be saved. Try again.

zh:settings.l4.advanced.general.text: 登录时启动、后台运行、使用情况分析、侧边栏密度
zh:settings.l4.advanced.general.en: Start at login, keep running in the background, usage analytics, sidebar density

zh:settings.l4.advanced.botDefaults.text: 新机器人投入多少精力、工具使用、机器人在项目中的自主程度、机器人在频道中的活动，以及由哪些机器人处理房间消息
zh:settings.l4.advanced.botDefaults.en: How much effort new bots use, tool use, how independently bots work on projects, bot activity in channels, and which bots handle room messages

zh:settings.l4.advanced.models.text: 模型目录、本地模型服务器、多个 Claude 账户、引擎命令行
zh:settings.l4.advanced.models.en: Model catalogs, local model servers, several Claude accounts, engine command lines

zh:settings.l4.advanced.webSearch.text: 各工具的提供商密钥、每日图片检查
zh:settings.l4.advanced.webSearch.en: Provider keys for each tool, daily image check

zh:settings.l4.profile.noteDesktop.text: 显示在侧边栏中。随改随存。
zh:settings.l4.profile.noteDesktop.en: Shown in the sidebar. Saved as you go.

zh:settings.timeZone.note.text: 机器人用它处理日期、时间和日历工作。在你选择之前，它跟随这台电脑。
zh:settings.timeZone.note.en: Bots use it for dates, times and calendar work. It follows this computer until you pick one.

zh:settings.timeZone.chosen.text: 机器人使用 {zone}，现在 {now}，无论这台电脑在哪里。
zh:settings.timeZone.chosen.en: Bots use {zone}, now {now}, wherever this computer is.

zh:settings.timeZone.saved.text: 已保存。机器人从下一条回复开始使用。
zh:settings.timeZone.saved.en: Saved. Bots use it from their next reply.

zh:settings.timeZone.savedRoutinesPendin.text: 已保存。每日例程的时间尚未更新；Murage 会在运行前再试一次。
zh:settings.timeZone.savedRoutinesPendin.en: Saved. Daily routines' times didn't update yet; Murage tries again before they run.

zh:settings.timeZone.unknown.text: 请从列表中选择一个时区，例如 Asia/Shanghai。
zh:settings.timeZone.unknown.en: Pick a time zone from the list, like America/Chicago.

zh:settings.timeZone.loadError.en: The time zone couldn't be loaded.

zh:settings.timeZone.saveError.en: The time zone didn't save. Try again.

zh:settings.timeZone.noteHome.text: 机器人用它处理日期、时间和日历工作，无论你在哪里。
zh:settings.timeZone.noteHome.en: Bots use it for dates, times and calendar work, wherever you are.

zh:settings.l4.addKey.note.text: 粘贴一个或多个密钥。Murage 会把每个密钥放到合适的位置。
zh:settings.l4.addKey.note.en: Paste one or more keys. Murage files each one where it belongs.

zh:settings.l4.engines.note.text: 安装、更新和修复运行你的机器人的软件。
zh:settings.l4.engines.note.en: Install, update and repair the software that runs your bots.

zh:settings.l4.searchKeys.note.text: 为每个要使用的搜索服务提供一个密钥。请在第一个屏幕上选择服务。
zh:settings.l4.searchKeys.note.en: A key for each search service you want to use. Pick the service on the first screen.

zh:settings.l4.voiceKey.where.text: 在“高级”中添加你的 AssemblyAI 密钥即可开启转写。
zh:settings.l4.voiceKey.where.en: Add your AssemblyAI key under Advanced to turn transcription on.

zh:modelSignIn.heading.en: Use a plan you already have

zh:modelSignIn.note.text: 登录后，你的机器人就可以使用 ChatGPT 或 Grok 套餐附带的模型。套餐限额同样适用。
zh:modelSignIn.note.en: Sign in and your bots can use the models that come with your ChatGPT or Grok plan. Plan limits apply.

zh:modelSignIn.chatgpt.note.text: 使用你的 ChatGPT 套餐登录，方式与 Codex 应用相同。OpenAI 可能会更改或限制此方式。Murage 会保留一份自己的登录信息副本，不会影响你的 Codex 登录。
zh:modelSignIn.chatgpt.note.en: Signs in with your ChatGPT plan the same way the Codex app does. OpenAI may change or limit this. Murage keeps its own copy of the sign-in and leaves your Codex sign-in alone.

zh:modelSignIn.chatgpt.ended.text: 你的 ChatGPT 登录已结束。请重新登录以继续使用。
zh:modelSignIn.chatgpt.ended.en: Your ChatGPT sign-in ended. Sign in again to keep using it.

zh:modelSignIn.chatgpt.unauthorized.text: OpenAI 未接受此次登录。请确认该账户有 ChatGPT 套餐，然后重试。
zh:modelSignIn.chatgpt.unauthorized.en: OpenAI did not accept this sign-in. Check that the account has a ChatGPT plan, then try again.

zh:modelSignIn.grok.note.text: xAI 尚未向其他应用公开此登录方式。如果 xAI 将其关闭，请改用 xAI 密钥。Murage 不会影响你的 Grok Build 登录。
zh:modelSignIn.grok.note.en: xAI has not published this sign-in for other apps yet. If xAI turns it off, use an xAI key instead. Murage leaves your Grok Build sign-in alone.

zh:modelSignIn.grok.ended.text: 你的 Grok 登录已结束。请重新登录以继续使用。
zh:modelSignIn.grok.ended.en: Your Grok sign-in ended. Sign in again to keep using it.

zh:modelSignIn.grok.unauthorized.text: xAI 未接受此次登录。需要 SuperGrok 或 X Premium 套餐。
zh:modelSignIn.grok.unauthorized.en: xAI did not accept this sign-in. A SuperGrok or X Premium plan is needed.

zh:modelSignIn.waiting.text: 请在浏览器中完成登录。此处会自动更新。
zh:modelSignIn.waiting.en: Finish signing in in your browser. This updates on its own.

zh:modelSignIn.pasteHint.text: 等了很久？请从 x.ai 页面复制代码并粘贴到这里。
zh:modelSignIn.pasteHint.en: Taking a while? Copy the code from the x.ai page and paste it here.

zh:modelSignIn.pastePlaceholder.text: 粘贴来自 x.ai 的代码

zh:modelSignIn.codeRefused.text: 该代码未被接受。请重新开始登录。
zh:modelSignIn.codeRefused.en: That code was not accepted. Start the sign-in again.

zh:modelSignIn.signOutFailed.en: Could not sign out. Try again.

zh:modelSignIn.connected.text: 已登录。套餐中的模型现在会出现在模型选择器中。
zh:modelSignIn.connected.en: Signed in. The plan's models now show in the model picker.

zh:modelSignIn.paused.text: 已达到套餐限额。使用此套餐的机器人将在 {time} 后继续。没有任何内容被转移到其他提供商。
zh:modelSignIn.paused.en: Plan limit reached. Bots using this plan pick up again after {time}. Nothing was moved to another provider.

zh:modelSignIn.remote.text: 请在运行 Murage 的电脑上完成登录。
zh:modelSignIn.remote.en: Finish sign-in on the computer running Murage.

zh:modelSignIn.rowNotFetched.text: 已登录 · 尚未获取模型列表
zh:modelSignIn.rowNotFetched.en: Signed in · model list not fetched

zh:modelSignIn.rowEnded.text: 登录已结束 · 请在上方重新登录
zh:modelSignIn.rowEnded.en: Sign-in ended · sign in again above

zh:modelSignIn.error.unauthorized.en: The sign-in was not accepted. Try again.

zh:modelSignIn.error.offline.text: 无法连接登录服务。请检查网络连接后重试。
zh:modelSignIn.error.offline.en: Could not reach the sign-in service. Check your connection and try again.

zh:modelSignIn.error.headless.text: 这台电脑没有可用于浏览器登录的显示器。请改用“使用代码登录”。
zh:modelSignIn.error.headless.en: This computer has no display for a browser sign-in. Use Sign in with a code instead.

zh:modelSignIn.device.open.text: 在任何有浏览器的设备上打开此页面：
zh:modelSignIn.device.open.en: On any device with a browser, open this page:

zh:modelSignIn.device.enter.text: 然后输入此代码。此页面会自动更新。
zh:modelSignIn.device.enter.en: Then enter this code. This updates on its own.

zh:modelSignIn.error.disabled.text: 此版本的 Murage 已关闭该登录方式。
zh:modelSignIn.error.disabled.en: This sign-in is turned off in this version of Murage.

zh:modelSignIn.error.storage.text: 你电脑上用于保存登录信息的存储不可用，因此无法保存此登录。
zh:modelSignIn.error.storage.en: Your computer's storage for sign-in details is unavailable, so this sign-in cannot be saved.

zh:modelSignIn.error.desktopOnly.text: 登录功能需在这台电脑上已安装的 Murage 应用中使用。
zh:modelSignIn.error.desktopOnly.en: Sign-in works in the installed Murage app on this computer.

zh:modelSignIn.error.port.text: 另一个程序正在使用登录连接。请关闭所有已打开的 Codex 登录窗口，然后重试。
zh:modelSignIn.error.port.en: Another program is using the sign-in connection. Close any open Codex sign-in window, then try again.

zh:modelSignIn.error.browser.text: 无法打开你的浏览器。请重试。
zh:modelSignIn.error.browser.en: Could not open your browser. Try again.

zh:modelSignIn.error.unknown.en: Sign-in did not finish. Try again.

zh:modelPicker.signIn.claude.text: Claude Code 运行 Claude 模型。要使用你的 ChatGPT 或 Grok 套餐，请选择 Fuigo 或 Codex。
zh:modelPicker.signIn.claude.en: Claude Code runs Claude models. Pick Fuigo or Codex to use your ChatGPT or Grok plan.

zh:modelPicker.signIn.noConnections.text: 此引擎不使用模型连接。要使用你的 ChatGPT 或 Grok 套餐，请选择 Fuigo 或 Codex。
zh:modelPicker.signIn.noConnections.en: This engine does not use model connections. Pick Fuigo or Codex to use your ChatGPT or Grok plan.

zh:modelPicker.signIn.paused.text: {name}：已达到套餐限额。相关工作将在 {time} 后继续。
zh:modelPicker.signIn.paused.en: {name}: plan limit reached. Work on it picks up again after {time}.

zh:projects.common.goalChanged.text: 此目标已更改。请刷新后重试。
zh:projects.common.goalChanged.en: This goal changed. Refresh and try again.

zh:projects.common.cardsNotAvailable.en: Card controls are not available yet

zh:projects.close.blocked.text: 关闭此项目前，请先停止进行中的目标。
zh:projects.close.blocked.en: Stop the active goal before closing this project.

zh:projects.close.signOff.text: 请先确认目标完成，或停止目标后再关闭此项目。
zh:projects.close.signOff.en: Sign off the goal first, or stop it and close this project.

zh:projects.close.ready.text: 项目工作完成后，即可关闭此项目。
zh:projects.close.ready.en: Close this project when its work is finished.

zh:projects.close.effects.text: 未完成的卡片和请求将被取消。负责人会总结工作和交付成果，成员会保存经验教训，例行任务将被暂停。你之后可以重新打开项目。
zh:projects.close.effects.en: Open cards and requests will be cancelled. The lead will summarise the work and deliverables, members will save lessons, and routines will be paused. You can reopen the project later.

zh:projects.end.effects.text: 目标将被停止，未完成的卡片将被取消，看板变为只读，工作文件夹将被清空。此房间将变为频道。历史记录仍可阅读。
zh:projects.end.effects.en: The goal will be stopped, open cards cancelled, the board made read-only, and work folders cleared. This room becomes a channel. History stays readable.

zh:projects.new.membersLoadError.text: 无法加载成员列表。请关闭此表单后重试。
zh:projects.new.membersLoadError.en: The member list could not load. Close this form and try again.

zh:projects.new.reviewNote.text: 请查看方案，然后创建项目。
zh:projects.new.reviewNote.en: Review the proposal, then create the project.

zh:projects.new.fillBelow.text: 请在下方填写项目信息。

zh:projects.new.chiefFailed.text: Chief 无法提出项目方案。请在下方填写项目信息。
zh:projects.new.chiefFailed.en: The Chief could not propose a project. Fill in the project below.

zh:projects.new.createFailed.en: The project could not be created.

zh:projects.new.openToCheck.text: 打开项目以查看其目标。
zh:projects.new.openToCheck.en: Open the project to check its goal.

zh:projects.new.goalStarted.text: 目标已开始。负责人正在制定计划。
zh:projects.new.goalStarted.en: The goal has started. The lead is planning it now.

zh:projects.new.startNowHint.text: 填写了目标标题时，项目一创建，负责人就会开始该目标。取消勾选后，目标将保持草稿状态，直到你开始它。
zh:projects.new.startNowHint.en: With a goal title, the lead starts the goal as soon as the project is created. Unchecked, the goal stays a draft until you start it.

zh:projects.new.usage.text: 你打算如何使用这个项目？
zh:projects.new.usage.en: How will you use this project?

zh:projects.new.mode.bots.text: 一组机器人共同处理一件事
zh:projects.new.mode.bots.en: A group of bots on one job

zh:projects.new.firstPlanHint.text: 最多 8 行，每行 280 个字符。计入目标描述或规则的字数上限。
zh:projects.new.firstPlanHint.en: Up to 8 lines, 280 characters each. Counts towards the goal description or rules limit.

zh:projects.activity.changed.text: 项目已更改。请刷新后重试。
zh:projects.activity.changed.en: The project changed. Refresh and try again.

zh:projects.activity.digestHint.text: 每天在聊天中发布一条简短摘要，并将其添加到你的收件箱。
zh:projects.activity.digestHint.en: Posts a short summary in the chat once a day and adds it to your Inbox.

zh:projects.autonomy.saveFailed.en: This setting could not be saved.

zh:projects.autonomy.hint.text: 关闭时，排队中的项目工作会等待。正在运行的工作可以完成。
zh:projects.autonomy.hint.en: When off, queued project work waits. Running work can finish.

zh:projects.autonomy.parallelHint.text: 关闭时，每个项目一次只启动一张卡片。正在运行的卡片可以完成。
zh:projects.autonomy.parallelHint.en: When off, each project starts one card at a time. Running cards can finish.

zh:projects.lifecycle.closingFor.text: 正在关闭：等待 {name} 的总结

zh:projects.lifecycle.closed.text: 此项目已关闭。例行任务会保持暂停，直到你逐个恢复。
zh:projects.lifecycle.closed.en: This project is closed. Routines stay paused until you resume each one.

zh:projects.lifecycle.reopenedPaused.text: 项目已重新打开。已暂停的例行任务：{routines}。{hint}

zh:projects.lifecycle.reopened.text: 项目已重新打开。准备好后请恢复。

zh:projects.strip.limitTitle.text: 达到你设定的上限后将不再启动新工作
zh:projects.strip.limitTitle.en: stops starting new work at your limit

zh:projects.work.budgetHint.text: Murage 达到你设定的上限后将不再启动新工作。正在运行的轮次会完成。
zh:projects.work.budgetHint.en: Murage stops starting new work at your limit. Running turns finish.

zh:projects.work.needsApp.text: 这需要在你的电脑上使用 Murage 应用。
zh:projects.work.needsApp.en: This needs the Murage app on your computer.

zh:projects.work.cardsHint.text: 选择此项目可以同时处理多少张卡片。
zh:projects.work.cardsHint.en: Choose how many cards this project can work on at once.

zh:projects.work.foldersHint.text: 工作文件夹会限制 Murage 代你批准的范围。设置为自行更改文件的引擎不受其限制。
zh:projects.work.foldersHint.en: Work folders limit what Murage approves for you. Engines set to change files on their own are not limited by them.

zh:projects.work.asksOutside.text: {name}：在工作文件夹之外更改前会询问你
zh:projects.work.asksOutside.en: {name}: Asks you before changes outside the work folders

zh:projects.work.usesApprovals.text: {name}：文件操作使用本轮的批准级别
zh:projects.work.usesApprovals.en: {name}: File actions use this turn's approval level

zh:projects.work.usesEngine.text: {name}：使用 {name} 的引擎设置：可能会在其工作文件夹中未经询问直接更改文件
zh:projects.work.usesEngine.en: {name}: Uses {name}'s engine setting: it may change files in its working folder without asking

zh:projects.inbox.stepChanged.text: 此步骤已更改。请刷新后重试。
zh:projects.inbox.stepChanged.en: This step changed. Refresh and try again.

zh:projects.inbox.stepFailed.en: This step could not be changed.

zh:projects.inbox.answerFailed.en: This answer could not be sent.

zh:projects.inbox.restartStep.text: 此步骤在重启时中断：重试步骤或跳过
zh:projects.inbox.restartStep.en: This step stopped at a restart: Retry step or Skip

zh:projects.inbox.markDone.text: 要未经审核就将此步骤标记为完成吗？
zh:projects.inbox.markDone.en: Mark this step done without review?

zh:projects.sheet.threadFailed.en: The work thread could not open.

zh:projects.goalForm.review.text: 由另一位成员审核每张卡片

zh:projects.goalView.evidenceGone.en: The evidence is no longer available.

zh:projects.goalView.threadGone.en: The work thread is no longer available.

zh:projects.goalView.chooseFolder.text: 请在项目设置中选择工作文件夹，以导出简报。
zh:projects.goalView.chooseFolder.en: Choose a work folder in project settings to export the brief.

zh:projects.goalView.goalsOff.text: 此项目已关闭目标功能
zh:projects.goalView.goalsOff.en: Goals are off for this project

zh:projects.goalView.stopConfirm.text: 要停止此目标并取消其未完成的卡片吗？
zh:projects.goalView.stopConfirm.en: Stop this goal and cancel its open cards?

zh:projects.board.queuedToStart.text: 卡片 {number} 已排队等待开始

zh:projects.board.off.en: The board is off for this project

zh:projects.board.dragInstructions.text: 按空格键或回车键拿起卡片。用方向键移动，按空格键放下，按 Esc 取消。点按或点击卡片可查看详情，也可用 Tab 键切换到它的“详情”按钮。
zh:projects.board.dragInstructions.en: Space or Enter picks up a card. Arrow keys move it, Space drops it, Escape cancels. Tap or click a card for its details, or Tab to its Details button.

zh:projects.board.confirmDone.text: 要未经审核就将此卡片标记为完成吗？
zh:projects.board.confirmDone.en: Mark this card done without a review?

zh:projects.cardForm.notSaved.text: 卡片未保存。请检查看板状态后重试。
zh:projects.cardForm.notSaved.en: The card was not saved. Check the board status and try again.

zh:projects.columns.changed.text: 列已更改。你的编辑未保存，请重试。
zh:projects.columns.changed.en: The columns changed. Your edit was not saved; try again.

zh:projects.columns.hint.text: 每个自定义列都会保留其状态。如需使用其他状态，请删除该列并新增一列。
zh:projects.columns.hint.en: Each custom column keeps its state. To use another state, delete it and add a new column.

zh:projects.columns.cardMoves.en: {count} card moves back to the main column.

zh:projects.columns.cardsMove.en: {count} cards move back to the main column.

zh:projects.details.controlsUnavailable.en: Project controls are not available yet

zh:projects.details.noMembers.text: 没有可供重新分配的成员

zh:projects.details.stopPrompt.text: 要停止此项目中的所有工作吗？排队中的工作将被取消，正在运行的工作将被中断。
zh:projects.details.stopPrompt.en: Stop all work in this project? Queued work is cancelled and running work is interrupted.

zh:projects.details.limitNote.text: 达到你设定的上限后，此项目将不再启动新工作。
zh:projects.details.limitNote.en: This project stops starting new work at your limit.

zh:projects.details.usageReported.text: 已用工作时间：{minutes} 分钟。已上报 {tokens} 个令牌。

zh:projects.details.usageUnreported.text: 已用工作时间：{minutes} 分钟。未上报令牌。
zh:projects.details.usageUnreported.en: Work used: {minutes} min. Tokens not reported.

zh:projects.goalAction.unavailable.text: 此操作对该目标不可用。
zh:projects.goalAction.unavailable.en: This action is not available for this goal.

zh:projects.goalAction.noteLong.text: 备注请控制在 500 个字符以内。

zh:projects.goalForm.errTitle.text: 请为目标填写不超过 200 个字符的标题。
zh:projects.goalForm.errTitle.en: Give the goal a title of up to 200 characters.

zh:projects.goalForm.errDescription.text: 描述请控制在 2000 个字符以内。

zh:projects.goalForm.errCriteria.text: 最多使用 10 条标准，每条 1 到 300 个字符。
zh:projects.goalForm.errCriteria.en: Use up to 10 criteria, each with 1 to 300 characters.

zh:projects.goalForm.errDeadline.text: 请选择有效的截止日期。

zh:projects.budget.paused.text: 已达限额：达到你的限额后不再开始新工作
zh:projects.budget.paused.en: Limit reached: no new work starts

zh:projects.face.goalPaused.text: 等待中：目标已暂停。请打开目标并点击“恢复”。
zh:projects.face.goalPaused.en: Waiting: the goal is paused. Open the goal and press Resume.

zh:projects.face.waitingDependency.text: 正在等待另一项任务完成
zh:projects.face.waitingDependency.en: waiting for another task to finish

zh:projects.client.unavailable.en: Project details are not available yet

zh:projects.client.changed.text: 内容已变化。请刷新后重试。
zh:projects.client.changed.en: This changed. Refresh and try again.

zh:projects.client.couldNot.en: This action could not be completed.

zh:projects.move.gone.text: 此卡片或列已不在看板上。
zh:projects.move.gone.en: This card or column is no longer on the board.

zh:projects.move.answerFirst.text: 请先做出所请求的决定，或中断此卡片。
zh:projects.move.answerFirst.en: Make the requested decision or interrupt this card first.

zh:projects.move.pickTeammate.text: 开始此卡片前，请先选择一位队友。
zh:projects.move.pickTeammate.en: Pick a teammate before starting this card.

zh:projects.move.queued.text: 卡片 {number} 已排队等待开始

zh:projects.boardNote.changed.text: 内容已变化。看板现已是最新状态。
zh:projects.boardNote.changed.en: This changed. The board is up to date now.

zh:projects.lane.pickTeammate.text: 选择一位队友，将此项重新分配给对方
zh:projects.lane.pickTeammate.en: Pick a teammate to reassign this to

zh:projects.lane.noCard.en: This card is no longer on the board.

zh:projects.lane.reopenFirst.text: 重新分配前，请先重新打开或恢复此卡片。
zh:projects.lane.reopenFirst.en: Reopen or restore this card before reassigning it.

zh:projects.lane.reassigned.text: 卡片 {number} 已重新分配并移到“{state}”
zh:projects.lane.reassigned.en: Card {number} was reassigned and moved to {state}

zh:projects.kb.cancelled.text: 已取消移动。卡片 {number} 已放回原处。

zh:projects.kb.picked.text: 已拿起卡片 {number}“{title}”。用方向键移动，按空格键放下，按 Esc 取消。
zh:projects.kb.picked.en: Picked up card {number}, '{title}'. Arrow keys move it, Space drops it, Escape cancels.

zh:projects.colErr.max.text: 最多可添加 12 个自定义列。
zh:projects.colErr.max.en: You can add up to 12 custom columns.

zh:projects.colErr.distinct.text: 请选择一个不重复的自定义列。

zh:projects.colErr.title.text: 列标题请使用 1 到 40 个字符。
zh:projects.colErr.title.en: Use 1 to 40 characters for a column title.

zh:projects.colErr.state.text: 请选择列的状态和位置。
zh:projects.colErr.state.en: Choose a column state and position.

zh:projects.colErr.stateLocked.text: 列的状态无法更改。请删除它，再添加另一列。
zh:projects.colErr.stateLocked.en: A column's state cannot change. Delete it and add another column.

zh:projects.act.criteria.text: 将任务标记为完成的一项要求已变更
zh:projects.act.criteria.en: A requirement for marking the task done changed

zh:projects.act.decision_opened.text: 有一项决定需要你处理

zh:projects.act.budget_paused.text: 已达限额：新工作已暂停
zh:projects.act.budget_paused.en: Limit reached: new work is paused

zh:projects.act.handoffEnded.en: Handed work to {name}. It did not finish.

zh:projects.act.handoffTeammate.text: 已将工作交给一位队友

zh:projects.act.handoffTeammateEnded.text: 已将工作交给一位队友。未完成。
zh:projects.act.handoffTeammateEnded.en: Handed work to a teammate. It did not finish.

zh:projects.act.pageLimit.text: 此时间点上的活动多于可加载的数量。更早的活动无法显示。
zh:projects.act.pageLimit.en: More activity shares this timestamp than can be loaded. Older activity could not be shown.

zh:projects.newErr.lengths.text: 请检查目的和目标文本的长度。
zh:projects.newErr.lengths.en: Check the purpose and goal text lengths.

zh:projects.newErr.lead.text: 请从成员中选择一位负责人。
zh:projects.newErr.lead.en: Choose a lead from the members.

zh:projects.newErr.chatLead.text: 请为聊天室选择一位负责人。
zh:projects.newErr.chatLead.en: Choose a lead for the chat room.

zh:projects.newErr.planLines.text: 首个计划最多 8 行，每行不超过 280 个字符。
zh:projects.newErr.planLines.en: First plan allows up to 8 lines of 280 characters each.

zh:projects.newErr.planNeedsTitle.text: 请添加目标标题以保留首个计划，或清除该计划。
zh:projects.newErr.planNeedsTitle.en: Add a goal title to keep the First plan, or clear the plan.

zh:projects.newErr.descLong.text: 目标描述和首个计划合计不得超过 2,000 个字符。
zh:projects.newErr.descLong.en: Goal description and First plan must fit within 2,000 characters.

zh:projects.newErr.rulesLong.text: 规则和首个计划合计不得超过 12,000 个字符。
zh:projects.newErr.rulesLong.en: Rules and First plan must fit within 12,000 characters.

zh:projects.newErr.briefLong.text: 简报不得超过 12,000 个字符。
zh:projects.newErr.briefLong.en: The brief must fit within 12,000 characters.

zh:projects.newErr.budget.text: 工作分钟数请使用 1 到 100,000 的整数，令牌数请使用 1 到 9,007,199,254,740,991 的整数。
zh:projects.newErr.budget.en: Use whole work minutes from 1 to 100,000 and whole tokens from 1 to 9,007,199,254,740,991.

zh:projects.startErr.lead.text: 开始前，请先选择一位负责人并开启项目负责人功能。
zh:projects.startErr.lead.en: Choose a lead and turn project leads on before starting.

zh:projects.startErr.board.en: Turn the board on before starting.

zh:projects.startErr.goals.text: 开始前，请先开启项目目标。
zh:projects.startErr.goals.en: Turn project goals on before starting.

zh:projects.startErr.work.text: 开始前，请先开启项目工作。
zh:projects.startErr.work.en: Turn project work on before starting.

zh:projects.statusNote.paused.text: 暂时搁置。什么都不会丢失。
zh:projects.statusNote.paused.en: Set down for the moment. Nothing is lost.

zh:projects.statusNote.done.text: 工作已完成。聊天会保留在这里。
zh:projects.statusNote.done.en: The work is finished. The chat stays here.

zh:botImages.intro.text: 此机器人在生成图片之前是否先询问你。
zh:botImages.intro.en: Whether this bot asks you before it makes an image.

zh:botImages.followTip.text: 在完全访问和无限制级别下，图片无需询问即可生成；在询问和自动级别下，会先询问。
zh:botImages.followTip.en: Full access and No limits make images without asking; Ask and Auto ask first.

zh:botImages.askTip.text: 无论级别如何，每张图片都会等待你的答复。
zh:botImages.askTip.en: Every image waits for your answer, whatever the level.

zh:botImages.allow.text: 无需询问即可生成图片

zh:botImages.allowTip.text: 机器人一提出请求就生成图片，适用于你自己的对话和例程。联系人和其他任何人的请求仍需要你批准。
zh:botImages.allowTip.en: Images are made as soon as the bot asks, in your own conversations and routines. Requests from contacts and anyone else still need your approval.

zh:botImages.askAfterLabel.text: 单次对话回合生成这么多张图片后再次询问
zh:botImages.askAfterLabel.en: Ask again after this many images in one turn

zh:botImages.askAfterHint.text: 留空则使用默认值 50。达到上限后，下一张图片会再次出现确认卡片。
zh:botImages.askAfterHint.en: Leave blank to use the default of 50. When the limit is reached, the card comes back for the next image.

zh:botImages.askAfterInvalid.text: 请输入 1 到 50 之间的整数，或留空。
zh:botImages.askAfterInvalid.en: Enter a whole number from 1 to 50, or leave it blank.

zh:botImages.desktopOnly.text: 图片设置只能在 Murage 桌面应用中修改。
zh:botImages.desktopOnly.en: The Images setting can only be changed in the Murage desktop app.

zh:fluxKeyBanner.refused.text: Flux Router 拒绝了你的密钥。请从你的 Flux Router 账户粘贴当前的密钥。
zh:fluxKeyBanner.refused.en: Flux Router refused your key. Paste a current key from your Flux Router account.

zh:fluxKeyBanner.notFlux.text: 已保存的 Flux 密钥不是 Flux Router 密钥，所以 Murage 没有使用它。Flux Router 密钥以 sk-flux- 开头。
zh:fluxKeyBanner.notFlux.en: The saved Flux key is not a Flux Router key, so Murage is not using it. A Flux Router key starts with sk-flux-.

zh:phone.lan.warning.text: 通过此 Wi-Fi 配对不加密。同一网络中的任何人都可能读取你的手机与这台电脑之间发送的内容。请只在你信任的网络上使用，或改用 Tailscale 配对。
zh:phone.lan.warning.en: Pairing on this Wi-Fi is not encrypted. Anyone on the same network could read what your phone and this computer send. Use it only on a network you trust, or pair over Tailscale instead.

zh:phone.lan.on.text: Wi-Fi 配对已开启。它在你的本地网络上不加密。
zh:phone.lan.on.en: Wi-Fi pairing is on. It is not encrypted on your local network.

zh:phone.lan.narrowed.text: 由于 Wi-Fi 配对不加密，现在除非你主动选择，否则它是关闭的。通过 Wi-Fi 配对的手机在你重新开启之前无法连接这台电脑。使用 Tailscale 的手机不受影响。
zh:phone.lan.narrowed.en: Wi-Fi pairing is now off unless you choose it, because it is not encrypted. A phone that paired over Wi-Fi can't reach this computer until you turn it back on. Phones that use Tailscale are not affected.

zh:phone.revoke.body.text: {name} 将退出登录，需要重新配对才能使用 Murage。
zh:phone.revoke.body.en: {name} is signed out and must be paired again to use Murage.

zh:modelSignIn.error.keyring.text: Murage 暂时无法保存此登录。这台电脑没有已解锁的密钥环（一种保护已保存登录信息的服务），因此如果保存此登录信息，它也只会被隐藏，而不会受到保护。请安装并解锁 gnome-keyring 或 KWallet 等密钥环，然后重启 Murage 并重新登录。
zh:modelSignIn.error.keyring.en: Murage can't save this sign-in yet. This computer has no unlocked keyring, a service that protects saved sign-in details, so a saved sign-in would only be hidden, not protected. Install and unlock a keyring such as gnome-keyring or KWallet, then restart Murage and sign in again.

zh:mcp.panel.lede.text: 给你的机器人更多工具。粘贴服务提供给你的链接、命令或配置片段。工具调用仍然遵循你平常的批准设置。
zh:mcp.panel.lede.en: Give your bots more tools. Paste the link a service gives you, a command, or a config snippet. Tool calls still follow your normal approval settings.

zh:mcp.panel.warning.text: 命令服务器在这台电脑上运行，并使用你提供的环境变量。链接服务器会收到你的机器人发送的内容。只添加你信任的服务器。新服务器在你启用之前保持关闭。
zh:mcp.panel.warning.en: Command servers run on this computer with the environment variables you provide. Link servers receive what your bots send them. Only add servers you trust. New servers stay off until you enable them.

zh:mcp.panel.empty.text: 还没有服务器。粘贴一个链接来添加第一个。
zh:mcp.panel.empty.en: No servers yet. Paste a link to add your first one.

zh:mcp.add.label.text: 粘贴链接、命令或一小段设置文本
zh:mcp.add.label.en: Paste a link, a command, or a short piece of settings text

zh:mcp.add.help.text: 其余的交给 Murage 来判断。在你同意之前，什么都不会开启。
zh:mcp.add.help.en: Murage works out the rest. Nothing is turned on until you say so.

zh:mcp.add.inspecting.text: 正在查看你粘贴的内容…

zh:mcp.add.nameTaken.text: 请换一个尚未使用的名称。
zh:mcp.add.nameTaken.en: Give it a name that is not used yet.

zh:mcp.add.typeLink.text: 指向在线服务器的链接

zh:mcp.add.typeCommand.text: 在这台电脑上运行的命令
zh:mcp.add.typeCommand.en: Command that runs on this computer

zh:mcp.add.tooMany.text: 一次只检查前 {count} 个链接。添加其余的之后，请对它们点按测试。
zh:mcp.add.tooMany.en: Only the first {count} links are checked at once. Press Test on the others after you add them.

zh:mcp.card.signin.tip.text: 会打开你的浏览器，让你登录 {host}。Murage 会保存登录状态，并且绝不会把它交给机器人。
zh:mcp.card.signin.tip.en: Opens your browser so you can sign in to {host}. Murage keeps the sign-in and never gives it to a bot.

zh:mcp.card.signin.waiting.text: 请在浏览器中完成登录。完成后此窗口会自动更新。
zh:mcp.card.signin.waiting.en: Finish signing in in your browser. This window updates when you are done.

zh:mcp.card.signin.desktopOnly.text: 登录需要 Murage 桌面应用。
zh:mcp.card.signin.desktopOnly.en: Signing in needs the Murage desktop app.

zh:mcp.card.key.title.en: This tool connection needs a key.

zh:mcp.card.key.sentAsTip.text: 把你的密钥传给服务器的请求头（随请求发送的一个命名字段）的名称。大多数服务器使用前两个之一。
zh:mcp.card.key.sentAsTip.en: The name of the header (a named field sent with a request) that carries your key to the server. Most servers use one of the first two.

zh:mcp.card.key.hint.text: 你可以在 {host} 的账户设置中找到它。
zh:mcp.card.key.hint.en: You can find it in your {host} account settings.

zh:mcp.card.fields.one.text: 此服务器需要你提供一个值。
zh:mcp.card.fields.one.en: This server needs one value from you.

zh:mcp.card.fields.many.text: 此服务器需要你提供 {count} 个值。
zh:mcp.card.fields.many.en: This server needs {count} values from you.

zh:mcp.card.fields.hidden.text: 输入时，机密值会被隐藏。
zh:mcp.card.fields.hidden.en: Secret values are hidden as you type.

zh:mcp.card.local.computer.text: 此链接指向这台电脑。只有在你自己启动了这个服务器时才继续。
zh:mcp.card.local.computer.en: This link points to this computer. Only continue if you started this server yourself.

zh:mcp.card.local.network.text: 此链接指向你本地网络中的一台设备（{host}）。只有在你清楚那里运行的是什么时才继续。
zh:mcp.card.local.network.en: This link points to a device on your local network ({host}). Only continue if you know what runs there.

zh:mcp.card.moved.text: 此服务器已迁移到 {url}。使用新链接吗？
zh:mcp.card.moved.en: This server has moved to {url}. Use the new link?

zh:mcp.card.moved.paste.text: 请在上方粘贴新链接以使用它。
zh:mcp.card.moved.paste.en: Paste the new link above to use it.

zh:mcp.card.connected.one.text: 已连接。找到 1 个工具。

zh:mcp.card.connected.other.text: 已连接。找到 {count} 个工具。

zh:mcp.card.connected.none.text: 已连接。服务器暂时没有列出工具。
zh:mcp.card.connected.none.en: Connected. The server lists no tools yet.

zh:mcp.card.turnOnTip.text: 新服务器在你开启之前保持关闭。工具调用遵循每个机器人的审批设置。
zh:mcp.card.turnOnTip.en: New servers stay off until you turn them on. Tool calls follow each bot's approval settings.

zh:mcp.card.addTestTip.text: 先以关闭状态保存服务器，然后连接它并列出它的工具。
zh:mcp.card.addTestTip.en: Saves the server turned off, then connects to it and lists its tools.

zh:mcp.card.addedOff.text: 已添加。在你开启之前它保持关闭。
zh:mcp.card.addedOff.en: Added. It stays off until you turn it on.

zh:mcp.card.install.setup.text: 正在首次设置。这可能需要一两分钟。
zh:mcp.card.install.setup.en: Setting it up for the first time. This can take a minute or two.

zh:mcp.card.install.still.text: 仍在设置中。大型服务器首次需要更长时间。
zh:mcp.card.install.still.en: Still setting up. Big servers take longer the first time.

zh:mcp.card.test.slow.text: 这比平时花的时间更长。
zh:mcp.card.test.slow.en: This is taking longer than usual.

zh:mcp.card.test.noAnswer.en: The server did not answer in time.

zh:mcp.reason.needsSignIn.en: This server needs you to sign in to {host}.

zh:mcp.reason.needsKey.en: This tool connection needs a key.

zh:mcp.reason.keyRejected.text: {host} 未接受此密钥。请检查后重试。
zh:mcp.reason.keyRejected.en: {host} did not accept this key. Check it and try again.

zh:mcp.reason.signInEnded.text: {host} 已将你退出登录。请重新登录以继续使用。
zh:mcp.reason.signInEnded.en: {host} signed you out. Sign in again to keep using it.

zh:mcp.reason.needsMoreAccess.text: {host} 需要你为此工具允许更多权限。请重新登录以允许。
zh:mcp.reason.needsMoreAccess.en: {host} needs you to allow more access for this tool. Sign in again to allow it.

zh:mcp.reason.notFound.text: Murage 找不到 {host}。请检查链接和你的网络连接。
zh:mcp.reason.notFound.en: Murage could not find {host}. Check the link and your internet connection.

zh:mcp.reason.unreachable.text: {host} 没有接受连接。请检查链接，或稍后再试。
zh:mcp.reason.unreachable.en: {host} did not accept the connection. Check the link, or try again in a moment.

zh:mcp.reason.wrongAddress.text: 此地址没有响应工具连接。请检查是否复制了完整链接。
zh:mcp.reason.wrongAddress.en: Nothing at this address answers as a tool connection. Check that you copied the whole link.

zh:mcp.reason.httpsRequired.text: Murage 只通过 https 连接互联网上的服务器。请确认链接以 https:// 开头。
zh:mcp.reason.httpsRequired.en: Murage connects to servers on the internet over https only. Check the link starts with https://.

zh:mcp.reason.addressChanged.text: 这个名称现在指向的位置与你添加时不同。如果这是预期的，请删除后重新添加。
zh:mcp.reason.addressChanged.en: This name now points somewhere else than when you added it. Remove it and add it again if that is expected.

zh:mcp.reason.blockedAddress.text: Murage 不会连接这类地址。
zh:mcp.reason.blockedAddress.en: Murage does not connect to that kind of address.

zh:mcp.reason.serverError.text: {host} 在响应时出了问题。请稍后再试。
zh:mcp.reason.serverError.en: {host} had a problem answering. Try again in a moment.

zh:mcp.reason.noAnswer.text: 服务器没有及时响应。请稍后再试。
zh:mcp.reason.noAnswer.en: The server did not answer in time. Try again in a moment.

zh:mcp.reason.noRegistration.text: {host} 不允许应用以此方式登录。请改用密钥。
zh:mcp.reason.noRegistration.en: {host} does not let apps sign in this way. Use a key instead.

zh:mcp.row.testTip.text: 连接到服务器并列出它的工具。
zh:mcp.row.testTip.en: Connects to the server and lists its tools.

zh:mcp.row.signInTip.text: 请在浏览器中重新登录 {host}。
zh:mcp.row.signInTip.en: Sign in to {host} again in your browser.

zh:mcp.card.stale.text: 此服务器已更改，请重新请求

zh:mcp.enable.command.text: {bot} 添加了一个在此电脑上运行的命令：
zh:mcp.enable.command.en: {bot} added a command that runs on this computer:

zh:mcp.enable.link.text: {bot} 添加了一个位于此地址的服务器：
zh:mcp.enable.link.en: {bot} added a server at this address:

zh:mcp.enable.off.text: 在你打开之前它保持关闭。
zh:mcp.enable.off.en: It stays off until you turn it on.

zh:mcp.enable.pending.text: 请先在它的卡片上输入 {names}。

zh:mcp.enable.on.text: 已打开。你的机器人从下一条消息起可以使用 {name}。
zh:mcp.enable.on.en: Turned on. Your bots can use {name} from their next message.

zh:mcp.panel.waiting.text: 你的机器人添加了 {count} 个服务器，正在等待你的审核。开启或移除它们，才能腾出位置添加更多。
zh:mcp.panel.waiting.en: {count} servers your bots added are waiting for your review. Turn them on or remove them to make room for more.

zh:mcp.row.connectedNoTools.text: 已连接 · 没有可用工具

zh:mcp.remove.confirm.text: 移除 {name}？你的机器人将失去它的工具。
zh:mcp.remove.confirm.en: Remove {name}? Your bots lose its tools.

zh:mcp.notice.switched.text: {name} 现在{state}。新任务将使用此更改。
zh:mcp.notice.switched.en: {name} is now {state}. New tasks will use this change.

zh:mcp.row.nameClash.text: 已关闭：引擎无法将此名称与 {other} 区分。请重新命名后使用。
zh:mcp.row.nameClash.en: Turned off: engines cannot tell this name apart from {other}. Give it a new name to use it.

zh:mcp.notice.renamed.text: {from} 已改名为 {to}。准备好后请开启；已保存的密钥需要重新输入。
zh:mcp.notice.renamed.en: {from} is now {to}. Turn it on when you are ready; enter any saved keys again.

zh:mcp.edit.env.text: 环境 · 每行一个 KEY=值

zh:mcp.edit.envHint.text: 将已有的值留空可保持其已保存状态。删除该行即可移除它。
zh:mcp.edit.envHint.en: Leave an existing value blank to keep it saved. Remove the line to delete it.

zh:mcp.edit.needBoth.text: 请填写服务器名称和可执行命令。
zh:mcp.edit.needBoth.en: Add a server name and executable command.

zh:mcp.edit.keepAsk.text: 你更改了此服务器运行的内容。要为新命令保留它已保存的值({keys})还是清除?
zh:mcp.edit.keepAsk.en: You changed what this server runs. Keep its saved values ({keys}) for the new command, or clear them?

zh:mcp.signin.body.text: {name} 需要你重新登录，{bot} 才能使用它。
zh:mcp.signin.body.en: {name} needs you to sign in again before {bot} can use it.

zh:mcp.signin.phone.text: 请在运行 Murage 的电脑上完成登录。
zh:mcp.signin.phone.en: Finish sign-in on the computer running Murage.

zh:mcp.signin.signedIn.text: 已登录。{bot} 正在继续任务。
zh:mcp.signin.signedIn.en: Signed in. {bot} is continuing the task.

zh:mcp.signin.waiting.text: 正在等待你在浏览器中完成…
zh:mcp.signin.waiting.en: Waiting for you to finish in your browser…

zh:mcp.signin.dismissFailed.text: 请在运行 Murage 的电脑上关闭此卡片。
zh:mcp.signin.dismissFailed.en: Close this card on the computer running Murage.

zh:mcp.add.secretHidden.text: 你粘贴的机密值现已隐藏，并已填入下方。
zh:mcp.add.secretHidden.en: The secret you pasted is hidden now. It is filled in below.

zh:mcp.card.argSecret.text: 此命令传入的值中含有密钥，会以明文保存。请将它移到环境变量，即服务器启动时传给它的一项命名设置。许多服务器会从环境变量读取密钥，例如 {name}。
zh:mcp.card.argSecret.en: This command includes a secret among the values passed to it, where it would be saved as plain text. Move it to an environment variable, a named setting passed to the server when it starts. Many servers read a key from one, such as {name}.

zh:mcp.card.argSecretMove.en: Move to a server startup setting

zh:mcp.paste.fail.empty.text: 请粘贴链接、命令或一小段设置文本。
zh:mcp.paste.fail.empty.en: Paste a link, a command, or a short piece of settings text.

zh:mcp.paste.fail.too-large.text: 内容超过 64 KiB。请只粘贴你想要的那个服务器的部分。
zh:mcp.paste.fail.too-large.en: That is more than 64 KiB. Paste just the part for the server you want.

zh:mcp.paste.fail.too-many.text: 这个片段包含超过 20 个服务器。请每次少粘贴一些。
zh:mcp.paste.fail.too-many.en: That snippet has more than 20 servers. Paste fewer at a time.

zh:mcp.paste.fail.toml.text: 暂不支持 Codex 的 config.toml 文件。请改为粘贴服务器的链接或命令。
zh:mcp.paste.fail.toml.en: Codex config.toml files are not supported yet. Paste the server's link or its command instead.

zh:mcp.paste.fail.yaml.text: 不支持 YAML 配置。请改为粘贴服务器的链接、命令或 JSON 片段。
zh:mcp.paste.fail.yaml.en: YAML config is not supported. Paste the server's link, its command, or a JSON snippet instead.

zh:mcp.paste.fail.invalid-json.text: 这看起来像 JSON，但无法读取。请检查是否缺少括号或引号。
zh:mcp.paste.fail.invalid-json.en: That looks like JSON but could not be read. Check for a missing bracket or quote.

zh:mcp.paste.fail.invalid-entry.text: 这个片段中没有任何服务器带有命令或链接。
zh:mcp.paste.fail.invalid-entry.en: None of the servers in that snippet has a command or a link.

zh:mcp.paste.fail.multi-command.text: 请每次只粘贴一条命令。
zh:mcp.paste.fail.multi-command.en: Paste one command at a time.

zh:mcp.paste.fail.shell-syntax.text: 请粘贴一条不含管道、重定向或替换的单独命令。Murage 会直接运行它，而不是通过 shell。
zh:mcp.paste.fail.shell-syntax.en: Paste a single command without pipes, redirects, or substitutions. Murage runs it directly, not through a shell.

zh:mcp.paste.fail.unterminated-quote.text: 这条命令中有一个没有闭合的引号。
zh:mcp.paste.fail.unterminated-quote.en: That command has a quote that is never closed.

zh:mcp.paste.fail.unrecognized.text: Murage 无法判断这是什么。请粘贴链接、命令或一小段设置文本。
zh:mcp.paste.fail.unrecognized.en: Murage could not tell what that is. Paste a link, a command, or a short piece of settings text.

zh:mcp.paste.note.ignoredEnv.text: 已忽略 {entry} 的环境变量值：链接没有环境变量。
zh:mcp.paste.note.ignoredEnv.en: Ignored the environment values of {entry}: a link has none.

zh:mcp.paste.note.skippedNothing.text: 已跳过“{entry}”：它没有命令或链接。
zh:mcp.paste.note.skippedNothing.en: Skipped "{entry}": it has no command or link.

zh:mcp.paste.note.skippedBoth.text: 已跳过“{entry}”：它同时有命令和链接。请只粘贴你想要的那一个。
zh:mcp.paste.note.skippedBoth.en: Skipped "{entry}": it has both a command and a link. Paste only the one you meant.

zh:mcp.paste.note.skippedLink.text: 已跳过“{entry}”：它的链接不是 http 或 https 地址。
zh:mcp.paste.note.skippedLink.en: Skipped "{entry}": its link is not an http or https address.

zh:mcp.paste.note.skippedArgs.text: 已跳过“{entry}”：它的参数不是文本列表。
zh:mcp.paste.note.skippedArgs.en: Skipped "{entry}": its arguments are not a list of text.

zh:browserExt.site.body.text: 在本次任务中，{bot} 可以在 {site} 上阅读和滚动页面。在那里输入或点击之前，它会先询问你。
zh:browserExt.site.body.en: {bot} can read and scroll on {site} for this task. It will ask before typing or clicking there.

zh:browserExt.ask.body.text: {site} 看起来是银行、支付、医疗或政府网站。{bot} 可以阅读它，但在那里每次点击或输入前都会先询问你。
zh:browserExt.ask.body.en: {site} looks like a bank, payment, health or government site. {bot} can read it, and will ask you before it clicks or types there.

zh:browserExt.l2.title.text: {bot} 想在 {site} 上点击和输入
zh:browserExt.l2.title.en: {bot} wants to click and type on {site}

zh:browserExt.l2.body.text: 在本次任务的剩余时间里，{bot} 可以在 {site} 上点击和输入，无需再次询问。发送、提交、购买、删除和发布每次仍需你确认。
zh:browserExt.l2.body.en: For the rest of this task, {bot} can click and type on {site} without asking again. Sending, submitting, buying, deleting and posting still need your OK each time.

zh:browserExt.l3.send.body.text: {bot} 想在 {site} 上向 {recipients} 发送消息。
zh:browserExt.l3.send.body.en: {bot} wants to send a message on {site} to {recipients}.

zh:browserExt.l3.newRecipient.body.text: {bot} 想在 {site} 上发送给 {recipients}。收件人不在你的请求里。
zh:browserExt.l3.newRecipient.body.en: {bot} wants to send to {recipients} on {site}. They are not in your request.

zh:browserExt.l3.delete.body.text: {bot} 想删除 {site} 上的 {thing}。此操作可能无法撤销。
zh:browserExt.l3.delete.body.en: {bot} wants to delete {thing} on {site}. You may not be able to undo this.

zh:browserExt.l3.order.body.text: {bot} 想在 {site} 上执行：{action}。最后的支付按钮由你自己点击。
zh:browserExt.l3.order.body.en: {bot} wants to {action} on {site}. You will press the final pay button yourself.

zh:browserExt.l3.download.body.text: 来自 {site}。文件将保存到 {bot} 的文件中。
zh:browserExt.l3.download.body.en: From {site}. It will be saved in {bot}'s files.

zh:browserExt.l3.upload.body.text: 请选择 {bot} 要上传的文件。

zh:browserExt.l3.leave.body.text: 在 {site} 上输入的文字可能会丢失。
zh:browserExt.l3.leave.body.en: Text typed on {site} may be lost.

zh:browserExt.l3.link.body.text: 这个指向 {site} 的链接带有你任务中的信息。
zh:browserExt.l3.link.body.en: This link to {site} carries information from your task.

zh:browserExt.intent.i1.text: 这个网站不在你的请求范围内。
zh:browserExt.intent.i1.en: This site was not part of your request.

zh:browserExt.intent.i2.text: 你的请求中没有的新收件人：{recipient}。
zh:browserExt.intent.i2.en: New recipient not in your request: {recipient}.

zh:browserExt.intent.i3.text: 此页面上有看起来像是给 Murage 的指令的文字。
zh:browserExt.intent.i3.en: This page has text that looks like instructions to Murage.

zh:browserExt.intent.i5.text: 这会把 {siteA} 上的文字发送到 {siteB}。

zh:browserExt.intent.mismatch.text: 这可能与你的请求不符。
zh:browserExt.intent.mismatch.en: This may not match your request.

zh:browserExt.footer.l2.text: 你可以在 Murage for Chrome 中查看并撤销。
zh:browserExt.footer.l2.en: You can see and revoke this in Murage for Chrome.

zh:browserExt.footer.l3.en: Allow applies to this step only.

zh:browserExt.footer.everyTime.text: 对此，无论哪种模式，Murage 每次都会询问你。
zh:browserExt.footer.everyTime.en: Murage asks every time for this, in every mode.

zh:browserExt.footer.waiting.text: 正在等你。在你回应之前，{bot} 不会执行任何操作。
zh:browserExt.footer.waiting.en: Waiting for you. {bot} will not act until you answer.

zh:browserExt.footer.expired.text: 此请求已过期，未执行任何操作。
zh:browserExt.footer.expired.en: This request expired. Nothing was done.

zh:browserExt.yourTurn.consent.text: {bot} 停在了只有你能完成的一步：同意 {site} 的条款、政策或 Cookie。如果你愿意，请自己在 Murage 标签页中完成，然后点击“继续”。
zh:browserExt.yourTurn.consent.en: {bot} stopped at a step only you can do: agreeing to {site}'s terms, policies or cookies. Do it yourself in the Murage tab if you want to, then press Continue.

zh:browserExt.yourTurn.verification.text: {site} 想确认操作者是真人。请自己在 Murage 标签页中完成验证，然后点击“继续”。
zh:browserExt.yourTurn.verification.en: {site} wants to check that a person is there. Complete the check yourself in the Murage tab, then press Continue.

zh:browserExt.yourTurn.credentials.text: {site} 需要你的密码、验证码或个人信息。请自己在 Murage 标签页中输入，然后点击“继续”。你输入时，{bot} 看不到该标签页。
zh:browserExt.yourTurn.credentials.en: {site} needs your password, a code or personal details. Enter them yourself in the Murage tab, then press Continue. {bot} cannot see the tab while you do.

zh:browserExt.yourTurn.payment.text: {bot} 已到达 {site} 上订单的最后一步。请检查订单，如果你愿意，请自己付款，然后点击“继续”。
zh:browserExt.yourTurn.payment.en: {bot} reached the last step of the order on {site}. Check it and pay yourself if you want to, then press Continue.

zh:browserExt.yourTurn.account.text: {bot} 在 {site} 停在了账户或安全设置的更改前：密码、登录方式、恢复选项、权限、共享设置或关闭账户。请自己在 Murage 标签页中完成，然后点击“继续”。
zh:browserExt.yourTurn.account.en: {bot} stopped at an account or security change on {site}: a password, sign-in method, recovery option, permission, sharing setting or closing the account. Do it yourself in the Murage tab, then press Continue.

zh:browserExt.yourTurn.siteNotSet.text: {bot} 在使用 {site} 之前暂停了。Murage for Chrome 没有确认这个新网站，所以这一步没有执行。点击“继续”再试一次，或点击“停止任务”结束它。
zh:browserExt.yourTurn.siteNotSet.en: {bot} paused before using {site}. Murage for Chrome did not confirm the new site, so the step did not run. Press Continue to try again, or Stop task to end it.

zh:browserExt.yourTurn.generic.text: {bot} 在 {site} 停在了需要你的一步。如果你愿意，请自己在 Murage 标签页中完成，然后点击“继续”。
zh:browserExt.yourTurn.generic.en: {bot} stopped at a step that needs you on {site}. Do it yourself in the Murage tab if you want to, then press Continue.

zh:botAccess.preset.none.en: No {app} tools of this kind are available yet

zh:botAccess.preset.writesNote.text: 会做出更改的工具仍需要打开机器人的更改开关
zh:botAccess.preset.writesNote.en: Tools that make changes still need the bot's changes switch turned on

zh:browserExt.yourTurn.chatReminder.text: 请在 Murage for Chrome 中点击“继续”，{bot} 才能接着做。
zh:browserExt.yourTurn.chatReminder.en: Press Continue in Murage for Chrome so {bot} can carry on.

zh:browserExt.updateToResume.text: 请更新 Murage for Chrome 以继续此任务。
zh:browserExt.updateToResume.en: Update Murage for Chrome to resume this task.

zh:browserExt.state.connectionLost.text: 因为 Chrome 或 Murage 已关闭，任务已暂停。请检查页面，然后在 Murage 侧边栏中按继续。
zh:browserExt.state.connectionLost.en: Paused because Chrome or Murage closed. Check the page, then press Resume in the Murage side panel.

zh:browserExt.yourTurn.phone.text: 在 {site} 上轮到你了。请在电脑上继续。
zh:browserExt.yourTurn.phone.en: Your turn on {site}. Continue on your computer.

zh:browserExt.refuse.hiddenControl.text: 机器人试图使用一个隐藏的控件，未执行任何操作。
zh:browserExt.refuse.hiddenControl.en: The bot tried to use a hidden control. Nothing was done.

zh:browserExt.refuse.repeatedAsks.text: Murage 已暂停此任务。该页面一再要求执行你没有要求的操作。未执行其他任何操作。
zh:browserExt.refuse.repeatedAsks.en: Murage paused this task. The page kept asking for things you did not ask for. Nothing else was done.

zh:browserExt.refuse.neverSite.text: {bot} 不被允许使用 {site}。你可以在浏览器设置中更改。
zh:browserExt.refuse.neverSite.en: {bot} is not allowed on {site}. You can change this in Browser settings.

zh:browserExt.refuse.handoverSite.text: {site} 是你自己使用的网站。Murage 不会为机器人打开它。
zh:browserExt.refuse.handoverSite.en: {site} is a site you use yourself. Murage does not open it for bots.

zh:browserExt.refuse.neverCategory.text: Murage 不会为机器人打开这类网站。你可以在浏览器设置中更改。
zh:browserExt.refuse.neverCategory.en: Murage does not open this kind of site for bots. You can change this in Browser settings.

zh:browserExt.refuse.routineSkip.text: {site} 不允许用于例行任务。要在例行任务中使用，请在浏览器设置中将其设为始终允许。
zh:browserExt.refuse.routineSkip.en: {site} is not allowed for routines. Allow it always in Browser settings to use it in routines.

zh:browserExt.refuse.routineWaiting.text: 有一个例行任务正在 {site} 上等待你的确认。
zh:browserExt.refuse.routineWaiting.en: A routine is waiting for your OK on {site}.

zh:browserExt.refuse.busyProfile.text: 另一个机器人正在使用此浏览器。请稍后再试。
zh:browserExt.refuse.busyProfile.en: Another bot is using this browser. Try again shortly.

zh:browserExt.refuse.browserRestarted.text: 上一步执行期间浏览器重新启动了。请检查页面，然后继续。
zh:browserExt.refuse.browserRestarted.en: The browser restarted during the last step. Check the page, then resume.

zh:browserExt.refuse.dialogOpen.text: 页面上有一个对话框处于打开状态。请先处理它，再做其他操作。
zh:browserExt.refuse.dialogOpen.en: A dialog is open on the page. Answer it before anything else.

zh:browserExt.refuse.clipboard.text: 所有者的浏览器中无法使用复制和粘贴。
zh:browserExt.refuse.clipboard.en: Copying and pasting are not available in the owner's browser.

zh:browserExt.mode.label.text: {bot} 在你的浏览器中如何询问

zh:browserExt.mode.step.desc.text: {bot} 在每次点击、输入或其他更改之前都会先询问。
zh:browserExt.mode.step.desc.en: {bot} asks before it clicks, types or makes any other change.

zh:browserExt.mode.task.desc.text: {bot} 在点击和输入之前，每个任务中每个网站询问一次；在发送、提交、购买、删除或发布之前，每次都会询问。
zh:browserExt.mode.task.desc.en: {bot} asks once per site per task before clicking and typing, and every time before sending, submitting, buying, deleting or posting.

zh:browserExt.mode.full.desc.text: {bot} 会不经询问直接点击、输入、发送和提交。危险区域。
zh:browserExt.mode.full.desc.en: {bot} clicks, types, sends and submits without asking. Danger zone.

zh:browserExt.mode.floorNote.text: 无论你如何选择，{bot} 都不会同意条款或 Cookie，不会回答真人验证，不会输入密码、验证码、银行卡或证件信息，也不会点击最后的支付按钮。它会停下来，把这些步骤交给你。
zh:browserExt.mode.floorNote.en: Whatever you choose, {bot} never agrees to terms or cookies, never answers a human check, never enters passwords, codes, card or ID details, and never presses the final pay button. It stops and hands those to you.

zh:browserExt.full.body1.text: {bot} 会在你的浏览器中发送消息、提交表单、发布和删除内容，而不会先询问你。
zh:browserExt.full.body1.en: {bot} will send messages, submit forms, post and delete in your browser without asking you first.

zh:browserExt.full.body2.text: 网页可能包含隐藏的指令。Murage 会对照你的请求检查每一步，但没有任何检查能发现所有问题。网页诱使 {bot} 做出的操作可能无法撤销。
zh:browserExt.full.body2.en: A web page can contain hidden instructions. Murage checks each step against your request, but no check catches everything. You may not be able to undo something a page tricks {bot} into doing.

zh:browserExt.full.body3.text: 仅在你信任的网站和任务上使用，并把你不希望出错的网站保持为“永不”。
zh:browserExt.full.body3.en: Use it only on sites and tasks you trust, and keep sites you would not want a mistake on set to Never.

zh:browserExt.full.body4.text: {bot} 仍会在条款、真人验证、密码、验证码、银行卡和证件信息以及最后的支付按钮处停下。
zh:browserExt.full.body4.en: {bot} will still stop for terms, human checks, passwords, codes, card and ID details, and the final pay button.

zh:browserExt.lower.title.text: 让 {bot} 在 {site} 上正常工作？

zh:browserExt.lower.body.text: {site} 看起来像银行、支付、医疗或政府网站，因此被设为每一步都先询问。
