zh:browserExt.lower.body.en: {site} is set to ask before every step because it looks like a bank, payment, health or government site.

zh:browserExt.listsNote.text: 这些列表无法涵盖所有网站。你可以把任何网站设为“永不”或每一步都询问。
zh:browserExt.listsNote.en: These lists cannot cover every site. Set any site to Never or to ask each step.

zh:browserExt.endOfTask.title.text: {bot} 在此任务中使用了 {site}。始终允许吗？
zh:browserExt.endOfTask.title.en: {bot} used {site} in this task. Allow it always?

zh:browserExt.preview.note.text: Murage for Chrome 目前为预览版。每次更改前它都会先询问。更多控制选项即将推出。
zh:browserExt.preview.note.en: Murage for Chrome is in preview. It asks before each change. More controls are coming.

zh:browserExt.checker.blocked.text: 此步骤与你的请求不符，Murage 已将其暂停。请查看后选择“继续”或“停止”。
zh:browserExt.checker.blocked.en: Murage paused this step because it does not match what you asked for. Review it and choose Continue or Stop.

zh:browserExt.checker.unavailable.text: Murage 无法运行操作检查，因此在此步骤之前停了下来。未更改任何内容。你可以重试，或自己批准此步骤后继续。
zh:browserExt.checker.unavailable.en: Murage could not run its action check, so it stopped before this step. Nothing was changed. Try again, or continue by approving this step yourself.

zh:browserExt.checker.settingsLine.text: 操作检查：在会更改内容的步骤之前，Murage 会将该步骤与你的请求进行比对。页面的简短片段可能会发送给负责检查的模型。
zh:browserExt.checker.settingsLine.en: Action check: before steps that change something, Murage compares the step with your request. Short excerpts of the page may be sent to the checking model.

zh:browserExt.checker.askEachStepUntil.text: 在操作检查可用之前，每一步都询问。
zh:browserExt.checker.askEachStepUntil.en: Ask each step until the action check is available.

zh:browserExt.full.errorDesktopOnly.text: 完全访问只能在你电脑上的 Murage 应用中开启。
zh:browserExt.full.errorDesktopOnly.en: Full access can only be turned on in the Murage app on your computer.

zh:browserExt.mode.errorLoosenDesktopOnl.text: 降低询问频率只能在你电脑上的 Murage 应用中设置。在这里你只能提高询问频率。
zh:browserExt.mode.errorLoosenDesktopOnl.en: Asking less often can only be set in the Murage app on your computer. From here you can only ask more often.

zh:browserExt.full.errorConfirmName.text: 请准确输入机器人的名字以开启完全访问。
zh:browserExt.full.errorConfirmName.en: Type the bot's name exactly to turn on Full access.

zh:browserExt.sites.errorProfile.text: 请说明是哪个浏览器配置文件。

zh:browserExt.sites.errorNeedsDesktop.text: 这需要你电脑上的 Murage 应用。
zh:browserExt.sites.errorNeedsDesktop.en: This needs the Murage app on your computer.

zh:browserExt.sites.errorAllowLimit.text: 此任务已有 64 个始终允许的网站。请移除一个，然后重试。
zh:browserExt.sites.errorAllowLimit.en: This task already has 64 sites allowed always. Remove one, then try again.

zh:browserExt.owner.errorContinueDesktop.text: 继续需要你电脑上的 Murage 应用。
zh:browserExt.owner.errorContinueDesktop.en: Continue needs the Murage app on your computer.

zh:browserExt.owner.errorNotWaiting.en: This step is not waiting for you.

zh:browserExt.owner.errorUseContinue.text: 完成这一步后，请点击“继续”。
zh:browserExt.owner.errorUseContinue.en: Press Continue once you have done the step.

zh:browserExt.owner.errorContinuePanel.text: 请在 Murage for Chrome 的侧边栏中点击“继续”。
zh:browserExt.owner.errorContinuePanel.en: Press Continue in the Murage for Chrome side panel.

zh:browserExt.sites.errorNewer.text: 已批准的网站列表由更新版本的 Murage 保存，因此此版本不会改动它。请更新 Murage 后使用。
zh:browserExt.sites.errorNewer.en: The approved sites list was saved by a newer version of Murage, so this version leaves it alone. Update Murage to use it.

zh:browserExt.sites.errorUnreadable.text: Murage 无法读取已批准的网站列表，因此没有使用它。未更改任何内容。
zh:browserExt.sites.errorUnreadable.en: Murage could not read the approved sites list, so it did not use it. Nothing was changed.

zh:browserExt.sites.errorAddress.text: 这不是 Murage 能记住的网址。
zh:browserExt.sites.errorAddress.en: That is not a web address Murage can remember.

zh:browserExt.sites.errorScheme.text: 只能批准 http 和 https 网站。
zh:browserExt.sites.errorScheme.en: Only http and https sites can be approved.

zh:browserExt.sites.errorProfileId.text: 该浏览器配置文件无效。
zh:browserExt.sites.errorProfileId.en: That browser profile is not valid.

zh:browserExt.sites.errorRule.text: Murage 不认识这个网站设置。
zh:browserExt.sites.errorRule.en: That is not a site setting Murage knows.

zh:browserExt.sites.errorLowered.text: 只有设为询问的网站才能降低其权限级别。
zh:browserExt.sites.errorLowered.en: Only a site set to Ask can have its permission level lowered.

zh:browserExt.sites.errorTooMany.text: 网站数量超过了 Murage 为一个浏览器保存的上限。请先删除一些。
zh:browserExt.sites.errorTooMany.en: That is more sites than Murage keeps for one browser. Remove some first.

zh:browserExt.sites.errorOldRecord.text: Murage 无法读取旧的浏览器连接记录，因此没有迁移任何内容。未更改任何内容。
zh:browserExt.sites.errorOldRecord.en: Murage could not read the old browser connection record, so nothing was moved. Nothing was changed.

zh:browserExt.sites.errorOldRecordNewer.text: 浏览器连接记录由更新版本的 Murage 保存，因此此版本不会改动它。请更新 Murage 后使用。
zh:browserExt.sites.errorOldRecordNewer.en: The browser connection record was saved by a newer version of Murage, so this version leaves it alone. Update Murage to use it.

zh:browserExt.checker.reasonUnavailable.text: 操作检查无法运行，因此此步骤没有执行。
zh:browserExt.checker.reasonUnavailable.en: The action check could not run, so this step did not happen.

zh:browserExt.checker.reasonPlan.text: 你的 Flux 套餐不包含操作检查，因此 Murage 会在每一步之前询问你。
zh:browserExt.checker.reasonPlan.en: Your Flux plan does not include the action check, so Murage will ask you before each step.

zh:browserExt.checker.reasonKeyNotPermit.text: 此 Flux 密钥无法使用操作检查的模型，因此 Murage 会在每一步之前询问你。
zh:browserExt.checker.reasonKeyNotPermit.en: This Flux key cannot use the action check model, so Murage will ask you before each step.

zh:browserExt.setup.step1.body.text: 从 Chrome 网上应用店把 Murage for Chrome 添加到你的浏览器。大约需要一分钟。
zh:browserExt.setup.step1.body.en: Add Murage for Chrome to your browser from the Chrome Web Store. It takes about a minute.

zh:browserExt.setup.step1.store.text: 打开 Chrome 网上应用店

zh:browserExt.setup.step2.body.text: 点按“连接我的浏览器”。然后点击浏览器顶部的 Murage for Chrome 图标。{bot} 会自动连接。
zh:browserExt.setup.step2.body.en: Press Connect my browser. Then click the Murage for Chrome icon at the top of your browser. {bot} connects by itself.

zh:browserExt.setup.step2.waiting.text: 现在点击浏览器顶部的 Murage for Chrome 图标。{bot} 会自动连接。
zh:browserExt.setup.step2.waiting.en: Now click the Murage for Chrome icon at the top of your browser. {bot} connects by itself.

zh:browserExt.setup.step2.otherBrowser.text: 在用 Edge 或 Brave？在这里选择
zh:browserExt.setup.step2.otherBrowser.en: Using Edge or Brave? Choose it here

zh:browserExt.setup.step3.body.text: 点按一个选项即可使用。之后可以更改。
zh:browserExt.setup.step3.body.en: Tap a choice to use it. You can change it later.

zh:browserExt.setup.step3.loading.text: 正在检查 {bot} 的询问方式…

zh:browserExt.setup.step3.failed.text: Murage 无法读取 {bot} 的询问方式。请检查连接后重试。
zh:browserExt.setup.step3.failed.en: Murage could not read how {bot} asks. Check the connection and try again.

zh:newConversation.stalled.text: 新对话启动时间过长。请重试。
zh:newConversation.stalled.en: The new conversation is taking too long to start. Try again.

zh:browserExt.setup.summary.step.text: 已连接。{bot} 每一步都会询问。

zh:browserExt.setup.summary.task.text: 已连接。{bot} 每个任务询问一次。

zh:browserExt.setup.summary.full.text: 已连接。{bot} 拥有完全访问权限。危险区域。
zh:browserExt.setup.summary.full.en: Connected. {bot} has Full access. Danger zone.

zh:browserExt.activity.empty.text: 暂无内容。{bot} 在你的浏览器中的每一步都会显示在这里。
zh:browserExt.activity.empty.en: Nothing yet. Each step {bot} takes in your browser appears here.

zh:browserExt.sites.empty.text: 暂无网站。{bot} 使用的网站会显示在这里。
zh:browserExt.sites.empty.en: No sites yet. Sites {bot} uses appear here.

zh:browserExt.checker.reasonNoFlux.text: 连接 Flux 后才能使用操作检查。在此之前，Murage 会在每一步前询问你。
zh:browserExt.checker.reasonNoFlux.en: Connect Flux to use the action check. Until then Murage asks you before each step.

zh:browserExt.checker.reasonNoRetain.text: 操作检查暂不可用，因此 Murage 会在每一步前询问你。
zh:browserExt.checker.reasonNoRetain.en: The action check is not available yet, so Murage asks you before each step.

zh:browserExt.checker.fallbackBot.text: Murage 的检查服务尚未上线，因此由 {bot} 自己的引擎检查每一步。
zh:browserExt.checker.fallbackBot.en: Murage's check service is not live yet, so {bot}'s own engine checks each step.

zh:browserExt.checker.reasonNoBotEngine.text: 你的机器人自己的引擎暂时无法用于操作检查，因此 Murage 会在每一步之前询问你。
zh:browserExt.checker.reasonNoBotEngine.en: Your bot's own engine is not available for the action check, so Murage asks you before each step.

zh:browserExt.never.body.text: {site} 在“从不”名单中，因此 {bot} 无法打开它。解除后，{bot} 可以再次在该网站工作。只有在你信任该网站时才这样做。
zh:browserExt.never.body.en: {site} is on the Never list, so {bot} cannot open it. Lifting it lets {bot} work there again. Only do this if you trust the site.

zh:browserExt.sites.loweredNote.text: 有一次保存没有完成，所以 Murage 已把你设为“始终允许”的网站改回“询问”。请对你信任的网站重新选择“始终允许”。
zh:browserExt.sites.loweredNote.en: A save did not finish, so Murage set your Always allow sites back to Ask. Choose Always allow again for the ones you trust.

zh:approval.changesLineEvery.text: 更改 {n} 行，所有匹配项

zh:approval.changesLinesEvery.text: 更改 {n} 行，所有匹配项

zh:approval.contentSize.text: 内容：{chars} 个字符，{lines} 行

zh:canTalk.hint.text: {name}可以主动与哪些机器人开始对话。回复始终返回给提问的一方。
zh:canTalk.hint.en: Which bots {name} can start a conversation with. Replies always go back to whoever asked.

zh:canTalk.everyoneHint.text: {name}可以主动与所有机器人开始对话。
zh:canTalk.everyoneHint.en: {name} can start a conversation with every bot.

zh:canTalk.directionHint.text: 单向：对方机器人只回答被问到的内容。双向：对方也可以主动发起对话。
zh:canTalk.directionHint.en: One-way: the other bot only answers what is asked. Two-way: it can also start conversations.

zh:canTalk.desktopOnly.text: 请在电脑上的 Murage 应用中更改此设置。
zh:canTalk.desktopOnly.en: Change this in the Murage app on your computer.

zh:canTalk.fixedTeam.text: 已是双向：团队或角色已允许互相联系。
zh:canTalk.fixedTeam.en: Already two-way: your team or role already lets them reach each other.

zh:canTalk.fixedTheirs.text: 已是双向：{other}在自己的设置中允许联系。
zh:canTalk.fixedTheirs.en: Already two-way: {other} allows contact in its own settings.

zh:phoneNotifications.on.text: 已开启。审批请求、问题和已完成的工作会发送到此手机。
zh:phoneNotifications.on.en: On. Approvals, questions and finished work reach this phone.

zh:phoneNotifications.denied.text: 请在手机设置中开启 Murage 通知。
zh:phoneNotifications.denied.en: Turn on notifications for Murage in your phone settings.

zh:phoneNotifications.hostOff.text: 在此电脑上开启通知，即可在这里接收。
zh:phoneNotifications.hostOff.en: Turn on notifications on this computer to receive them here.

zh:phoneNotifications.unsupported.text: 在此手机上打开 Murage 查看最新动态。
zh:phoneNotifications.unsupported.en: Open Murage on this phone to see your updates.

zh:phoneNotifications.retry.text: 请稍后再次尝试开启通知。
zh:phoneNotifications.retry.en: Try turning on notifications again in a moment.

zh:phoneNotifications.previewLabel.text: 在此手机的锁定屏幕上显示私人详情
zh:phoneNotifications.previewLabel.en: Show private details on this phone’s lock screen

zh:phoneNotifications.previewHelp.text: 默认关闭。通知使用通用文字。开启后，此手机的锁定屏幕将显示消息正文和审批详情。
zh:phoneNotifications.previewHelp.en: Off by default. Notifications use generic text. Turn on to show message text and approval details on this phone’s lock screen.

zh:phoneNotifications.previewRetry.text: 请再次尝试保存锁定屏幕偏好设置。
zh:phoneNotifications.previewRetry.en: Try saving your lock screen preference again.

zh:importGuard.askNote.text: 无论文件里写了什么，导入的机器人都从询问级别开始。之后你可以在机器人的设置里提高它的权限。例行任务会以暂停状态和询问级别到达。
zh:importGuard.askNote.en: Imported bots start at Ask, whatever the file says. You can raise a bot's access later in its settings. Routines arrive paused and at Ask.

zh:importGuard.blockedNote.text: 导入已拦截。请从包中删除标记的文本，然后重试。
zh:importGuard.blockedNote.en: Import blocked. Remove the flagged text from the package before trying again.

zh:importGuard.reviewNote.text: 请阅读下面的文本。确认没问题后，勾选方框即可导入。
zh:importGuard.reviewNote.en: Read the text below. If you are happy with it, tick the box to import.

zh:importGuard.acknowledge.text: 我已查看这些警告，并要导入此选择。
zh:importGuard.acknowledge.en: I reviewed the warnings and want to import this selection.

zh:importGuard.scanNote.text: 这项检查会查找已知的模式。它只是多一双眼睛，并非保证，所以请先读一读你要导入的内容。
zh:importGuard.scanNote.en: The check looks for known patterns. It is one more pair of eyes, not a promise, so read what you import.

zh:importGuard.progress.text: 正在检查第 {done} 个文件，共 {total} 个…

zh:importGuard.tooLarge.text: 此包太大，无法检查，因此未导入。
zh:importGuard.tooLarge.en: This package is too large to check, so it was not imported.

zh:importGuard.unavailable.text: 检查未能完成，因此没有导入任何内容。请重试。
zh:importGuard.unavailable.en: The check could not finish, so nothing was imported. Please try again.

zh:importGuard.cat.credential-mention.text: 读取保存密码的设置文件
zh:importGuard.cat.credential-mention.en: Reads the settings file where passwords are kept

zh:importGuard.cat.credential-literal.text: 包含看起来像密码或密钥的内容
zh:importGuard.cat.credential-literal.en: Contains what looks like a password or key

zh:importGuard.cat.network-exfiltration.en: Sends data to an outside website

zh:importGuard.cat.shell-execution.text: 在电脑上运行有风险的命令
zh:importGuard.cat.shell-execution.en: Runs risky commands on the computer

zh:importGuard.cat.filesystem-write.text: 更改自己文件夹之外的文件
zh:importGuard.cat.filesystem-write.en: Changes files outside its own folder

zh:importGuard.cat.instruction-override.text: 让机器人忽略它的指令
zh:importGuard.cat.instruction-override.en: Tells the bot to ignore its instructions

zh:importGuard.cat.obfuscation.text: 把内容藏在编码文本里

zh:importGuard.cat.index-poisoning.text: 它的搜索词与它的实际功能不符
zh:importGuard.cat.index-poisoning.en: Its search words don't match what it does

zh:importGuard.cat.direction-override.text: 包含会打乱文本顺序以隐藏内容的字符
zh:importGuard.cat.direction-override.en: Contains characters that reorder text to hide it

zh:importGuard.cat.padding.text: 把文本藏在页面很靠下的位置
zh:importGuard.cat.padding.en: Hides text far down the page

zh:importGuard.cat.prompt-injection.text: 试图接管机器人的指令
zh:importGuard.cat.prompt-injection.en: Tries to take over the bot's instructions

zh:importGuard.cat.data-exfiltration.en: Sends data to an outside website

zh:importGuard.cat.privilege-escalation.text: 试图获得超出所需的权限
zh:importGuard.cat.privilege-escalation.en: Tries to get more access than it needs

zh:importGuard.cat.output-handling.text: 以有风险的方式传递其输出
zh:importGuard.cat.output-handling.en: Passes its output on in a risky way

zh:importGuard.cat.system-prompt-leakage.text: 试图泄露机器人的私有指令
zh:importGuard.cat.system-prompt-leakage.en: Tries to reveal the bot's private instructions

zh:importGuard.cat.tool-misuse.text: 以有风险的方式使用工具

zh:importGuard.cat.rogue-agent.text: 试图做超出自己职责的事
zh:importGuard.cat.rogue-agent.en: Tries to act beyond its job

zh:importGuard.cat.agent-snooping.text: 窥探其他机器人或应用的数据
zh:importGuard.cat.agent-snooping.en: Looks into other bots' or apps' data

zh:importGuard.cat.anti-refusal.text: 向机器人施压，让它不要拒绝
zh:importGuard.cat.anti-refusal.en: Pressures the bot not to say no

zh:importGuard.cat.insecure-deserializat.text: 以有风险的方式加载数据
zh:importGuard.cat.insecure-deserializat.en: Loads data in a risky way

zh:importGuard.cat.obfuscated.text: 把指令藏在伪装的文本后面

zh:importGuard.cat.encoded-payload.text: 包含可解码为指令的编码文本
zh:importGuard.cat.encoded-payload.en: Contains encoded text that decodes to instructions

zh:importGuard.cat.tag-characters.text: 包含可携带隐藏信息的不可见字符
zh:importGuard.cat.tag-characters.en: Contains invisible characters that can carry a hidden message

zh:importGuard.cat.homoglyph.text: 在单词中使用其他字母表里的相似字母
zh:importGuard.cat.homoglyph.en: Uses look-alike letters from another alphabet inside words

zh:freshAuth.changed.text: 此请求已更改。允许之前请再查看一遍。
zh:freshAuth.changed.en: This request changed. Review it again before you allow it.

zh:freshAuth.failed.text: Murage 无法确认是你本人。请重试。
zh:freshAuth.failed.en: Murage couldn't confirm it was you. Try again.

zh:freshAuth.noLock.text: 这部手机没有设置密码,因此无法批准高风险操作。请在电脑上批准这一项。
zh:freshAuth.noLock.en: This phone has no passcode, so it can't approve high-risk actions. Approve this one on your computer.

zh:freshAuth.noKey.text: 请在电脑上批准。要在这部手机上批准高风险操作,请先开启密码,然后重新配对。
zh:freshAuth.noKey.en: Approve this on your computer. To approve high-risk actions from this phone, turn on a passcode, then pair it again.

zh:freshAuth.update.text: 请更新 Murage 应用以便在手机上批准,或在电脑上批准。
zh:freshAuth.update.en: Update the Murage app to approve this from your phone, or approve it on your computer.

zh:freshAuth.pairAgain.text: 请重新配对这部手机,以便在这里批准。
zh:freshAuth.pairAgain.en: Pair this phone again to approve this here.

zh:freshAuth.computerOnly.text: 请在电脑或 Murage 应用中批准。
zh:freshAuth.computerOnly.en: Approve this on your computer or in the Murage app.

zh:freshAuth.answerOnComputer.text: 请在电脑上回答这一项。
zh:freshAuth.answerOnComputer.en: Answer this one on your computer.

zh:freshAuth.spoken.cancelled.text: 好的，我先放着。准备好了就说“是”，要拒绝就说“不”。
zh:freshAuth.spoken.cancelled.en: Okay, I'll leave that waiting. Say yes when you're ready, or no to deny it.

zh:freshAuth.spoken.changed.text: 这个请求有变化。请在屏幕上查看，然后再说一次“是”，或者说“不”来拒绝。
zh:freshAuth.spoken.changed.en: That request changed. Look at it on screen, then say yes again, or no to deny it.

zh:freshAuth.spoken.failed.text: 我无法确认是你本人。说“是”再试一次，或说“不”来拒绝。
zh:freshAuth.spoken.failed.en: I couldn't confirm it was you. Say yes to try again, or no to deny it.

zh:freshAuth.spoken.noLock.text: 这部手机没有设置锁屏密码，无法批准高风险操作。请在电脑上批准，或说“不”来拒绝。
zh:freshAuth.spoken.noLock.en: This phone has no passcode, so it can't approve high-risk actions. Approve this one on your computer, or say no to deny it.

zh:freshAuth.spoken.noKey.text: 要在这部手机上批准高风险操作，请先开启锁屏密码，然后重新配对。现在请在电脑上批准，或说“不”来拒绝。
zh:freshAuth.spoken.noKey.en: To approve high-risk actions from this phone, turn on a passcode, then pair it again. For now, approve this one on your computer, or say no to deny it.

zh:freshAuth.spoken.update.text: 请更新 Murage 应用以便在手机上批准，或在电脑上批准。你也可以说“不”来拒绝。
zh:freshAuth.spoken.update.en: Update the Murage app to approve this from your phone, or approve it on your computer. You can say no to deny it.

zh:freshAuth.spoken.pairAgain.text: 请重新配对这部手机以便在这里批准，或在电脑上批准。你也可以说“不”来拒绝。
zh:freshAuth.spoken.pairAgain.en: Pair this phone again to approve this here, or approve it on your computer. You can say no to deny it.

zh:freshAuth.spoken.computerOnly.text: 请在电脑上或 Murage 应用中批准。你也可以说“不”来拒绝。
zh:freshAuth.spoken.computerOnly.en: Approve this on your computer or in the Murage app. You can say no to deny it.

zh:freshAuth.spoken.answerOnComputer.text: 请在电脑上回答这一项,或者说“不”来拒绝。
zh:freshAuth.spoken.answerOnComputer.en: Answer this one on your computer, or say no to deny it.

zh:freshAuth.gone.text: 这个请求已不在等待中。
zh:freshAuth.gone.en: That request is no longer waiting.

zh:freshAuth.spoken.gone.text: 这个请求已不在等待中。请在电脑上查看发生了什么。
zh:freshAuth.spoken.gone.en: That request is no longer waiting. Check your computer to see what happened.

zh:approval.confirmOnPhone.text: 正在等待手机确认是你本人。
zh:approval.confirmOnPhone.en: Waiting for your phone to confirm it's you.

zh:publish.title.update.text: 更新你已上线的网站吗?

zh:publish.public.text: 任何拿到链接的人都可以看到。
zh:publish.public.en: Anyone with the link can see this.

zh:publish.takeDown.body.text: 这会让所有人都无法访问 {url}。你的文件仍保留在这里。
zh:publish.takeDown.body.en: This removes {url} for everyone. Your files stay here.

zh:publish.takeDown.version.text: 这会删除 {url} 的一个已保存版本。你的文件仍保留在这里。
zh:publish.takeDown.version.en: This removes one saved version of {url}. Your files stay here.

zh:publish.phone.body.text: 发布网站需要在运行 Murage 的电脑上批准。
zh:publish.phone.body.en: Putting a site online is approved on the computer running Murage.

zh:publish.progress.takenDown.text: 已下线。你的文件仍保留在这里。
zh:publish.progress.takenDown.en: Taken down. Your files stay here.

zh:publish.settled.declined.text: 暂时不要。没有任何更改。

zh:publish.settled.unanswered.text: 没有收到回复,所以没有做任何更改。想继续时随时再提。
zh:publish.settled.unanswered.en: No answer, so nothing was changed. Ask again whenever you like.

zh:publish.fail.reconnect.en: Netlify needs you to sign in again.

zh:publish.next.reconnect.text: 请重新连接 Netlify,然后再试一次。

zh:publish.next.wait.text: 请等一分钟,然后再试一次。
zh:publish.next.wait.en: Wait a minute, then try again.

zh:publish.fail.tooBig.text: 这些文件太大,无法发布。
zh:publish.fail.tooBig.en: These files are too big to publish.

zh:publish.next.tooBig.text: 请把最大的文件缩小或移除一些,然后再试一次。
zh:publish.next.tooBig.en: Make the largest files smaller or remove some, then try again.

zh:publish.next.nameTaken.text: 请换一个网站名称,然后再试一次。
zh:publish.next.nameTaken.en: Pick another site name, then try again.

zh:publish.fail.notLive.en: The page did not load when it was checked.

zh:publish.next.notLive.text: 请等一分钟,然后再试一次。
zh:publish.next.notLive.en: Wait a minute, then try again.

zh:publish.next.other.en: Try again when you are ready.

zh:publish.open.blocked.text: 浏览器拦截了新标签页。请允许后再点一次“打开”。
zh:publish.open.blocked.en: Your browser held back the new tab. Allow it, then press Open again.

zh:publish.sites.empty.text: 目前还没有上线的内容。请 {bot} 发布一个网站,它就会显示在这里。
zh:publish.sites.empty.en: Nothing is online yet. Ask {bot} to put a site online and it shows up here.

zh:publish.sites.given.en: Given to this bot by you

zh:publish.sites.confirm.text: 要让所有人都无法访问 {url} 吗?你的文件仍保留在这里。
zh:publish.sites.confirm.en: Take {url} down for everyone? Your files stay here.

zh:publish.sites.phone.text: 下线网站需要在运行 Murage 的电脑上操作。
zh:publish.sites.phone.en: Taking a site down is done on the computer running Murage.

zh:publish.sites.failed.text: 没有成功。请等一分钟再试一次。
zh:publish.sites.failed.en: That did not go through. Wait a minute, then try again.

zh:publish.connect.body.text: 要把你的网站发布上线,Murage 需要连接到你的 Netlify 账户。
zh:publish.connect.body.en: Murage needs to be connected to your Netlify account to put your site online.

zh:publish.connect.allows.text: 这样 Murage 就能为你的机器人创建、更新和下线它发布的网站。每次操作前,它都会在这台电脑上先征求你的同意。
zh:publish.connect.allows.en: This lets Murage create, update and take down the sites it publishes for your bots. It asks you on this computer before each one.

zh:publish.connect.private.text: Netlify 的访问权限覆盖你的整个 Netlify 账户,所以 Murage 会把它私密地保存在这台电脑上,绝不会在聊天中显示。
zh:publish.connect.private.en: Netlify access covers your whole Netlify account, so Murage keeps it private on this computer and never shows it in chat.

zh:publish.connect.signingIn.text: 正在浏览器中打开 Netlify。请在那里批准登录,然后回到这里。
zh:publish.connect.signingIn.en: Opening Netlify in your browser. Approve the sign-in there, then come back here.

zh:publish.connect.checking.text: 正在检查与 Netlify 的连接

zh:publish.connect.useToken.text: 改为粘贴 Netlify 访问密钥
zh:publish.connect.useToken.en: Paste a Netlify access key instead

zh:publish.connect.tokenHow.text: 在 Netlify 中依次打开 User settings、Applications,选择 New access token,然后把它复制到这里。
zh:publish.connect.tokenHow.en: In Netlify, open User settings, then Applications, choose New access token, and copy it here.

zh:publish.connect.tokenLink.text: 打开 Netlify 的访问令牌页面

zh:publish.connect.connected.text: Netlify 已连接。Murage 可以继续了。
zh:publish.connect.connected.en: Netlify is connected. Murage can carry on.

zh:publish.connect.phone.text: 连接 Netlify 需要在运行 Murage 的电脑上完成。
zh:publish.connect.phone.en: Connecting Netlify is done on the computer running Murage.

zh:publish.connect.why.signInNotEnough.text: 你的 Netlify 登录已成功，但 Netlify 要求使用访问密钥才能发布。请在下方粘贴密钥，只需一分钟。
zh:publish.connect.why.signInNotEnough.en: Your Netlify sign-in worked, but Netlify wants an access key for publishing. Paste one below. It takes a minute.

zh:publish.connect.why.tokenRejected.text: Netlify 未接受该密钥。请检查是否已完整复制，然后重试。
zh:publish.connect.why.tokenRejected.en: Netlify did not accept that key. Check that you copied all of it, then try again.

zh:publish.connect.why.tokenShape.text: 这看起来不像 Netlify 访问密钥。请从 Netlify 重新复制并粘贴到此处。
zh:publish.connect.why.tokenShape.en: That does not look like a Netlify access key. Copy it again from Netlify and paste it here.

zh:publish.connect.why.unreachable.text: 我刚才没能连上 Netlify。请一分钟后再试。
zh:publish.connect.why.unreachable.en: I could not reach Netlify just now. Try again in a minute.

zh:publish.connect.why.saveFailed.text: Murage 无法保存该密钥。请重试。
zh:publish.connect.why.saveFailed.en: Murage could not keep that key. Try again.

zh:publish.connect.why.noShell.text: 登录功能仅在 Murage 桌面应用中可用。请改为在此处粘贴访问密钥。
zh:publish.connect.why.noShell.en: Signing in is available in the Murage desktop app. Paste an access key here instead.

zh:publish.sites.add.help.text: 粘贴你的 Netlify 网站地址或名称,{bot} 就能更新它。
zh:publish.sites.add.help.en: Paste your Netlify site's address or name and {bot} can update it.

zh:publish.sites.add.notFound.text: 你的账户里没有这个地址的 Netlify 网站。请检查后再试。
zh:publish.sites.add.notFound.en: Netlify has no site with that address in your account. Check it and try again.

zh:publish.sites.add.badName.text: 请粘贴类似 my-shop.netlify.app 的地址,或只粘贴网站名称。
zh:publish.sites.add.badName.en: Paste an address such as my-shop.netlify.app, or just the site name.

zh:publish.sites.add.reconnect.text: 请先连接 Netlify。让 {bot} 发布一个网站,就会出现“连接 Netlify”卡片。
zh:publish.sites.add.reconnect.en: Connect Netlify first. Ask {bot} to put a site online and a Connect Netlify card appears.

zh:publish.sites.add.failed.text: 没有成功。请等一分钟再试。
zh:publish.sites.add.failed.en: That did not go through. Wait a minute, then try again.

zh:publish.sites.attention.body.text: 这个网站已开始创建,但没有完成上线。点击“下线”来清理它。
zh:publish.sites.attention.body.en: This site was started but did not finish going up. Press Take down to clear it.

zh:learnedChip.praise.3.text: 记下了有效的做法。保留：{text}

zh:learnedChip.win.1.text: 已记为一次成功。{bot} 会保留：{text}
zh:learnedChip.win.1.en: Noted as a win. {bot} will keep: {text}

zh:learnedChip.win.3.text: 一次成功。{bot} 正在保留：{text}

zh:learnedChip.win.4.text: {bot} 会重复这里奏效的做法：{text}

zh:learnedChip.win.6.text: 成功已记录。{bot} 会保留：{text}

zh:learnedChip.chipLabel.text: {bot} 从那条回复中保留了一些内容。详情
zh:learnedChip.chipLabel.en: {bot} kept something from that reply. Details

zh:learnedChip.firstHint.text: 这类经验在“设置 > 学习”中，你可以在那里编辑或撤销。
zh:learnedChip.firstHint.en: Lessons like this live in Settings > Learning, where you can edit or undo them.

zh:learnedChip.undoNote.text: 撤销不会改变已经发出的内容。
zh:learnedChip.undoNote.en: Undo does not change what was already sent.

zh:learnedChip.keptHere.en: {bot} will do this in this conversation.

zh:learnedChip.keptChats.en: {bot} will do this in your chats.

zh:learnedChip.keptCustomers.en: {bot} will do this when it writes to customers.

zh:learnedChip.keptEverywhere.en: {bot} will do this in every conversation.

zh:learnedChip.approvalsNote.text: {bot}的审批遵循你的访问设置。请在访问中更改。
zh:learnedChip.approvalsNote.en: {bot} follows your Access settings for approvals. Change them in Access.

zh:learnedChip.failed.en: That did not save. Try again.

zh:outcome.valueNumber.en: The value must be a number.

zh:outcome.currencyCode.text: 请使用三个字母的货币代码，例如 USD。
zh:outcome.currencyCode.en: Use a three letter currency such as USD.

zh:outcome.proposal.sales.text: 看起来这笔交易已有结果。成交了吗？

zh:outcome.proposal.other.text: 看起来这件事已经完成。进展如何？
zh:outcome.proposal.other.en: Looks like this wrapped up. How did it go?

zh:learningCounts.month.text: 本月：学到 {learned} 项，记住 {remembered} 项

zh:inboxLearning.error.text: 没有成功。请刷新收件箱后重试。
zh:inboxLearning.error.en: That did not go through. Refresh the Inbox and try again.

zh:learningScreen.askFirst.label.en: Ask me before it changes anything

zh:learningScreen.error.load.en: Could not load this. Try again.

zh:learningScreen.error.save.en: Could not save that. Try again.

zh:learningScreen.intro.text: {bot} 会从你的反馈、编辑和标记中学习。它能执行哪些操作仍由其级别决定。
zh:learningScreen.intro.en: {bot} learns from your feedback, edits and marks. Its level still decides what it may do.

zh:learningScreen.learned.empty.text: 暂时没有。可以在上方告诉它一件事，或在聊天中给出反馈。
zh:learningScreen.learned.empty.en: Nothing yet. Tell it something above, or give feedback in a chat.

zh:learningScreen.memory.off.text: 要开始学习，请在设置 > 记忆中开启记忆
zh:learningScreen.memory.off.en: Turn memory on in Settings > Memory to learn

zh:learningScreen.prospect.label.text: 从客户和受众的消息中学习
zh:learningScreen.prospect.label.en: Learn from customer and audience messages

zh:learningScreen.recent.note.text: 撤销不会改变已经发送的内容
zh:learningScreen.recent.note.en: Undo does not change what was already sent

zh:learningScreen.restore.done.text: 已恢复。已撤销的经验：{count}条。

zh:learningScreen.restore.note.text: 这会撤销每条经验，并关闭上方两个选项。已应用到技能的更改不受影响。
zh:learningScreen.restore.note.en: This undoes every lesson and turns both options above off. Changes already applied to skills are not touched.

zh:learningScreen.results.needMany.text: 示例还不够。请再确认{count}个结果。
zh:learningScreen.results.needMany.en: Not enough examples yet. Confirm {count} more outcomes.

zh:learningScreen.results.needOne.text: 示例还不够。请再确认1个结果。
zh:learningScreen.results.needOne.en: Not enough examples yet. Confirm 1 more outcome.

zh:learningScreen.waiting.intro.text: {bot}注意到的事项。喜欢的就保留。
zh:learningScreen.waiting.intro.en: Things {bot} picked up. Keep any you like.

zh:learningScreen.approvals.note.text: {bot}的审批遵循你的访问设置。请在访问中更改。
zh:learningScreen.approvals.note.en: {bot} follows your Access settings for approvals. Change them in Access.

zh:learningScreen.tell.added.text: 已添加。从下一轮起生效。
zh:learningScreen.tell.added.en: Added. It applies from the next turn.

zh:learningScreen.tell.placeholder.text: 例如：给客户的邮件控制在 120 个词以内
zh:learningScreen.tell.placeholder.en: e.g. Keep client emails under 120 words

zh:learningScreen.why.feedback.text: 你在聊天中说了些什么。
zh:learningScreen.why.feedback.en: You said something in a chat.

zh:learningScreen.conflict.wins.text: 你自己的经验优先于 {name} 共享的经验：{text}
zh:learningScreen.conflict.wins.en: Yours wins over a shared lesson from {name}: {text}

zh:learningScreen.conflict.loses.text: 未使用。你自己的经验优先：{text}
zh:learningScreen.conflict.loses.en: Not used. Your own lesson takes priority: {text}

zh:learningScreen.why.shareBots.text: 为 {from} 学到的内容。建议给 {names}。

zh:learningScreen.why.shareTeam.text: 为 {from} 学到的内容。建议给整个团队。
zh:learningScreen.why.shareTeam.en: Learned for {from}. Offered to the whole team.

zh:learnedChip.improved.6.text: {bot} 根据你的工作方式调整了{text}

zh:learnedChip.improvedNote.text: 已自动改进。撤销会恢复之前的内容。
zh:learnedChip.improvedNote.en: Improved automatically. Undo puts back what it was before.

zh:learningScreen.why.outbound.text: 它会发送内容或联系其他人，所以要等你确认。
zh:learningScreen.why.outbound.en: It sends something to other people or contacts them, so it waits for you.

zh:learningScreen.why.askFirst.en: You asked to approve changes first.

zh:learningScreen.forgetData.ask.text: 忘记这个机器人学到的一切？

zh:learningScreen.forgetData.done.text: 已忘记。你的对话不受影响。

zh:learningScreen.forgetData.note.text: 这会删除这个机器人保存的所有经验、结果标记和示例，以及保存在这台电脑上的笔记。对话会保留。
zh:learningScreen.forgetData.note.en: This removes every lesson, result mark and example this bot kept, and the notes kept on this computer. Conversations stay.

zh:learningScreen.prospect.later.text: 稍后推出。目前不会从客户或受众的消息中学习。
zh:learningScreen.prospect.later.en: Coming later. Nothing is learned from customer or audience messages yet.

zh:whatsapp.intro.text: 使用你关联到 Murage 的号码，从 WhatsApp 向你的 Chief of Staff 发消息。请让 Murage 保持运行以接收消息。审批仍在 Murage 中进行。
zh:whatsapp.intro.en: Message your Chief of Staff from WhatsApp using a number you link to Murage. Keep Murage running to receive messages. Approvals stay in Murage.

zh:whatsapp.risk.title.text: 关联你自己的 WhatsApp 号码

zh:whatsapp.risk.how.text: Murage 像 WhatsApp Web 一样，从这台电脑使用你自己的号码关联 WhatsApp。随后，你的机器人就可以在 WhatsApp 中回复你和你选择的联系人。
zh:whatsapp.risk.how.en: Murage links to WhatsApp the way WhatsApp Web does, from this computer, using your own number. Your bot can then reply to you, and to the contacts you choose, inside WhatsApp.

zh:whatsapp.risk.unofficial.text: WhatsApp 并未正式提供此关联方式。如果 WhatsApp 认为某个号码由其他软件操控，可能会在不通知的情况下限制或移除该号码。最适合的使用方式是用第二张 SIM 卡或 eSIM 的备用号码，并在 WhatsApp Business 应用中设置。你也可以关联主要号码，但该号码的风险由你承担。
zh:whatsapp.risk.unofficial.en: WhatsApp does not offer this link officially. WhatsApp may restrict or remove a number it sees driven by other software, without notice. A spare number on a second SIM or eSIM, set up in the WhatsApp Business app, is the best way to use this. Linking your main number is possible, but it is your number to risk.

zh:whatsapp.risk.local.text: WhatsApp 会话及其关联凭据保留在这台电脑上。消息和音频使用你配置的模型和转写服务。只有先发来消息的聊天会收到回复；不会群发消息。
zh:whatsapp.risk.local.en: The WhatsApp session and its linking credentials stay on this computer. Messages and audio use the model and transcription services you configure. Replies go only to chats that message first; there is no broadcasting.

zh:whatsapp.risk.official.text: 目前可以通过关联你自己的号码连接。WhatsApp 官方的企业连接方式是未来的选项，目前尚不可用。
zh:whatsapp.risk.official.en: Linking your own number is the way to connect today. WhatsApp's official business route is a later option and is not available yet.

zh:whatsapp.state.linking.text: 请用该号码所在的手机扫描此代码。
zh:whatsapp.state.linking.en: Scan this code with the phone that owns the number.

zh:whatsapp.state.linkingCode.text: 请在该号码所在的手机上输入此代码。
zh:whatsapp.state.linkingCode.en: Enter this code on the phone that owns the number.

zh:whatsapp.state.restarting.text: WhatsApp 已接受关联并要求重启。请稍等。
zh:whatsapp.state.restarting.en: WhatsApp accepted the link and asked for a restart. One moment.

zh:whatsapp.state.connectedNoNumber.text: 已作为 {device} 关联到 WhatsApp。

zh:whatsapp.state.loggedOut.text: WhatsApp 已结束此关联。请重新关联以继续。
zh:whatsapp.state.loggedOut.en: WhatsApp ended this link. Relink to continue.

zh:whatsapp.state.conflict.text: 另一个 WhatsApp Web 会话已接管此关联。请重新关联以在此继续。
zh:whatsapp.state.conflict.en: Another WhatsApp Web session took over this link. Relink to continue here.

zh:whatsapp.state.blocked.forbidden.text: WhatsApp 拒绝了此连接。如果号码受到限制，请在手机上的 WhatsApp 支持中查看详情。
zh:whatsapp.state.blocked.forbidden.en: WhatsApp declined this connection. If the number was restricted, WhatsApp support on the phone has the details.

zh:whatsapp.state.blocked.update.text: WhatsApp 需要此关联方式的更新版本。请更新 Murage，然后重新关联。
zh:whatsapp.state.blocked.update.en: WhatsApp needs a newer version of this link. Update Murage, then relink.

zh:whatsapp.state.blocked.retryLimit.text: 多次尝试后仍无法连接 WhatsApp。请检查连接，然后点击“恢复”。
zh:whatsapp.state.blocked.retryLimit.en: WhatsApp could not be reached after several tries. Check the connection and press Resume.

zh:whatsapp.state.blocked.credentialStor.text: Murage 启动时无法读取已保存的登录信息。请重启 Murage 后再试。
zh:whatsapp.state.blocked.credentialStor.en: Murage could not read the saved sign-in details when it started. Restart Murage to try again.

zh:whatsapp.state.blocked.unreadable.text: 无法在这台电脑上打开已保存的 WhatsApp 关联。请重新关联以继续。
zh:whatsapp.state.blocked.unreadable.en: The saved WhatsApp link cannot be opened on this computer. Relink to continue.

zh:whatsapp.state.blocked.cloud.text: WhatsApp 官方的企业连接方式尚不可用。请切换回关联你自己的号码。
zh:whatsapp.state.blocked.cloud.en: The official WhatsApp business route is not available yet. Switch back to linking your own number.

zh:whatsapp.state.blocked.other.text: WhatsApp 需要你处理。请刷新状态，如果仍受阻，请重新关联。
zh:whatsapp.state.blocked.other.en: WhatsApp needs attention. Refresh status, then relink if it stays blocked.

zh:whatsapp.link.qrInstead.en: Link with a QR code instead

zh:whatsapp.link.steps.text: 在手机上打开 WhatsApp，然后依次选择“已关联设备”和“关联设备”。
zh:whatsapp.link.steps.en: Open WhatsApp on the phone, then Linked devices, then Link a device.

zh:whatsapp.link.codeSteps.text: 在手机上打开 WhatsApp，然后依次选择“已关联设备”和“关联设备”。接着选择改用电话号码关联，并输入此代码。
zh:whatsapp.link.codeSteps.en: On the phone, open WhatsApp, then Linked devices, then Link a device, then choose to link with a phone number instead, and type this code.

zh:whatsapp.link.phone.text: 含国家代码的电话号码

zh:whatsapp.link.phoneHelp.text: 请使用你要关联的号码，例如 15551234567。代码会显示约一分钟。
zh:whatsapp.link.phoneHelp.en: Use the number you are linking, for example 15551234567. The code is shown for about a minute.

zh:whatsapp.link.sameDevice.text: 如果 WhatsApp 和 Murage 在同一设备上，请使用代码将它们关联。
zh:whatsapp.link.sameDevice.en: If WhatsApp and Murage are on the same device, use a code to link them.

zh:whatsapp.unlinkConfirm.text: 解除此号码的关联？已保存的关联将从这台电脑上移除，机器人将停止在 WhatsApp 中回复。
zh:whatsapp.unlinkConfirm.en: Unlink this number? The saved link is removed from this computer and the bot stops replying on WhatsApp.

zh:whatsapp.status.chief.text: 回复来自你的 Chief of Staff。WhatsApp 仅与当前 Chief 关联。
zh:whatsapp.status.chief.en: Replies come from your Chief of Staff. WhatsApp links with the current Chief only.

zh:whatsapp.status.pending.text: 有 WhatsApp 任务待处理。请在 Murage 中检查任务。
zh:whatsapp.status.pending.en: WhatsApp work is pending. Review the task in Murage.

zh:whatsapp.status.uncertain.text: 无法确定一条回复是否已送达。请在重新发送消息前检查 WhatsApp。
zh:whatsapp.status.uncertain.en: A reply delivery is uncertain. Check WhatsApp before sending the message again.

zh:whatsapp.status.rejected.text: 一条回复被拒绝。请在 Murage 中检查任务。
zh:whatsapp.status.rejected.en: A reply was rejected. Review the task in Murage.

zh:whatsapp.status.needsReview.text: 已保存的任务记录需要在 Murage 中检查。任务不会自动重新运行。
zh:whatsapp.status.needsReview.en: A saved task record needs review in Murage. The task will not be run again automatically.

zh:whatsapp.status.ingress.text: 无法保存一条 WhatsApp 消息。请检查磁盘剩余空间。
zh:whatsapp.status.ingress.en: A WhatsApp message could not be kept. Check free disk space.

zh:whatsapp.status.catchUp.text: 重新连接后，Murage 没有处理部分旧消息。请在手机上查看聊天。
zh:whatsapp.status.catchUp.en: Murage did not process some older messages after reconnecting. Check the chat on the phone.

zh:whatsapp.mode.title.text: 谁可以给机器人发消息

zh:whatsapp.mode.self.text: 仅我自己（给自己发消息）

zh:whatsapp.mode.help.text: 仅我自己：机器人在你与自己的聊天中回复。我与选定的联系人：你批准的人可以给机器人发消息；机器人从不主动开始对话。
zh:whatsapp.mode.help.en: Only me: the bot answers in your own chat with yourself. Me and chosen contacts: people you approve can message the bot; the bot never starts a conversation.

zh:whatsapp.allow.label.text: 含国家代码的联系人号码

zh:whatsapp.allow.invalid.text: 请输入含国家代码的号码，仅使用数字。
zh:whatsapp.allow.invalid.en: Enter the number with its country code, digits only.

zh:whatsapp.allow.full.en: The list of allowed entries is full.

zh:whatsapp.pairing.none.text: 没有等待批准的联系人。
zh:whatsapp.pairing.none.en: No contacts are waiting for approval.

zh:whatsapp.pairing.help.text: 请输入联系人收到的代码。联系人将作为独立人员加入，绝不会作为你。
zh:whatsapp.pairing.help.en: Type the code the contact received. The contact becomes a separate person, never you.

zh:whatsapp.groups.help.text: 群组默认关闭，直到你启用其中一个。在设置为“提及”的群组中，机器人只在有人提及已关联号码、回复机器人发送的消息，或输入已关联号码的数字且未提及其他人时回复。在设置为“每条消息”的群组中，它会回复每条消息。群组中的所有人，包括你，都是访客：机器人只使用该群组的对话，从不使用个人记忆，也从不批准任何事项。
zh:whatsapp.groups.help.en: Groups are off until you turn one on. In a group set to Mention, the bot answers only when someone mentions the linked number, replies to a message the bot sent, or writes the linked number's digits without mentioning anyone else. In a group set to Every message, it answers every message. Everyone in a group, including you, is a guest there: the bot uses only that group's conversation, never personal memory, and never approves anything.

zh:whatsapp.groups.none.en: No groups were found on this number.

zh:whatsapp.groups.senders.text: 群组中谁可以与机器人交谈
zh:whatsapp.groups.senders.en: Who in a group can talk to the bot

zh:whatsapp.groups.sendersMembers.text: 允许的群组中的任何成员
zh:whatsapp.groups.sendersMembers.en: Any member of an allowed group

zh:whatsapp.groups.sendersAllowlist.text: 仅允许的联系人列表中的成员
zh:whatsapp.groups.sendersAllowlist.en: Only members on the allowed contacts list

zh:whatsapp.groups.full.en: At most 50 groups can be allowed.

zh:whatsapp.error.status.text: 无法刷新状态。请确认 Murage 正在运行，然后再次使用“刷新状态”。
zh:whatsapp.error.status.en: Status could not be refreshed. Check that Murage is running, then use Refresh status again.

zh:whatsapp.error.refreshFailed.text: 无法刷新状态。仍显示最后一次确认的状态。
zh:whatsapp.error.refreshFailed.en: Status refresh failed. The last confirmed state is still shown.

zh:whatsapp.error.link.text: 无法开始关联。请确认已选择一个 Chief，然后重试。
zh:whatsapp.error.link.en: Linking could not start. Check that a Chief is selected and try again.

zh:whatsapp.error.phone.text: 请输入含国家代码的电话号码。
zh:whatsapp.error.phone.en: Enter the phone number with its country code.

zh:whatsapp.error.save.text: 无法保存设置。请刷新状态后重试。
zh:whatsapp.error.save.en: Settings could not be saved. Refresh status and try again.

zh:whatsapp.error.approve.text: 无法批准该代码。请检查代码并确认请求尚未过期。
zh:whatsapp.error.approve.en: The code could not be approved. Check the code and that the request has not expired.

zh:whatsapp.error.dismiss.text: 无法忽略该请求。请刷新状态后重试。
zh:whatsapp.error.dismiss.en: The request could not be dismissed. Refresh status and try again.

zh:whatsapp.error.resume.text: 无法完成重新连接。请检查连接，然后刷新状态。
zh:whatsapp.error.resume.en: Reconnect could not complete. Check your connection, then refresh status.

zh:whatsapp.error.unlink.text: 无法完成解除关联。请刷新状态后重试。
zh:whatsapp.error.unlink.en: Unlink could not complete. Refresh status and try again.

zh:whatsapp.error.groups.text: 无法加载群组。请关联 WhatsApp 后重试。
zh:whatsapp.error.groups.en: Groups could not be loaded. Link WhatsApp and try again.

zh:permissionMenu.cannotAsk.text: {engine} 无法暂停询问，因此它在没有命令、队友、记忆或已连接应用的情况下工作。请选择可以询问的引擎，让这个机器人使用这些功能。
zh:permissionMenu.cannotAsk.en: {engine} can't stop to ask, so it works without commands, teammates, memory or connected apps. Pick an engine that can ask to give this bot those.

zh:permissionMenu.ownTools.text: {engine} 使用自己的工具运行。在“询问”模式下，它只读取和回答：不运行命令，也不更改文件。在“自动”“完全访问”和“无限制”模式下，它遵循你自己的 {engine} 命令设置。
zh:permissionMenu.ownTools.en: {engine} runs on its own tools. At Ask it reads and answers only: it runs no commands and changes no files. At Auto, Full access and No limits it follows your own {engine} command settings.

zh:channelReply.limitLater.text: {engine} 已达到使用上限，我稍后会重新处理你的消息。
zh:channelReply.limitLater.en: {engine} is at its limit, so I will try your message again later.

zh:channelReply.limitUntil.text: {engine} 已达到使用上限。额度重置后（约 {time}），我会继续处理你的消息。
zh:channelReply.limitUntil.en: {engine} is at its limit. I will pick up your message after it resets (about {time}).

zh:channelReply.routineLimit.text: {engine} 已达到使用上限；本次运行将在额度重置后（约 {time}）继续
zh:channelReply.routineLimit.en: {engine} is at its limit; this run continues after it resets (about {time})

zh:channelReply.routineLimitStopped.text: {engine} 仍处于使用上限，本次运行已停止。请在额度重置后重新运行。
zh:channelReply.routineLimitStopped.en: {engine} is still at its limit, so this run stopped. Run it again after the limit resets.

zh:channelReply.linkAccount.text: 请在 Murage 的记忆设置中将此频道账号关联到你自己或其他人，然后重新发送消息。
zh:channelReply.linkAccount.en: Link this channel account to yourself or another person in Murage Memory settings, then send your message again.

zh:channelReply.paired.text: {channel} 已与 Murage 配对。开始聊天前，请在 Murage 的“设置 → 记忆”中关联此频道账号，然后重新发送消息。
zh:channelReply.paired.en: {channel} is paired with Murage. Before chatting, link this channel account in Murage Settings → Memory. Then send your message again.

zh:channelReply.pairingExpired.text: 此配对码已过期。请在 Murage 中打开“设置 → 频道 → Telegram”，创建新的配对码。尚未向你的机器人发送任何消息。
zh:channelReply.pairingExpired.en: This pairing code expired. In Murage, open Settings → Channels → Telegram and create a new pairing code. No messages have been sent to your bot.

zh:channelReply.pairingCode.text: 此号码已关联到一个 Murage 助手。请让其所有者在 Murage 中批准代码 {code} 以开始使用。
zh:channelReply.pairingCode.en: This number is linked to a Murage assistant. Ask its owner to approve code {code} in Murage to start.

zh:channelReply.approvalsInMurage.text: 请在 Murage 中审核批准请求。{channel} 消息无法批准操作。
zh:channelReply.approvalsInMurage.en: Review approvals in Murage. {channel} messages cannot approve actions.

zh:channelReply.approvalsInApp.text: 请在 Murage 应用中审核批准请求。{channel} 消息无法批准操作。
zh:channelReply.approvalsInApp.en: Review approvals in the Murage app. {channel} messages cannot approve actions.

zh:channelReply.taskEnded.text: 任务已结束。请在 Murage 中查看结果。
zh:channelReply.taskEnded.en: Task ended. Review its result in Murage.

zh:channelReply.taskFailed.text: 任务失败。请在 Murage 中查看详情。
zh:channelReply.taskFailed.en: The task failed. Review details in Murage.

zh:channelReply.voiceUnconfigured.text: 语音消息需要在 Murage 中开启转写功能。请在“设置”中开启，或以文字形式发送。
zh:channelReply.voiceUnconfigured.en: Voice notes need transcription turned on in Murage. Turn it on in Settings, or send this as text.

zh:channelReply.voiceBusy.text: Murage 正在处理另一条语音消息。请稍后重新发送这条。
zh:channelReply.voiceBusy.en: Murage is still working on another voice note. Send this one again in a moment.

zh:channelReply.voiceUnreadable.text: 无法识别这条语音消息。语音消息时长上限约为两分钟。你可以重新发送，或直接输入文字。
zh:channelReply.voiceUnreadable.en: I could not read that voice note. Voice notes work up to about two minutes. You can send it again or type it.

zh:channelReply.desktopOnly.text: 请在电脑上批准此操作。你可以在这里拒绝。10 分钟后过期。
zh:channelReply.desktopOnly.en: Approve this on your computer. You can deny it here. Expires in 10 minutes.

zh:channelReply.approveOrDeny.text: 批准一次，或拒绝此特定操作。10 分钟后过期。
zh:channelReply.approveOrDeny.en: Approve once or deny this exact action. Expires in 10 minutes.

zh:channelReply.approveTaskOrDeny.text: 批准一次、在本任务剩余时间内允许在同一位置执行同类操作，或拒绝。10 分钟后过期。
zh:channelReply.approveTaskOrDeny.en: Approve once, allow the same kind of action in the same place for the rest of this task, or deny. Expires in 10 minutes.

zh:channelReply.noLongerPendingDecision.text: 已不再待处理。请在 Murage 中查看该决定。
zh:channelReply.noLongerPendingDecision.en: No longer pending. Review the decision in Murage.

zh:channelReply.noLongerPendingAction.text: 已不再待处理。请在 Murage 中审核此操作。
zh:channelReply.noLongerPendingAction.en: No longer pending. Review this action in Murage.

zh:channelReply.noLongerWaiting.text: 已不再等待回答。请在 Murage 中查看对话。
zh:channelReply.noLongerWaiting.en: No longer waiting for an answer. See the conversation in Murage.

zh:channelReply.decisionUnconfirmed.text: 决定未确认。请在 Murage 中查看，切勿重复操作。
zh:channelReply.decisionUnconfirmed.en: Decision unconfirmed. Check Murage; do not repeat.

zh:channelReply.decisionNotConfirmed.text: 无法确认此决定。请在 Murage 中审核该操作，切勿重复操作。
zh:channelReply.decisionNotConfirmed.en: Could not confirm this decision. Review the action in Murage; do not repeat it.

zh:channelReply.approvalStale.text: 此批准请求已过期、已变更或已被处理。请在 Murage 中查看。
zh:channelReply.approvalStale.en: This approval is expired, changed, or already answered. Review it in Murage.

zh:channelReply.questionPickMany.text: 点按你想要的选项，然后点按“提交”。
zh:channelReply.questionPickMany.en: Tap the options you want, then Submit.

zh:channelReply.questionOwnWords.en: Tap "{button}" to answer in your own words.

zh:channelReply.questionAnswerUnconfirme.text: 无法确认此回答已送达你的机器人。请在 Murage 中查看对话，切勿重复发送。
zh:channelReply.questionAnswerUnconfirme.en: Could not confirm this answer reached your bot. Check the conversation in Murage; do not repeat it.

zh:channelReply.questionCancelled.text: 好的。请在上方问题中点按一个选项或“跳过”。
zh:channelReply.questionCancelled.en: Okay. Tap an option or Skip on the question above.

zh:channelReply.questionTooLong.text: 回答超过 {count} 个字符。请发送更短的回答。
zh:channelReply.questionTooLong.en: That answer is longer than {count} characters. Send a shorter one.

zh:channelReply.questionNotedSubmit.text: 已记录。完成后点按“提交”，或继续选择选项。
zh:channelReply.questionNotedSubmit.en: Noted. Tap Submit when you are done, or keep picking options.

zh:channelReply.questionSkipped.text: 已跳过。已告知你的机器人你未作答。
zh:channelReply.questionSkipped.en: Skipped. Your bot was told you did not answer.

zh:channelReply.questionSkipUnconfirmed.text: 无法确认跳过操作已送达你的机器人。请在 Murage 中查看对话。
zh:channelReply.questionSkipUnconfirmed.en: Could not confirm the skip reached your bot. Check the conversation in Murage.

zh:channelReply.questionTakesOption.text: 此问题需要从选项中选择一个。
zh:channelReply.questionTakesOption.en: Answer this question by picking one of its options.

zh:channelReply.questionReplyHere.text: 请在此聊天中回复你的答案。发送 /cancel 可返回选项。
zh:channelReply.questionReplyHere.en: Reply in this chat with your answer. Send /cancel to go back to the options.

zh:channelReply.questionPickFirst.text: 请先选择至少一个选项。
zh:channelReply.questionPickFirst.en: Pick at least one option first.

zh:terms.intro.text: 请阅读并接受服务条款和隐私政策后再使用 Murage。只需一分钟。
zh:terms.intro.en: Please read and accept the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy to use Murage. It only takes a minute.

zh:terms.updatedIntro.text: 我们更新了服务条款和隐私政策。请阅读并接受，以继续使用 Murage。
zh:terms.updatedIntro.en: We have updated the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy. Please read and accept them to keep using Murage.

zh:terms.checkbox.text: 我已年满 18 岁，并同意{terms}和{privacy}
zh:terms.checkbox.en: I am 18 or older and I agree to the {terms} and {privacy}

zh:terms.error.text: 没能保存。请确认 Murage 仍在运行，然后再试一次。
zh:terms.error.en: That didn't save. Check that Murage is still running, then try again.

zh:terms.unreachable.text: 无法连接 Murage 来核对条款。正在自动重试。
zh:terms.unreachable.en: We couldn't reach Murage to check the terms. Retrying automatically.

zh:terms.desktopOnly.text: 此屏幕无法记录你的同意。请在电脑上打开 Murage，在那里接受条款，然后回到这里。
zh:terms.desktopOnly.en: This screen can't record your agreement. Open Murage on your computer, accept the terms there, then come back here.

zh:ux.l2a.today.tag.fuigoFlux.text: 通过 Flux Router 使用 Fuigo

zh:ux.l2a.today.needs.rest.text: 其余项请在“需要你处理”中查看
zh:ux.l2a.today.needs.rest.en: Open Needs you for the rest

zh:ux.l2a.today.look.reconnectMeta.text: 已停止 {n} 个例行任务 · 自 {time} 起

zh:ux.l2a.today.look.reconnectMetaOne.text: 已停止 1 个例行任务 · 自 {time} 起

zh:ux.l2a.today.look.failedGeneric.en: Open it to see what happened

zh:ux.l2a.today.look.handoff.text: {from} 交给 {to} 的任务正在等待

zh:ux.l2a.today.day.every.text: 每 {n} 分钟一次，直到午夜

zh:ux.l2a.today.day.meetings.text: 你自己的会议将在后续更新中显示在这里。
zh:ux.l2a.today.day.meetings.en: Your own meetings will show here in a coming update.

zh:ux.l2a.today.day.empty.text: 今天没有其他安排。下一个：{name}，{when}。
zh:ux.l2a.today.day.empty.en: Nothing else is scheduled today. Next: {name}, {when}.

zh:ux.l2a.today.day.none.text: 还没有例行任务。告诉{chief}你每天想完成什么。
zh:ux.l2a.today.day.none.en: No routines yet. Tell {chief} what you want done every day.

zh:ux.l2a.today.done.empty.text: 今天还没有完成任何事。结果会显示在这里。
zh:ux.l2a.today.done.empty.en: Nothing finished yet today. Results show here.

zh:ux.l2a.today.lead.quiet.text: 你的团队已就绪。今天还没有运行任何任务。
zh:ux.l2a.today.lead.quiet.en: Your team is ready. Nothing ran yet today.

zh:ux.l2a.today.view.label.text: 今天页面显示多少内容

zh:ux.l2a.today.view.saveFailed.en: That did not save. Try again.

zh:ux.l2a.today.runCost.title.text: 已报告的例行任务费用

zh:ux.l2a.today.runCost.partial.text: 今天有 {n} 次运行未报告费用
zh:ux.l2a.today.runCost.partial.en: {n} runs today did not report a cost

zh:ux.l2a.today.runCost.partialOne.text: 今天有 1 次运行未报告费用
zh:ux.l2a.today.runCost.partialOne.en: 1 run today did not report a cost

zh:ux.l2a.today.runCost.todayNone.text: 今天的运行未报告费用。
zh:ux.l2a.today.runCost.todayNone.en: Today's runs did not report a cost.

zh:ux.l2a.today.runCost.tooMany.text: 今天运行次数太多，无法在此汇总。请查看用量。
zh:ux.l2a.today.runCost.tooMany.en: Too many runs today to total here. See usage.

zh:ux.l2a.today.runCost.noHistory.en: Not enough days yet to compare.

zh:ux.l2a.today.runCost.none.text: 本周没有例行任务报告费用。
zh:ux.l2a.today.runCost.none.en: No routine reported a cost this week.

zh:ux.l2a.today.runCost.sub.text: 仅限例行任务运行。聊天费用在用量页面。
zh:ux.l2a.today.runCost.sub.en: Routine runs only. Chats are on the Usage page.

zh:ux.l2a.today.routines.line.text: 今天的例行任务：{ran} 个已运行，{failed} 个失败。下一个：{name}，{when}。

zh:ux.l2a.today.routines.lineNoNext.text: 今天的例行任务：{ran} 个已运行，{failed} 个失败。没有其他安排。
zh:ux.l2a.today.routines.lineNoNext.en: Routines today: {ran} ran, {failed} failed. Nothing else scheduled.

zh:ux.l2a.today.needsEmpty.text: 现在没有等你处理的事。
zh:ux.l2a.today.needsEmpty.en: Nothing is waiting on you right now.

zh:ux.l2a.today.needsEmptySub.text: 当机器人需要你同意、登录或回答时，会显示在这里。
zh:ux.l2a.today.needsEmptySub.en: When a bot needs a yes, a sign-in or an answer, it shows here.

zh:ux.l2a.today.needsChecking.text: 正在检查需要你处理的事。

zh:ux.l2a.today.moreNeeds.text: 需要你处理中还有 {n} 项

zh:ux.l2a.today.finishedEmpty.text: 今天后台还没有完成任何事。
zh:ux.l2a.today.finishedEmpty.en: Nothing finished in the background yet today.

zh:ux.l2a.today.tryLine.text: 对任意机器人说“每个工作日 8 点，把夜间邮件的摘要发给我”。它会设置好例行任务，并只问你一次。
zh:ux.l2a.today.tryLine.en: Say "every weekday at 8, send me a brief of overnight email" to any bot. It sets up the routine and asks you once.

zh:ux.l2a.today.trySentence.text: 每个工作日 8 点，把夜间邮件的摘要发给我。
zh:ux.l2a.today.trySentence.en: Every weekday at 8, send me a brief of overnight email.

zh:ux.l2a.today.tryHidden.text: 已隐藏。提示仍在帮助面板中。
zh:ux.l2a.today.tryHidden.en: Hidden. Tips stay in the help panel.

zh:sendNotice.notRecorded.text: Murage 无法记录这条消息，因此没有发送任何内容。你的文字仍在输入框中。请稍后再试。
zh:sendNotice.notRecorded.en: Murage couldn't record that message, so nothing was sent. Your words are still in the box. Try again in a moment.

zh:sendNotice.lateRefused.text: 机器人没能及时接收这条消息，而更新的一条已经先行处理，所以这条没有运行。如果仍然需要，请重新发送。
zh:sendNotice.lateRefused.en: The bot could not take that message in time and a newer one had already gone ahead, so it was not run. Send it again if you still want it.

zh:sendNotice.notConfirmed.text: 这条消息可能在 Murage 关闭之前没有送达机器人。它没有被再次发送。如果仍然需要，请重新发送。
zh:sendNotice.notConfirmed.en: This message may not have reached the bot before Murage closed. It was not sent again. Send it again if you still want it.

zh:sendNotice.refused.text: 这条消息无法启动，因此没有发送。你的文字仍在这里。准备好后请重新发送。
zh:sendNotice.refused.en: This message could not start, so it was not sent. Your words are still here. Send it again when you are ready.

zh:send.outboxFull.text: 之前的消息仍在投递中。你的消息已回到输入框。请稍后再发送。
zh:send.outboxFull.en: Earlier messages are still being delivered. Your message is back in the box. Send it again in a moment.

zh:send.timedOut.en: That took too long. Try again.

zh:send.notSaved.text: 你的文字仍在这里。此设备未能记录这次发送，因此没有发出任何内容。请稍后再按一次发送。
zh:send.notSaved.en: Your words are still here. This device could not record the send, so nothing went out. Press Send again in a moment.

zh:send.earlierArrived.text: 你之前的消息已经送达机器人。你编辑后的文字仍在这里，可以作为新消息发送。
zh:send.earlierArrived.en: Your earlier message already reached the bot. Your edited words are still here, ready to send as a new message.

zh:send.checkFailed.text: 你的文字仍在这里。Murage 暂时无法确认你之前的消息是否送达。请稍后再按一次发送。
zh:send.checkFailed.en: Your words are still here. Murage could not yet confirm whether your earlier message arrived. Press Send again in a moment.

zh:routines.schedulerLate.detail.text: Murage 一就绪，你的例行任务就会启动。
zh:routines.schedulerLate.detail.en: Your routines start as soon as Murage is ready.

zh:memoryStrip.working.text: 你可以照常聊天。正在检查之前的记忆,{percent}%。完成后,机器人会重新使用它们之前的回复。
zh:memoryStrip.working.en: You can chat as usual. Checking earlier memory, {percent}%. Bots pick up their earlier replies again when this is done.

zh:memoryStrip.workingEta.text: 你可以照常聊天。正在检查之前的记忆,{percent}%,{left}。完成后,机器人会重新使用它们之前的回复。
zh:memoryStrip.workingEta.en: You can chat as usual. Checking earlier memory, {percent}%, {left}. Bots pick up their earlier replies again when this is done.

zh:memoryStrip.workingNoPercent.text: 你可以照常聊天。正在检查之前的记忆。完成后,机器人会重新使用它们之前的回复。
zh:memoryStrip.workingNoPercent.en: You can chat as usual. Checking earlier memory. Bots pick up their earlier replies again when this is done.

zh:memoryStrip.workingOpen.text: 你可以照常聊天。{label},{done}。完成后,机器人会重新使用它们之前的回复。
zh:memoryStrip.workingOpen.en: You can chat as usual. {label}, {done}. Bots pick up their earlier replies again when this is done.

zh:memoryStrip.done.text: 之前的记忆已检查完毕。一切就绪。
zh:memoryStrip.done.en: Earlier memory is checked. Everything is in place.

zh:memoryStrip.phase.learning.text: 正在检查已学到的内容

zh:memoryStrip.phase.storage.text: 正在整理历史记录的存放方式

zh:memoryStorage.available.text: Murage 已缩小你的记忆。你可以归还约 {size} 的磁盘空间。
zh:memoryStorage.available.en: Murage made your memory smaller. You can hand back about {size} of disk space.

zh:memoryStorage.note.text: 这需要几分钟,期间 Murage 可能会变慢。
zh:memoryStorage.note.en: This takes a few minutes, and Murage may feel slow while it works.

zh:memoryStorage.availableUnknown.text: Murage 已缩小你的记忆。你可以归还升级后不再需要的磁盘空间。
zh:memoryStorage.availableUnknown.en: Murage made your memory smaller. You can hand back disk space that the upgrade no longer needs.

zh:memoryStorage.running.text: 正在归还空间。这可能需要几分钟。
zh:memoryStorage.running.en: Handing back the space. This can take a few minutes.

zh:memoryStorage.failed.text: Murage 还没准备好开始这一步。请稍后再试。
zh:memoryStorage.failed.en: Murage is not ready to start that yet. Try again in a moment.

zh:memoryStrip.hold.text: 之前的记忆暂时被搁置。你的聊天照常使用。在此期间,新的内容不会加入记忆。
zh:memoryStrip.hold.en: Earlier memory is set aside for now. Your chats work as usual. New things are not added to memory while it is set aside.

zh:memoryStrip.mode.held.text: 之前的记忆暂时被搁置。你的聊天照常使用。在此期间,新的内容不会加入记忆。
zh:memoryStrip.mode.held.en: Earlier memory is set aside for now. Your chats work as usual. New things are not added to memory while it is set aside.

zh:memoryStrip.mode.paused.text: 记忆已暂停。你的聊天照常使用。
zh:memoryStrip.mode.paused.en: Memory is paused. Your chats work as usual.

zh:memoryStrip.mode.pausedNoted.text: 记忆已暂停。你的聊天照常使用,新的内容仍会被记录。
zh:memoryStrip.mode.pausedNoted.en: Memory is paused. Your chats work as usual, and new things are still noted.

zh:memoryStrip.mode.off.text: 记忆已关闭。记录和回忆都已关闭。
zh:memoryStrip.mode.off.en: Memory is off. Capture and recall are off.

zh:memoryStrip.mode.capture.text: 记录已开启。回忆已关闭。
zh:memoryStrip.mode.capture.en: Capture is on. Recall is off.

zh:memoryStrip.slow.text: 这一步需要多花一点时间。它仍在推进。
zh:memoryStrip.slow.en: This step is taking a little longer. It is still moving.

zh:memoryStrip.phase.message-index.text: 正在准备供搜索的消息

zh:memoryStrip.phase.shapes.text: 正在检查之前记忆的详细内容

zh:memoryStrip.phase.marker.text: 正在完成之前的记忆整理

zh:memoryStrip.phase.masking.text: 正在遮盖之前记忆中的银行卡号和账号
zh:memoryStrip.phase.masking.en: Masking bank and card numbers in earlier memory

zh:memoryStrip.phase.settling.text: 正在完成之前记忆中号码的遮盖
zh:memoryStrip.phase.settling.en: Finishing the masking of earlier memory

zh:memoryStorage.waiting.text: 归还空间需要更多可用磁盘空间。请先腾出一些空间,然后重试。
zh:memoryStorage.waiting.en: Murage needs more free disk space to hand back the space. Make some room, then try again.

zh:memoryStorage.vacuumIdle.text: 旧记录已清除。你离开几分钟后,Murage 会把空间还给磁盘,所以绝不会拖慢你。
zh:memoryStorage.vacuumIdle.en: The old records are cleared. Murage gives the space back to your disk once you have been away for a few minutes, so it never slows you down.

zh:restoreHolds.intro.text: 恢复时为你保留了这些项目。在你放行之前，不会分享任何内容。
zh:restoreHolds.intro.en: Your restore kept these for you. Nothing is shared until you release it.

zh:restoreHolds.failed.en: Try releasing that again in a moment.

zh:restoreHolds.refreshed.text: 列表已更新。请查看后再放行。
zh:restoreHolds.refreshed.en: The list was updated. Check it and release again.

zh:delegationHeld.actionFailed.en: Try that again in a moment.

zh:memoryPage.modeSentence.active.text: 记忆已开启：你的机器人会在对话之间保留记忆。
zh:memoryPage.modeSentence.active.en: Memory is on: your bots remember between conversations.

zh:memoryPage.modeSentence.capture.text: “仅记录”会持续保存发生的事，但机器人暂不使用记忆。
zh:memoryPage.modeSentence.capture.en: Capture only keeps saving what happens, and bots do not use memory yet.

zh:memoryPage.modeSentence.paused.text: “暂停”会暂时搁置记忆。已保存的内容仍会保留。
zh:memoryPage.modeSentence.paused.en: Paused sets memory aside for now. What is saved stays saved.

zh:memoryPage.stillSaving.text: 仍在保存，可能需要一点时间。
zh:memoryPage.stillSaving.en: Still saving. This can take a moment.

zh:memoryPage.saveFailed.text: 没有保存成功。请再试一次。
zh:memoryPage.saveFailed.en: That did not save. Try again.

zh:memoryPage.stillWorking.text: 仍在处理，可能需要一点时间。
zh:memoryPage.stillWorking.en: Still working. This can take a moment.

zh:memoryPage.didNotWork.en: That did not work. Try again.

zh:memoryPage.ceiling.invalid.text: 请输入 0 到 1,000,000 之间的数字。

zh:memoryPage.ceiling.zero.text: 上限为 0 会关闭学习，直到你调高它。
zh:memoryPage.ceiling.zero.en: A limit of 0 turns learning off until you raise it.

zh:memoryPage.event.changed.text: 这条记忆已更改。请在下方的工作区记忆中查看。
zh:memoryPage.event.changed.en: This memory has changed. Review it in workspace memory below.

zh:memoryPage.event.retryFailed.text: 无法重新开始。请稍后再试。
zh:memoryPage.event.retryFailed.en: Could not start that again. Try again in a moment.

zh:memoryPage.event.retriedNote.text: 已重试。新的结果会显示在这里。
zh:memoryPage.event.retriedNote.en: Retried. New results will show up here.

zh:memoryPage.refreshFailed.text: 无法刷新记忆。请再试一次。
zh:memoryPage.refreshFailed.en: Could not refresh memory. Try again.

zh:memoryPage.subtitle.text: 你的机器人在对话之间记住的内容。
zh:memoryPage.subtitle.en: What your bots remember between conversations.

zh:memoryPage.on.captureHint.text: 当前为“仅记录”。可在“高级”中更改。
zh:memoryPage.on.captureHint.en: Capture only is on. Change it under Advanced.

zh:memoryPage.on.pausedDone.text: 记忆已暂停。已保存的内容仍会保留。
zh:memoryPage.on.pausedDone.en: Memory is paused. What is saved stays saved.

zh:memoryPage.learningUnavailable.text: 学习设置不可用。请刷新设置后再试。
zh:memoryPage.learningUnavailable.en: Learning settings are unavailable. Refresh settings to try again.

zh:memoryPage.ceiling.raised.text: 上限已调高。学习将继续。
zh:memoryPage.ceiling.raised.en: Limit raised. Learning picks up again.

zh:memoryPage.ceiling.raiseFailed.text: 无法调高上限。请再试一次。
zh:memoryPage.ceiling.raiseFailed.en: Could not raise the limit. Try again.

zh:memoryPage.learn.asWeTalkHint.text: 事实，以及你喜欢的做事方式。
zh:memoryPage.learn.asWeTalkHint.en: Facts and how you like things done.

zh:memoryPage.learn.asWeTalkOff.en: Learning as we talk is off.

zh:memoryPage.learn.asWeTalkOn.en: Learning as we talk is on.

zh:memoryPage.learn.reviewOff.en: New memories are used right away.

zh:memoryPage.learn.reviewOn.en: New memories wait for your yes.

zh:memoryPage.bots.subtitle.text: 每个机器人各自的记忆

zh:memoryPage.bots.empty.text: 你的机器人会显示在这里。

zh:memoryPage.history.empty.text: 还没有学到任何内容。新学到的内容会连同来源显示在这里。
zh:memoryPage.history.empty.en: Nothing learned yet. New learning will appear here with its source.

zh:memoryPage.history.moreFailed.text: 无法加载更多记录。请再试一次。
zh:memoryPage.history.moreFailed.en: Could not load more history. Try again.

zh:memoryPage.mode.procedures.text: 学习你喜欢的做事方式
zh:memoryPage.mode.procedures.en: Learn how you like things done

zh:memoryPage.mode.proceduresOff.text: 不学习你喜欢的做事方式。
zh:memoryPage.mode.proceduresOff.en: Not learning how you like things done.

zh:memoryPage.mode.proceduresOn.text: 正在学习你喜欢的做事方式。
zh:memoryPage.mode.proceduresOn.en: Learning how you like things done.

zh:memoryPage.connection.fluxAddKey.text: Flux Fast（默认，需添加你的密钥）

zh:memoryPage.connection.note.text: 学习使用单独的文本连接，不会使用你的机器人的聊天引擎。
zh:memoryPage.connection.note.en: Learning uses a separate connection for text. Your bot's chat engine is not used.

zh:memoryPage.limit.note.text: 用来防止你的 Flux 余额被失控消耗。上限设置得很高，正常使用不会触及。
zh:memoryPage.limit.note.en: A guard against runaway spending on your Flux balance. Set high, so normal use never reaches it.

zh:memoryPage.limit.reset.text: 上限每月 1 日重置。如果你达到上限，学习会暂停，并在“需要你处理”中出现一个请求。
zh:memoryPage.limit.reset.en: The limit resets on the 1st of each month. If you reach it, learning pauses and a request appears in Needs you.

zh:memoryPage.loadFailed.text: 无法加载记忆设置。请刷新设置后再试。
zh:memoryPage.loadFailed.en: Could not load memory settings. Refresh settings to try again.

zh:memoryPage.historyFailed.text: 无法加载学习记录。请刷新设置后再试。
zh:memoryPage.historyFailed.en: Could not load learning history. Refresh settings to try again.

zh:memoryPage.busy.text: 另一项更改仍在保存。请稍后再试。
zh:memoryPage.busy.en: Another change is still saving. Try again in a moment.

zh:memoryPage.conflict.text: 学习设置已在别处更改。请刷新设置并查看最新的选择。
zh:memoryPage.conflict.en: Learning settings changed elsewhere. Refresh settings and review the latest choices.

zh:memoryPage.conversationGone.en: This conversation is no longer available.

zh:memoryPage.desktopOnly.text: 记忆设置仅在桌面应用中提供。
zh:memoryPage.desktopOnly.en: Memory settings are available in the desktop app.

zh:memorySettings.savedOne.text: 已保存 {count} 条记忆 · {waiting} 条等你处理

zh:memorySettings.savedOther.text: 已保存 {count} 条记忆 · {waiting} 条等你处理

zh:memorySettings.savedRecordsRemain.text: 已保存的记录仍可在这里查看。

zh:memorySettings.botGone.en: A bot that is no longer here

zh:memorySettings.backlog.text: {pending} 个排队中 · {leased} 个处理中 · {deferred} 个已推迟 · {failed} 个失败

zh:memorySettings.import.result.text: 已导入 {imported} 个，已跳过 {skipped} 个。原始文件：{originals}。

zh:memorySettings.desktopOnly.text: 记忆管理仅在本地桌面应用中提供。远程会话无法管理工作区记忆。
zh:memorySettings.desktopOnly.en: Memory management is available in the local desktop app. Remote sessions cannot manage workspace memory.

zh:memorySettings.audienceAccessFolder.text: 受众访问权限和文件夹记忆

zh:memorySettings.stillWorking.text: 仍在处理，可能需要一点时间。
zh:memorySettings.stillWorking.en: Still working. This can take a moment.

zh:memorySettings.didNotWork.en: That did not work. Try again.

zh:memorySettings.download.started.text: 已开始下载。进度会显示在这里。

zh:memorySettings.download.failed.text: 无法开始下载。请检查网络连接后再试。
zh:memorySettings.download.failed.en: The download could not start. Check your connection and try again.

zh:memorySettings.download.slow.text: 仍在启动，可能需要一点时间。
zh:memorySettings.download.slow.en: Still starting. This can take a moment.

zh:memorySettings.threadGone.en: A conversation that is no longer here

zh:memorySettings.subtitle.text: 搜索已保存的内容，查看它来自哪里，并选择谁可以使用。
zh:memorySettings.subtitle.en: Search what is saved, see where it came from and choose who can use it.

zh:memorySettings.keywordOnly.text: 记忆搜索仅使用关键词；在这台电脑上运行的可选模型尚未就绪。
zh:memorySettings.keywordOnly.en: Memory search uses keywords only; the optional model that runs on this computer is not ready.

zh:memorySettings.semanticReady.text: 按含义查找记忆的模型已在这台电脑上就绪。
zh:memorySettings.semanticReady.en: The model for finding memories by meaning is ready on this computer.

zh:memorySettings.modelNotReady.text: 可选的本地模型尚未就绪。
zh:memorySettings.modelNotReady.en: The optional local model is not ready.

zh:memorySettings.botNote.text: 记录、模型下载和处理设置适用于整个工作区。
zh:memorySettings.botNote.en: Capture, model downloads and processing settings apply to the whole workspace.

zh:memorySettings.off.note.text: 记忆已关闭。开启工作区的记录与回忆，并导入检测到的 Murage 机器人笔记本。原件会保留，每个笔记本仍只属于对应的机器人。回忆的内容会发送给你选择的引擎；学习则遵循你在“设置”的“记忆”中的选择。
zh:memorySettings.off.note.en: Memory is off. Enable workspace capture and recall and import detected Murage bot notebooks. Originals are preserved and each notebook stays private to its bot. Recalled context is sent to the engine you choose; learning follows your choices in Settings, then Memory.

zh:memorySettings.off.enabled.text: 已开启记录与回忆。正在导入检测到的机器人笔记本，原件会保留。
zh:memorySettings.off.enabled.en: Capture and recall enabled. Detected bot notebooks are being imported; originals are preserved.

zh:memorySettings.noMatches.text: 没有符合这些筛选条件的记忆。

zh:memorySettings.changes.aria.text: 需要审阅的笔记本更改

zh:memorySettings.changes.note.text: 这些文件在某条记忆被置顶、编辑、归档或忘记之后发生了变化，或无法读取。你已保存的决定都已保留。
zh:memorySettings.changes.note.en: These files changed after a memory was pinned, edited, archived or forgotten, or could not be read. Your saved decisions have been preserved.

zh:memorySettings.changes.conflict.text: 更改后的笔记本与已保存的记忆决定冲突。
zh:memorySettings.changes.conflict.en: The changed notebook conflicts with a saved memory decision.

zh:memorySettings.changes.attention.text: 这个笔记本需要先处理才能导入。
zh:memorySettings.changes.attention.en: This notebook needs attention before it can be imported.

zh:memorySettings.changes.stop.text: 保留已保存的记忆并停止跟踪
zh:memorySettings.changes.stop.en: Keep saved memory and stop tracking

zh:memorySettings.changes.stopped.text: 已保留已保存的记忆。笔记本跟踪已停止。
zh:memorySettings.changes.stopped.en: Saved memory kept. Notebook tracking stopped.

zh:memorySettings.changes.none.text: 没有需要审阅的笔记本冲突。

zh:memorySettings.compactNote.text: 管理工作区的记录、导入和可选的本地模型。
zh:memorySettings.compactNote.en: Manage capture, imports and the optional local model for the workspace.

zh:memorySettings.retention.text: 已归档的记忆仍可用于较早的对话。除非你主动忘记，否则不会忘掉任何内容。
zh:memorySettings.retention.en: Archived memories can still be used for older conversations. Nothing is forgotten unless you forget it.

zh:memorySettings.model.finished.text: 下载完成。本地模型已就绪。
zh:memorySettings.model.finished.en: Download finished. The local model is ready.

zh:memorySettings.model.smartNote.text: 本地模型验证通过后，智能搜索才会启动。在此期间关键词搜索可用。
zh:memorySettings.model.smartNote.en: Smart search starts once the local model is verified. Keyword search works meanwhile.

zh:memorySettings.model.downloadNote.text: 把固定版本的模型文件下载到这台电脑。此操作不会请求任何 AI 服务运行模型。
zh:memorySettings.model.downloadNote.en: Downloads a fixed version of the model files to this computer. This action does not ask an AI service to run a model.

zh:memorySettings.excluded.note.text: 排除某个对话时，Murage 也会不再使用它已有的记忆。重新纳入它不会恢复这些记忆。
zh:memorySettings.excluded.note.en: Excluding a conversation also stops Murage from using its existing memories. Including it again does not restore those memories.

zh:memorySettings.access.note.text: 仅限所有者的记忆只属于你；队友能看到共享的记忆。
zh:memorySettings.access.note.en: Owner-only memories stay with you; teammates see shared ones.

zh:memorySettings.access.folderCreated.text: 已创建文件夹记忆并授予访问权限。
zh:memorySettings.access.folderCreated.en: Folder memory created and access granted.

zh:memorySettings.import.subtitle.en: Bring in notes you already have.

zh:memorySettings.import.previewNote.text: 导入前先预览完整的笔记本或团队简介。导入的记录会带有“未验证导入”标记；原始文件会保留。
zh:memorySettings.import.previewNote.en: Preview the full notebook or team brief before importing it. Imported records retain an unverified-import label; original files are preserved.

zh:memorySettings.import.track.text: 在导入的笔记本文件更改时保持同步。已置顶、编辑、归档或忘记的记忆需要审阅。
zh:memorySettings.import.track.en: Keep imported notebooks updated when their files change. Pinned, edited, archived or forgotten memories require review.

zh:memorySettings.import.previewReady.text: 预览已就绪。导入前请在下方检查。
zh:memorySettings.import.previewReady.en: Preview ready. Check it below before importing.

zh:memoryHealth.scope.text: 统计涵盖整个工作区，查看单个机器人时也是如此。记忆被保存或检索到，并不能证明机器人用过它。
zh:memoryHealth.scope.en: Counts cover the whole workspace, including when viewing one bot. Saved or retrieved memory does not prove a bot used it.

zh:memoryHealth.unavailable.text: 活动详情不可用。请刷新记忆后再试。
zh:memoryHealth.unavailable.en: Activity details are unavailable. Refresh memory to try again.

zh:memoryHealth.retrievedNone.en: Retrieval history has not been recorded yet.

zh:memoryHealth.supplied.text: 发送给机器人的记忆引用

zh:memoryHealth.suppliedBody.text: 在 {turns} 次机器人回复中，向机器人发送了 {references} 条记忆引用。
zh:memoryHealth.suppliedBody.en: {references} memory references sent to bots across {turns} bot responses.

zh:memoryHealth.synthesis.configured.text: 已配置连接；仅凭配置并不能确认学习成功
zh:memoryHealth.synthesis.configured.en: connection configured; successful learning is not confirmed by configuration alone

zh:memoryHealth.synthesis.notConfigured.text: 尚未配置连接；请在“设置”的“记忆”中选择一个连接
zh:memoryHealth.synthesis.notConfigured.en: no connection configured; choose a connection in Settings, then Memory

zh:memoryHealth.backlog.text: {pending} 个排队中 · {leased} 个处理中 · {deferred} 个已推迟 · {failed} 个失败

zh:memoryHealth.indexing.text: 搜索索引正在更新。最近的记录可能还不会显示。
zh:memoryHealth.indexing.en: Search index is updating. Recent records may not appear yet.

zh:memoryWords.workerUnavailable.text: 记忆正在赶进度，稍后会再试。
zh:memoryWords.workerUnavailable.en: Memory is catching up and will try again shortly.

zh:memoryWords.indexFailed.text: 搜索正在赶进度。最近的内容可能需要几分钟才会显示。
zh:memoryWords.indexFailed.en: Search is catching up. Recent items may take a few minutes to show up.

zh:memoryWords.consolidationFailed.text: 学习稍后会再试。已经学到的内容都仍然有效。
zh:memoryWords.consolidationFailed.en: Learning will try again shortly. Everything already learned still works.

zh:memoryWords.modelFailed.text: 搜索模型没有下载完成。你可以再试一次。
zh:memoryWords.modelFailed.en: The search model did not finish downloading. You can try again.

zh:memoryWords.indexBuilding.text: 更新后 Murage 仍在准备记忆。这个笔记本几分钟后会自动更新。
zh:memoryWords.indexBuilding.en: Murage is still getting memory ready after the update. This notebook will update by itself in a few minutes.

zh:memoryReview.everyday.one.text: 你可以保留 {count} 条日常内容。

zh:memoryReview.everyday.other.text: {count} 条日常内容可以一起保留。
zh:memoryReview.everyday.other.en: {count} everyday things can be kept together.

zh:memoryReview.batch.changed.one.text: {count} 条在你查看时发生了变化，所以仍在这里。
zh:memoryReview.batch.changed.one.en: {count} changed while you were looking, so it is still here.

zh:memoryReview.batch.changed.other.text: {count} 条在你查看时发生了变化，所以仍在这里。
zh:memoryReview.batch.changed.other.en: {count} changed while you were looking, so they are still here.

zh:memoryReview.reason.sourceGone.text: 已不可用：它来源的消息已被删除。
zh:memoryReview.reason.sourceGone.en: No longer available: the message it came from was deleted.

zh:memoryReview.reason.correction.text: {name} 想更新一条之前的记忆。
zh:memoryReview.reason.correction.en: {name} would like to update an earlier memory.

zh:memoryReview.reason.edited.text: 你修改了措辞，所以它在等你最终确认。
zh:memoryReview.reason.edited.en: You changed the words, so it waits for your final yes.

zh:memoryReview.reason.identity.text: 内容与 {name} 自身有关，所以会先问你。
zh:memoryReview.reason.identity.en: About {name} itself, so it asks you first.

zh:memoryReview.reason.money.text: 内容与金钱有关，所以 {name} 会先问你。
zh:memoryReview.reason.money.en: About money, so {name} asks you first.

zh:memoryReview.reason.health.text: 内容与健康有关，所以 {name} 会先问你。
zh:memoryReview.reason.health.en: About health, so {name} asks you first.

zh:memoryReview.reason.secret.text: 可能包含密码或密钥，所以 {name} 会先问你。
zh:memoryReview.reason.secret.en: Could include a password or key, so {name} asks you first.

zh:memoryReview.reason.person.text: 内容与其他人有关，所以 {name} 会先问你。
zh:memoryReview.reason.person.en: About another person, so {name} asks you first.

zh:memoryReview.reason.shared.text: 多个机器人或多个人可能会用到它，所以会先问你。
zh:memoryReview.reason.shared.en: Several bots or people could use this, so it asks you first.

zh:memoryReview.reason.workedOut.text: {name} 从{day}的聊天中得出了这一点。

zh:memoryReview.error.reconnect.text: 请重新连接后再保留。没有任何改动。
zh:memoryReview.error.reconnect.en: Reconnect to keep this. Nothing has been changed.

zh:memoryReview.error.conflict.text: 这条内容在你查看时发生了变化，下面是最新的。
zh:memoryReview.error.conflict.en: This changed while you were looking. Here is the latest.

zh:memoryReview.error.reused.en: That did not go through. Try again.

zh:memoryReview.error.laterFull.text: “稍后”已满。请先处理其中几条。
zh:memoryReview.error.laterFull.en: Later is full. Decide on a few of those first.

zh:memoryReview.error.undoUnavailable.en: This can no longer be undone here.

zh:memoryReview.error.sourceUnavailable.text: 它来源的消息已不可用。
zh:memoryReview.error.sourceUnavailable.en: The message this came from is no longer available.

zh:memoryReview.error.correctionPin.text: 这会替换你置顶的内容。请选择如何处理置顶。
zh:memoryReview.error.correctionPin.en: This would replace something you pinned. Choose what happens to the pin.

zh:memoryReview.error.correction.text: 这次更新所针对的记忆已发生变化。请重新查看。
zh:memoryReview.error.correction.en: The memory this updates has changed. Review it again.

zh:memoryReview.error.pinBudget.text: Murage 会把每条置顶的记忆带入每次回复，它们共有 {allowed} 字节的空间。加上这一条将占用 {used} 字节。请先取消置顶或缩短一条置顶的记忆，再置顶这一条。
zh:memoryReview.error.pinBudget.en: Murage brings every pinned memory into each reply, and they have {allowed} bytes of room. With this one they would take {used}. Unpin or shorten a pinned memory first, then pin this one.

zh:memoryReview.error.pinBudgetPlain.text: Murage 会把每条置顶的记忆带入每次回复，加上这一条将超出它们的空间。请先取消置顶或缩短一条置顶的记忆，再置顶这一条。
zh:memoryReview.error.pinBudgetPlain.en: Murage brings every pinned memory into each reply, and this one would take them past the room they have. Unpin or shorten a pinned memory first, then pin this one.

zh:memoryReview.error.writeWords.en: Write a few words to keep.

zh:memoryReview.error.desktopOnly.text: 记忆只能在桌面应用中查看。
zh:memoryReview.error.desktopOnly.en: Memory can only be reviewed in the desktop app.

zh:memoryReview.error.generic.text: 没有成功。没有任何改动。
zh:memoryReview.error.generic.en: That did not go through. Nothing was changed.

zh:memoryEvolution.reasonNone.en: No {kind} improvement check has been requested.

zh:memoryEvolution.reasonPassedUnrecorde.text: 测试已通过；没有记录显示更改已被应用。
zh:memoryEvolution.reasonPassedUnrecorde.en: The test passed; there is no record of the change being applied.

zh:memoryEvolution.reasonNoChange.text: 没有发现改进。保留当前策略。
zh:memoryEvolution.reasonNoChange.en: No improvement was found. The current policy was retained.

zh:memoryEvolution.reasonRejected.text: 建议的更改被拒绝。此次检查没有应用任何记忆规则。
zh:memoryEvolution.reasonRejected.en: The proposed change was rejected. This check did not apply any memory rules.

zh:memoryEvolution.reasonFinishedNoResul.text: 检查已结束，但没有记录结果。
zh:memoryEvolution.reasonFinishedNoResul.en: The check finished without a recorded result.

zh:memoryEvolution.reasonRunning.text: 正在用人工示例测试{kind}更改。

zh:memoryEvolution.reasonExtractorBusy.text: 正在等待当前的记忆处理完成。
zh:memoryEvolution.reasonExtractorBusy.en: Waiting for current memory processing to finish.

zh:memoryEvolution.reasonConnection.text: 正在等待可用的学习连接。
zh:memoryEvolution.reasonConnection.en: Waiting for an available learning connection.

zh:memoryEvolution.reasonAdmission.text: 正在等待当前的授权和自动学习设置。
zh:memoryEvolution.reasonAdmission.en: Waiting for current authorization and automatic-learning settings.

zh:memoryEvolution.reasonCostAuthority.text: 这次检查需要更新授权后才能运行。
zh:memoryEvolution.reasonCostAuthority.en: This check needs updated authorization before it can run.

zh:memoryEvolution.reasonBudget.en: The memory processing limit has been reached.

zh:memoryEvolution.reasonInterrupted.text: 之前的检查在开始后被中断。
zh:memoryEvolution.reasonInterrupted.en: The earlier check was interrupted after it started.

zh:memoryEvolution.reasonResource.text: 此安装版本不提供记忆改进工具。
zh:memoryEvolution.reasonResource.en: Memory improvement tools are unavailable on this installation.

zh:memoryEvolution.reasonBlocked.text: 这次检查已被阻止，因为它的输入或权限发生了变化。
zh:memoryEvolution.reasonBlocked.en: This check is blocked because its inputs or permissions changed.

zh:memoryEvolution.reasonStopped.text: 检查在开始后停止了，尚未自动重试。
zh:memoryEvolution.reasonStopped.en: The check stopped after it started. It has not been retried automatically.

zh:memoryEvolution.reasonWaitingRequirem.text: 检查正在等待其所需条件就绪。
zh:memoryEvolution.reasonWaitingRequirem.en: The check is waiting for its requirements to become available.

zh:memoryEvolution.errRetryState.text: 这次检查在当前状态下无法重试。请刷新其状态。
zh:memoryEvolution.errRetryState.en: This check cannot be retried from its current state. Refresh its status.

zh:memoryEvolution.errRevisionUnavailabl.text: 回忆策略版本不可用。请刷新版本。
zh:memoryEvolution.errRevisionUnavailabl.en: Recall policy revision is unavailable. Refresh versions.

zh:memoryEvolution.descRollback.text: 先前已恢复的记忆策略。

zh:memoryEvolution.descEvaluated.text: 用人工示例测试后保留的记忆规则。
zh:memoryEvolution.descEvaluated.en: Memory rules kept after testing with artificial examples.

zh:memoryEvolution.descBaseline.text: 任何经过测试的更改之前的内置记忆规则。
zh:memoryEvolution.descBaseline.en: Built-in memory rules before any tested changes.

zh:memoryEvolution.titleClassification.text: 经过测试的记忆语句归类改进
zh:memoryEvolution.titleClassification.en: Tested improvements to sorting memory statements into categories

zh:memoryEvolution.enabled.text: 已允许使用人工示例运行随附的{kind}测试。
zh:memoryEvolution.enabled.en: Permission has been given to run the included {kind} test using artificial examples.

zh:memoryEvolution.intro.text: 让 Murage 使用应用附带的人工示例测试{kind}更改。只有当单独留作测试的示例上结果有所改善，且没有任何测试结果变差时，才会应用更改。你的私人对话不会被用作此检查的训练示例。
zh:memoryEvolution.intro.en: Let Murage test {kind} changes using artificial examples included with the app. It applies a change only if results improve on examples kept separate for testing and no test results get worse. Your private conversations are not used as training examples for this check.

zh:memoryEvolution.scopeClassification.text: 这些检查测试人工来源语句如何被归入类别。现有的自动学习选择和处理上限仍然适用。
zh:memoryEvolution.scopeClassification.en: These checks test how artificial source statements are sorted into categories. Existing choices about automatic learning and processing limits still apply.

zh:memoryEvolution.scopeRecall.text: 这些检查测试 Murage 会选择使用哪些记忆。现有的自动学习选择和处理上限仍然适用。
zh:memoryEvolution.scopeRecall.en: These checks test which memories Murage chooses to use. Existing choices about automatic learning and processing limits still apply.

zh:memoryEvolution.statusUnavailableClas.text: 将记忆语句归入类别的改进状态不可用。
zh:memoryEvolution.statusUnavailableClas.en: The status of improvements to sorting memory statements into categories is unavailable.
