zh:memoryEvolution.authorized.text: 已授权使用应用附带的人工示例
zh:memoryEvolution.authorized.en: Authorized for artificial examples included with the app

zh:memoryEvolution.lastHeldout.text: 最近一次在单独留作测试的示例上的结果
zh:memoryEvolution.lastHeldout.en: Last result on examples kept separate for testing

zh:memoryEvolution.heldoutScoreClassific.text: {cases} 个人工示例。将语句归入类别的得分：更改前 {baseline}，建议的更改 {candidate}。
zh:memoryEvolution.heldoutScoreClassific.en: {cases} artificial examples. Score for sorting statements into categories: {baseline} before the change, {candidate} for the proposed change.

zh:memoryEvolution.heldoutScoreRecall.text: {cases} 个人工示例。选取相关记忆的得分：更改前 {baseline}，建议的更改 {candidate}。
zh:memoryEvolution.heldoutScoreRecall.en: {cases} artificial examples. Score for choosing relevant memories: {baseline} before the change, {candidate} for the proposed change.

zh:memoryEvolution.regressions.text: 结果变差的测试：{regressions}。得分描述的是此次检查所用的人工示例。
zh:memoryEvolution.regressions.en: Tests with worse results: {regressions}. Scores describe the artificial examples used in this check.

zh:memoryEvolution.waitSettings.text: 请等待当前的设置操作完成。
zh:memoryEvolution.waitSettings.en: Wait for the current settings action to finish.

zh:procedureAdmissions.reasonEvidence.text: 此预览包含从对话中保留的信息。发送预览之前，需要另行审阅这些数据。
zh:procedureAdmissions.reasonEvidence.en: This preview includes information kept from conversations. A separate review of that data is required before the preview can be sent.

zh:procedureAdmissions.reasonGrant.text: 此流程、受众、模型和测试集已获允许。
zh:procedureAdmissions.reasonGrant.en: Already allowed for this procedure, audience, model and test set.

zh:procedureAdmissions.reasonNoModel.text: 正在等待可用于学习的 AI 模型连接。
zh:procedureAdmissions.reasonNoModel.en: Waiting for an available connection to an AI model for learning.

zh:procedureAdmissions.reasonIneligible.text: 这组指令正在等待合适的测试示例，或运行测试的最新权限。
zh:procedureAdmissions.reasonIneligible.en: This set of instructions is waiting for suitable test examples or up-to-date permission to run the test.

zh:procedureAdmissions.reasonReview.text: 允许评估之前，请先查看下方的确切指令。
zh:procedureAdmissions.reasonReview.en: Review the exact instructions below before allowing evaluation.

zh:procedureAdmissions.errMismatch.text: 流程预览与所选的审阅不一致。
zh:procedureAdmissions.errMismatch.en: The procedure preview did not match the selected review.

zh:procedureAdmissions.errLoad.en: Could not load this procedure preview.

zh:procedureAdmissions.errRetryNotConfir.text: 此审阅的重试尚未确认。
zh:procedureAdmissions.errRetryNotConfir.en: Retry was not confirmed for this review.

zh:procedureAdmissions.noticeRetry.text: 已使用现有的流程权限请求重试。
zh:procedureAdmissions.noticeRetry.en: Retry requested using the existing procedure permission.

zh:procedureAdmissions.errStaleRetry.text: 此流程的权限已更改。重试之前请先刷新预览。
zh:procedureAdmissions.errStaleRetry.en: This procedure permission changed. Refresh the preview before retrying.

zh:procedureAdmissions.errAuthNotConfirm.text: 此审阅的授权尚未确认。
zh:procedureAdmissions.errAuthNotConfirm.en: Authorization was not confirmed for this review.

zh:procedureAdmissions.noticeAuth.text: 已允许对所审阅的指令和范围进行评估。
zh:procedureAdmissions.noticeAuth.en: Evaluation allowed for the reviewed instructions and scope.

zh:procedureAdmissions.errStaleAuth.text: 此预览已更改。允许评估之前，请刷新并查看最新的指令。
zh:procedureAdmissions.errStaleAuth.en: This preview changed. Refresh it and review the latest instructions before allowing evaluation.

zh:procedureAdmissions.refreshFailed.text: 无法刷新等待中的流程审阅。
zh:procedureAdmissions.refreshFailed.en: Could not refresh waiting procedure reviews.

zh:procedureAdmissions.intro.text: 选择一个等待中的审阅，查看将发送去测试的确切指令。没有合适测试示例的指令会继续等待。
zh:procedureAdmissions.intro.en: Select a waiting review to see the exact instructions that would be sent for testing. Instructions without suitable test examples remain waiting.

zh:procedureAdmissions.noneWaiting.text: 没有等待中的流程审阅。

zh:procedureAdmissions.showingUpTo.text: 最多显示 {max} 个等待中的审阅。列出的审阅并不代表可以发送其内容。
zh:procedureAdmissions.showingUpTo.en: Showing up to {max} waiting reviews. A listed review is not permission to send its contents.

zh:procedureAdmissions.loadingPreview.text: 正在加载所选流程的预览…

zh:procedureAdmissions.noConnection.text: 没有可用的连接来审阅机器人学到的内容。
zh:procedureAdmissions.noConnection.en: No connection is available to review what the bot has learned.

zh:procedureAdmissions.noLongerWaiting.text: 此审阅已不在等待列表中。继续之前请先刷新流程审阅。
zh:procedureAdmissions.noLongerWaiting.en: This review is no longer in the waiting list. Refresh procedure reviews before continuing.

zh:procedureAdmissions.exactSent.text: 发送去评估的确切指令

zh:procedureAdmissions.onlySent.text: 只会发送这些指令和用于测试的虚构示例。已保存的对话摘录不会被发送。
zh:procedureAdmissions.onlySent.en: Only these instructions and the made-up examples used for testing are sent. Saved conversation excerpts are not sent.

zh:procedureAdmissions.permissionCovers.text: 该权限可涵盖这些指令之后经过测试的版本，前提是受众、AI 模型和测试示例相同。如果你编辑了指令，就需要重新审阅。现有的处理上限仍然适用。
zh:procedureAdmissions.permissionCovers.en: Permission can cover later versions of these instructions that have been tested with the same audience, AI model and test examples. If you edit the instructions, they need a new review. Existing processing limits still apply.

zh:procedureHistory.restoreNote.text: 恢复只影响之后的任务。正在运行的任务沿用它们的指令版本。
zh:procedureHistory.restoreNote.en: Restoring affects future tasks. Running tasks keep their instruction version.

zh:procedureHistory.noHistory.text: 这些指令还没有版本历史记录。
zh:procedureHistory.noHistory.en: No version history is recorded for these instructions yet.

zh:procedureHistory.noEarlier.text: 此受众没有更早的版本。
zh:procedureHistory.noEarlier.en: No earlier versions are available for this audience.

zh:procedureHistory.skillAudienceNote.text: 上方显示的指令是全局技能。请在下方选择要查看哪个受众的历史。
zh:procedureHistory.skillAudienceNote.en: Instructions shown above are the global skill. Choose which audience’s history to inspect below.

zh:memoryNeeds.pinAsk.text: 你置顶了“{text}”。置顶状态该如何处理？
zh:memoryNeeds.pinAsk.en: You pinned "{text}". What should happen to the pin?

zh:memoryNeeds.pinTransfer.text: 把置顶保留在新记忆上
zh:memoryNeeds.pinTransfer.en: Keep the pin on the new one

zh:memoryNeeds.lookingUp.en: Looking up where this came from.

zh:memoryNeeds.lookupError.en: Could not look that up right now.

zh:memoryNeeds.noLonger.text: 已不可用：它来自的消息已被删除。
zh:memoryNeeds.noLonger.en: No longer available: the message it came from was deleted.

zh:memoryNeeds.usedIn.text: 用于你与 {name} 的对话。只有你能看到。
zh:memoryNeeds.usedIn.en: Used in your chats with {name}. Only you can see it.

zh:memoryNeeds.emptyLater.text: “稍后”里没有内容。点“暂不处理”后，内容会放到这里，直到你决定。
zh:memoryNeeds.emptyLater.en: Nothing in Later. Not now puts things here until you decide.

zh:memoryNeeds.keptBot.text: 已保留，用于你与 {name} 的对话。

zh:memoryNeeds.undoneAll.text: 已撤销。{name} 不会在这里使用它。
zh:memoryNeeds.undoneAll.en: Undone. {name} will not use this here.

zh:memoryNeeds.undoneSome.text: 已撤销。有 {count} 条不会在这里使用。
zh:memoryNeeds.undoneSome.en: Undone. {count} will not be used here.

zh:memoryNeeds.keptPin.text: 已保留。置顶状态已更新。

zh:memoryNeeds.movedLater.text: 已移到“稍后”。它会留在那里，直到你决定。
zh:memoryNeeds.movedLater.en: Moved to Later. It stays there until you decide.

zh:memoryNeeds.savedKept.text: 已保存你的措辞并保留。
zh:memoryNeeds.savedKept.en: Saved your wording and kept it.

zh:memoryReview.importedNote.text: 导入的笔记属于参考资料。保留它们是为了便于回忆；这不会把它们验证为指令，也不会更改工作区的记录设置。
zh:memoryReview.importedNote.en: Imported notes are reference material. Keeping them saves them for recall; it does not verify them as instructions or change workspace capture settings.

zh:memoryReview.lineageOne.text: 基于这条记忆的 1 个较早版本。
zh:memoryReview.lineageOne.en: Built on 1 earlier version of this memory.

zh:memoryReview.lineageMany.text: 基于这条记忆的 {count} 个较早版本。
zh:memoryReview.lineageMany.en: Built on {count} earlier versions of this memory.

zh:memoryReview.skillRequested.text: 已在所选机器人的对话中请求技能审阅。任何提议的技能仍需你批准。
zh:memoryReview.skillRequested.en: Skill review requested in the selected bot's conversation. Any proposed skill still needs your approval.

zh:memoryReview.chooseBot.text: 选择一个有权限的机器人

zh:memoryReview.learnNote.text: 以这条记忆的确切版本为来源，启动现有的 /learn 流程。所选机器人必须已有访问权限，审阅会在该机器人的模型上运行。此操作不会启用任何技能。
zh:memoryReview.learnNote.en: Starts the existing /learn workflow with this exact memory version as its source. The selected bot must already have access, and the review runs on that bot's model. No skill is activated by this action.

zh:memoryReview.correctionSaved.en: Correction saved as a new version.

zh:memoryReview.shared.text: 已向所选受众共享一条单独的记忆。
zh:memoryReview.shared.en: A separate memory was shared with the selected audience.

zh:memoryReview.shareNote.text: 共享会为该受众创建一份已批准的副本。共享私人信息之前，请先检查文本。
zh:memoryReview.shareNote.en: Sharing creates an approved copy for this audience. Review the text before sharing private information.

zh:memoryReview.managed.text: 在 Continuity 中管理。请在机器人的“记忆”设置中编辑或移除此项。
zh:memoryReview.managed.en: Managed in Continuity. Edit or remove this in the bot's Memory settings.

zh:memoryReview.archived.text: 记忆已归档。它的来源仍可用于历史回忆。
zh:memoryReview.archived.en: Memory archived. Its sources remain available for historical recall.

zh:memoryReview.restored.text: 记忆已恢复到当前回忆中。

zh:memoryReview.forgetNote.text: 忘记会移除这条记忆，并清除依赖它的已回忆信息。已发送给外部提供商的文本无法撤回。
zh:memoryReview.forgetNote.en: Forgetting removes this memory and clears recalled information that depends on it. Text already sent to an external provider cannot be withdrawn.

zh:memoryReview.forgotten.text: 记忆已忘记。依赖它的已回忆信息已被清除。
zh:memoryReview.forgotten.en: Memory forgotten. Recalled information that depends on it has been cleared.

zh:memoryPeople.accountLabel.text: {platform} 账户 · 用户 ID {userId} · 账户提供方 ID {authorityId}
zh:memoryPeople.accountLabel.en: {platform} account · user ID {userId} · account provider ID {authorityId}

zh:memoryPeople.errUpdate.text: 无法更新此账户。请再试一次。
zh:memoryPeople.errUpdate.en: Could not update this account. Try again.

zh:memoryPeople.errStale.text: 此账户已在别处更改。请刷新已验证账户，查看最新的分配，然后再试。
zh:memoryPeople.errStale.en: This account changed elsewhere. Refresh verified accounts, review the latest assignment, then try again.

zh:memoryPeople.errShare.text: 无法更改此共享受众。请刷新已验证账户，然后再试。
zh:memoryPeople.errShare.en: Could not change this shared audience. Refresh verified accounts, then try again.

zh:memoryPeople.errRefresh.text: 无法刷新已验证账户。请再试一次。
zh:memoryPeople.errRefresh.en: Could not refresh verified accounts. Try again.

zh:memoryPeople.intro.text: 请先选定这些已验证的平台账户属于你还是别人，再进行关联。把某个账户标为你的，它就可以使用工作区所有者的上下文。另一个人的信息保持独立。关联账户会合并为这些账户保存的信息；显示名称永远不能证明身份。
zh:memoryPeople.intro.en: Link verified platform accounts only after choosing whether they belong to you or someone else. Marking an account as yours lets it use the workspace owner's context. A separate person's information stays separate. Linking accounts combines the information saved for those accounts; a display name is never proof of identity.

zh:memoryPeople.none.text: 目前没有需要分配的已验证平台账户。
zh:memoryPeople.none.en: No verified platform accounts need an assignment yet.

zh:memoryPeople.pendingOne.text: 有 1 个已验证的平台账户在等所有者决定。
zh:memoryPeople.pendingOne.en: 1 verified platform account is waiting for an owner decision.

zh:memoryPeople.pendingMany.text: 有 {count} 个已验证的平台账户在等所有者决定。
zh:memoryPeople.pendingMany.en: {count} verified platform accounts are waiting for an owner decision.

zh:memoryPeople.sharedIntro.text: 共享后，回复另一个人的机器人可以使用为该频道、项目、团队或工作区保存的记忆。这里只提供这些受众；此选择不会共享工作区所有者的私人对话。停止共享后，这些记忆今后不再被使用；已发送给提供商的文本无法撤回。
zh:memoryPeople.sharedIntro.en: Sharing lets bots responding to a separate person use memories saved for that channel, project, team or workspace. Only those audiences are offered here; this choice does not share the workspace owner's private conversations. Stopping sharing prevents future use of those memories; text already sent to a provider cannot be withdrawn.

zh:memoryPeople.noShared.text: 没有共享受众。回复此人时，机器人只会使用此人自己的对话和偏好。
zh:memoryPeople.noShared.en: No shared audiences. When responding to this person, bots use only that person's own conversations and preferences.

zh:memoryNotebook.choose.text: 每次导入最多可选 20 个文件。导入前你会先审阅文件内容；原始文件保持不动。
zh:memoryNotebook.choose.en: Choose up to 20 files per import. You will review their contents before importing; original files stay in place.

zh:memoryNotebook.needsYou.text: 需要你处理：再次导入之前，请检查该文件以及所有已置顶、编辑、归档或忘记的记忆。
zh:memoryNotebook.needsYou.en: Needs you: check the file and any pinned, edited, archived or forgotten memories before importing again.

zh:memoryLearning.status.memoryOff.text: 学习已暂停：记忆已关闭。
zh:memoryLearning.status.memoryOff.en: Learning is paused: memory is off.

zh:memoryLearning.status.paused.text: 学习已随记忆处理一起暂停。
zh:memoryLearning.status.paused.en: Learning is paused with memory processing.

zh:memoryLearning.status.nothingOn.text: 学习已暂停。请在下方开启事实或流程。
zh:memoryLearning.status.nothingOn.en: Learning is paused. Turn on facts or procedures below.

zh:memoryLearning.status.addKey.text: 学习已暂停：请添加你的 Flux 密钥或选择一个连接。
zh:memoryLearning.status.addKey.en: Learning is paused: add your Flux key or choose a connection.

zh:memoryLearning.status.review.text: 学习已开启。需要你点头的记忆会在“需要你处理”中等待。
zh:memoryLearning.status.review.en: Learning is on. Memories that need your yes wait in Needs you.

zh:memoryLearning.event.guideUndone.text: 工作指南的更改已撤销

zh:memoryLearning.error.conflict.text: 学习设置已在别处更改。请刷新设置并查看最新的选择。
zh:memoryLearning.error.conflict.en: Learning settings changed elsewhere. Refresh settings and review the latest choices.

zh:memoryLearning.error.connection.text: 此连接不可用。请刷新设置并选择一个连接。
zh:memoryLearning.error.connection.en: This connection is unavailable. Refresh settings and choose a connection.

zh:memoryLearning.error.generic.text: 无法更新记忆。请刷新设置后再试。
zh:memoryLearning.error.generic.en: Could not update memory. Refresh settings and try again.

zh:memoryLearning.ceiling.off.text: 学习已关闭。学习上限设为 0。
zh:memoryLearning.ceiling.off.en: Learning is off. The learning limit is set to 0.

zh:memoryLearning.ceiling.paused.text: 学习已暂停：已达到本月的学习上限。
zh:memoryLearning.ceiling.paused.en: Learning paused: it reached this month's learning limit.

zh:memoryLearning.semantic.keywordOnly.text: 智能搜索就绪前，记忆搜索使用关键词。
zh:memoryLearning.semantic.keywordOnly.en: Memory search uses keywords until smart search is ready.

zh:memoryLearning.semantic.indexing.text: 正在为智能搜索建立索引，{done} / {total}。

zh:memoryLearning.counts.oneWaiting.text: {count} 条记忆，{waiting} 条在“需要你处理”中等待。

zh:memoryLearning.counts.manyWaiting.text: {count} 条记忆，{waiting} 条在“需要你处理”中等待。

zh:memoryLearning.skipped.text: 无法从这段对话的一部分中学习。
zh:memoryLearning.skipped.en: Could not learn from part of this conversation.

zh:firstRun.press.brief.text: 正在设置你的晨间简报

zh:firstRun.press.day.text: 正在准备你的今日计划

zh:firstRun.press.notes.text: 正在为你的笔记做准备

zh:firstRun.press.research.en: Getting ready to look into it

zh:firstRun.press.business.text: 正在为你的生意组建团队

zh:firstRun.press.slow.text: 还在处理中，可能需要几秒钟。
zh:firstRun.press.slow.en: Still working on it. This can take a few seconds.

zh:settings.l5.firstRun.off.text: 你已选择暂不开启备份。可随时在“设置”的“备份”中开启。
zh:settings.l5.firstRun.off.en: You chose to keep backups off for now. Turn them on any time in Settings, under Backups.

zh:settings.l5.firstRun.offFailed.text: Murage 暂时无法记录此选择。请重试，或在“设置”的“备份”中关闭备份。
zh:settings.l5.firstRun.offFailed.en: Murage couldn't record that choice yet. Try again, or turn backups off in Settings, under Backups.

zh:settings.l5.firstRun.unsupported.text: 此电脑暂时无法运行备份。请稍后重试，或暂不开启备份，之后再到“设置”的“备份”中开启。
zh:settings.l5.firstRun.unsupported.en: Backups can't run on this computer yet. Try again in a moment, or keep backups off for now and turn them on later in Settings, under Backups.

zh:settings.l5.firstRun.inSettings.text: 你的备份设置保持不变。可在“设置”的“备份”中开启备份，或暂不开启。
zh:settings.l5.firstRun.inSettings.en: Your backup settings stay as you left them. Turn backups on in Settings, under Backups, or keep them off for now.

zh:settings.l5.restore.existingHint.text: 已有来自这台电脑或被替换电脑的备份？在备份模式中可以选择该备份并输入恢复密钥。
zh:settings.l5.restore.existingHint.en: Have a backup already, from this computer or the one this replaces? Backup mode lets you choose it and your recovery key.

zh:cloudConnect.useCopiedLinkNote.text: 如果浏览器没有将你带回此处，请从 Murage 页面复制链接，然后点按“使用已复制的链接”。
zh:cloudConnect.useCopiedLinkNote.en: If your browser does not bring you back here, copy the link from the Murage page, then press Use copied link.

zh:cloudConnect.retryIn.text: 可再次尝试的剩余时间：

zh:cloudConnect.result.expired.text: 此链接已过期。请再次点按“连接”。
zh:cloudConnect.result.expired.en: This link has expired. Press Connect again.

zh:cloudConnect.result.holdRequired.text: 请在“我的云”中开始添加这台电脑。72 小时检查完成后即可连接。
zh:cloudConnect.result.holdRequired.en: Start adding this computer on My Cloud. It can connect after the 72-hour check.

zh:cloudConnect.result.tooManyDevices.text: 此云端空间连接的设备过多。请在“我的云”中移除一台设备，然后再次点按“连接”。
zh:cloudConnect.result.tooManyDevices.en: This home has too many devices connected. Remove one on My Cloud, then press Connect again.

zh:cloudConnect.result.refused.text: 你的云端空间拒绝连接这台电脑。请再次点按“连接”。
zh:cloudConnect.result.refused.en: Your Cloud home would not connect this computer. Press Connect again.

zh:cloudConnect.result.tooManyTries.text: 尝试次数过多。请等待十分钟，然后再次点按“连接”。
zh:cloudConnect.result.tooManyTries.en: Too many tries. Wait ten minutes, then press Connect again.

zh:cloudConnect.result.homeBusy.text: 你的云端空间当前繁忙。请稍候，然后再次点按“连接”。
zh:cloudConnect.result.homeBusy.en: Your Cloud home is busy right now. Wait a moment, then press Connect again.

zh:cloudConnect.result.lost.text: 你的云端空间可能已连接这台电脑，但未收到响应。请再次点按“连接”；它会使用相同的密钥，因此无需重新进行 72 小时检查。
zh:cloudConnect.result.lost.en: Your home may have connected this computer, but the answer didn't arrive. Press Connect again; it uses the same key, so no new 72-hour check.

zh:cloudConnect.result.tookTooLong.text: 耗时超过十分钟。请点按“连接”重新开始。
zh:cloudConnect.result.tookTooLong.en: That took longer than ten minutes. Press Connect to start again.

zh:cloudConnect.result.removeOnMyCloud.text: 如果这台电脑出现在“我的云”中，请在那里将其移除。
zh:cloudConnect.result.removeOnMyCloud.en: If this computer appears on My Cloud, remove it there.

zh:cloudConnect.result.otherConnect.text: 此链接属于另一次连接操作。请再次点按“连接”。
zh:cloudConnect.result.otherConnect.en: This link was created for a different connection attempt. Press Connect again.

zh:cloudConnect.result.badLink.text: 这不是 Murage 连接链接。
zh:cloudConnect.result.badLink.en: That is not a Murage connect link.

zh:cloudConnect.result.pinMismatch.text: 这不是你配对的云端空间。请重新配对。
zh:cloudConnect.result.pinMismatch.en: This isn't the Cloud home you paired with. Pair it again.

zh:cloudConnect.result.unreachable.text: 无法访问你的云端空间

zh:cloudConnect.notLive.text: 此应用暂不支持 Murage Cloud。请更新 Murage 后重试。
zh:cloudConnect.notLive.en: Murage Cloud isn't available for this app yet. Update Murage and try again.

zh:err.plain.network.text: Murage 无法连接到其辅助程序。请检查网络连接后重试。
zh:err.plain.network.en: Murage could not reach its helper. Check your connection and try again.

zh:err.plain.signIn.text: 登录已过期。请重新登录以继续。
zh:err.plain.signIn.en: Your sign-in has expired. Sign in again to carry on.

zh:err.plain.rateLimit.text: 该服务当前繁忙。请稍后重试。
zh:err.plain.rateLimit.en: That service is busy right now. Try again in a moment.

zh:err.plain.server.text: 服务出现问题。请稍后重试。
zh:err.plain.server.en: The service hit a snag. Try again in a moment.

zh:err.plain.notFound.text: 找不到该内容，它可能已被移动。
zh:err.plain.notFound.en: That could not be found. It may have moved.

zh:err.plain.badReply.text: Murage 收到了无法读取的响应。请重试。
zh:err.plain.badReply.en: Murage got a reply it could not read. Try again.

zh:err.plain.internal.text: 处理过程中出现问题。请重试。
zh:err.plain.internal.en: Something went wrong on the way. Try again.

zh:sidebar.markAllReadFailed.text: 部分对话无法标为已读。请稍后重试。
zh:sidebar.markAllReadFailed.en: Some conversations could not be marked read. Try again in a moment.

zh:modal.discardChanges.text: 不保存就关闭？你的更改将会丢失。
zh:modal.discardChanges.en: Close without saving? Your changes will be lost.

zh:copy.failed.text: 无法复制。请选中文本后手动复制。
zh:copy.failed.en: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it yourself.

zh:routines.carryLastReport.text: 每次运行都以上一次运行的报告开头
zh:routines.carryLastReport.en: Starts each run with the last run's report

zh:loopNotice.nudged.text: 相同的失败出现 5 次后，已向机器人发送跟进消息
zh:loopNotice.nudged.en: Sent the bot a follow-up after 5 identical failures

zh:loopNotice.repeat.text: 相同操作已重复 {n} 次: {call}(可能卡住了)
zh:loopNotice.repeat.en: Same action repeated {n}×: {call} (it may be stuck)

zh:slik.backupDetail.text: 当此机器人的引擎达到上限时，由另一个引擎回答你的消息。若未设置，会出现一张卡片让你选择或等待。
zh:slik.backupDetail.en: Another engine answers your message when this bot's engine is at its limit. Without one, a card lets you pick or wait.

zh:slik.backupNone.en: Wait for the limit to reset

zh:slik.backupRoutinesHint.text: 例行任务只会在你已付费的套餐或密钥上继续。
zh:slik.backupRoutinesHint.en: Routines carry on only on a plan or key you already pay for.

zh:slik.backupTitle.en: When this engine is at its limit

zh:slik.botModelDetail.text: 没有自己模型的聊天会使用这个模型。
zh:slik.botModelDetail.en: Chats without a model of their own use this one.

zh:slik.ownModelMany.text: {n} 个聊天使用自己的模型

zh:slik.ownModelOne.text: 1 个聊天使用自己的模型

zh:slik.switchBusy.text: 完成。{n} 个仍在运行；它们结束后再切换。
zh:slik.switchBusy.en: Done. {n} still working; switch those when they finish.

zh:slik.switchDone.text: 完成。这些聊天现在使用此机器人的模型。
zh:slik.switchDone.en: Done. Those chats now use this bot's model.

zh:slik.waitingForLimit.text: 正在等待 {engine} 的上限重置
zh:slik.waitingForLimit.en: waiting for the limit on {engine} to reset

zh:settings.sendKey.note.text: 选择用来发送消息的按键。其他按键用于换行。
zh:settings.sendKey.note.en: Pick the key that sends a message. The other keys start a new line.

zh:settings.bot.overview.roleMatches.text: 当前角色与导入时指定的用途一致。
zh:settings.bot.overview.roleMatches.en: The current role matches the purpose specified in the import.

zh:settings.bot.overview.roleInactive.text: 导入的角色未生效。请使用下方的角色控件明确分配角色。
zh:settings.bot.overview.roleInactive.en: The imported role is not active. Use the role control below to assign a role explicitly.

zh:settings.bot.overview.noGrant.text: 导入配置文件不会授予任何权限。
zh:settings.bot.overview.noGrant.en: Importing a profile does not grant permissions.

zh:settings.bot.identity.titlePlaceholde.text: 描述你的机器人的职责

zh:settings.bot.identity.instructionsPla.text: 这个机器人做什么、需要了解什么，以及你希望它如何工作
zh:settings.bot.identity.instructionsPla.en: What this bot does, what it should know, and how you want it to work

zh:settings.bot.identity.instructionsHin.text: 在每次回复开始时发送给这个机器人。请从机器人的视角来写。它的队友在决定由谁负责工作时也会阅读这些内容，因此请围绕其职责来写。
zh:settings.bot.identity.instructionsHin.en: Sent to this bot at the start of each response. Write from the bot's perspective. Its teammates also read it when deciding who should handle work, so keep it about the job.

zh:settings.bot.identity.personalityPlac.text: 直截了当，略带调侃，冷幽默。省去客套话。
zh:settings.bot.identity.personalityPlac.en: Direct, a little snarky, dry wit. Skip the pleasantries.

zh:settings.bot.identity.personalityHint.text: 这个机器人的说话方式。仅提供给它本身，其他任何地方都不会读取。队友在决定委派对象时不会看到这些内容。
zh:settings.bot.identity.personalityHint.en: How this bot talks, spoken to it, and read by nothing else. A teammate deciding who to delegate to never sees it.

zh:settings.bot.peer.engineCannot.text: 此引擎无法联系其他机器人
zh:settings.bot.peer.engineCannot.en: This engine cannot contact other bots

zh:settings.bot.apps.connectFirst.text: 请先连接应用（侧边栏中的“应用”），然后再授予此机器人访问权限。
zh:settings.bot.apps.connectFirst.en: Connect apps first (Apps, in the sidebar), then give this bot access.

zh:settings.bot.apps.engineCannot.text: 此机器人当前的引擎无法使用已连接的应用。
zh:settings.bot.apps.engineCannot.en: This bot's current engine cannot use connected apps.

zh:settings.bot.apps.on.text: 允许此机器人使用你已连接的 Gmail、Calendar、Slack 等应用。
zh:settings.bot.apps.on.en: Let this bot use your connected Gmail, Calendar, Slack, and other apps.

zh:settings.bot.apps.off.text: 不允许此机器人使用你已连接的应用。
zh:settings.bot.apps.off.en: Keep your connected apps unavailable to this bot.

zh:settings.bot.apps.switchLabel.text: 允许此机器人使用已连接的应用
zh:settings.bot.apps.switchLabel.en: Allow this bot to use connected apps

zh:settings.bot.apps.connectFirstTitle.text: 请先在侧边栏的“应用”中连接应用
zh:settings.bot.apps.connectFirstTitle.en: Connect apps first, under Apps in the sidebar

zh:settings.bot.apps.engineCannotTitle.text: 此引擎无法使用已连接的应用
zh:settings.bot.apps.engineCannotTitle.en: This engine cannot use connected apps

zh:settings.bot.browser.featureOff.text: 可在“应用设置 → 设备 → 内置浏览器”中开启浏览器。
zh:settings.bot.browser.featureOff.en: Enable the built-in browser in App Settings → Devices → Built-in browser.

zh:settings.bot.browser.engineCannot.text: 此机器人当前的引擎无法使用内置浏览器。
zh:settings.bot.browser.engineCannot.en: This bot's current engine cannot use the built-in browser.

zh:settings.bot.browser.on.text: 此机器人在电脑面板中拥有专属的浏览器标签页和独立的登录状态，你可以随时查看或接管。
zh:settings.bot.browser.on.en: This bot has its own browser tab in the computer panel, with its own logins. You can watch it or take it over at any time.

zh:settings.bot.browser.off.text: 不允许此机器人使用内置浏览器。
zh:settings.bot.browser.off.en: Keep the built-in browser unavailable to this bot.

zh:settings.bot.browser.switchLabel.text: 为此机器人提供内置浏览器
zh:settings.bot.browser.switchLabel.en: Give this bot a built-in browser

zh:settings.bot.effort.note.text: 新线程的默认思考强度

zh:settings.bot.effort.noteEngineDecides.text: 新线程的默认思考强度（由引擎决定）
zh:settings.bot.effort.noteEngineDecides.en: Default effort for new threads (the engine decides)

zh:settings.bot.computer.note.text: 此机器人的电脑运行位置

zh:settings.bot.computer.noteAuto.text: 此机器人的电脑运行位置（当前：自动）
zh:settings.bot.computer.noteAuto.en: Where this bot's computer runs (currently: auto)

zh:settings.bot.computer.vm.text: 此设备上的虚拟计算机

zh:settings.bot.computer.vpsNote.text: 允许“自动”模式在需要时创建或启动此机器人的托管工作区。
zh:settings.bot.computer.vpsNote.en: Let Auto create or start this bot's hosted workspace when needed.

zh:settings.bot.folder.note.text: 此机器人运行命令和处理文件的位置。
zh:settings.bot.folder.note.en: Where this bot runs commands and works with files.

zh:settings.bot.folder.pathPlaceholder.text: 机器人专属工作区，或完整的文件夹路径
zh:settings.bot.folder.pathPlaceholder.en: Private bot workspace, or a full folder path

zh:settings.bot.folder.pinned.text: 新任务将从这里开始。此任务已固定到 {folder}；如需使用新文件夹，请新建任务。
zh:settings.bot.folder.pinned.en: New tasks start here. This task is pinned to {folder}; start a new task to use the new folder.

zh:settings.bot.memory.note.text: 搜索已保存的知识、查看其来源，并管理此机器人记住的内容。
zh:settings.bot.memory.note.en: Search saved knowledge, inspect its source and manage what this bot remembers.

zh:settings.bot.notebook.note.text: 可编辑的 Markdown 笔记。将其导入托管记忆后即可供回忆使用。
zh:settings.bot.notebook.note.en: Editable Markdown notes. Import them into managed memory to make them available for recall.

zh:settings.bot.notebook.placeholder.text: 此机器人的 Markdown 笔记（可选）。
zh:settings.bot.notebook.placeholder.en: Optional Markdown notes for this bot.

zh:settings.bot.notebook.truncated.text: 内容太长，无法完整作为笔记本指令包含进去。完整文件仍已保存，可添加到机器人的记忆中。
zh:settings.bot.notebook.truncated.en: This is too long to include in full as notebook instructions. The full file is still saved and can be added to the bot's memory.

zh:settings.bot.review.supported.text: 由同一引擎审核普通的批准请求。带有额外限制的操作、无需你参与就开始的工作、对这台电脑的访问以及问题，仍需要你来回应。
zh:settings.bot.review.supported.en: The same engine reviews ordinary approval requests. Actions with extra restrictions, work started without you, access to this computer, and questions still need your response.

zh:settings.bot.review.unsupported.text: 此引擎无法运行单独的审核，因此批准卡片将继续等待你处理。
zh:settings.bot.review.unsupported.en: This engine cannot run a separate review, so approval cards keep waiting for you.

zh:settings.bot.review.offHint.text: 所有未决的批准请求都将等待你处理。
zh:settings.bot.review.offHint.en: Every undecided approval waits for you.

zh:settings.bot.review.shadowHint.text: 记录审核结果，但不批准也不拒绝该操作。
zh:settings.bot.review.shadowHint.en: Record the review without approving or rejecting the action.

zh:settings.bot.review.enforceHint.text: 仅当审核明确批准某项操作时，才自动批准该操作。
zh:settings.bot.review.enforceHint.en: Automatically approve an action only when its review explicitly approves it.

zh:settings.bot.notifications.note.text: 此机器人完成任务或需要输入时通知我
zh:settings.bot.notifications.note.en: Get notified when this bot finishes or needs input

zh:settings.bot.routines.none.text: 此机器人未分配任何例程。
zh:settings.bot.routines.none.en: No routines assigned to this bot.

zh:settings.bot.history.loadFailed.text: 无法加载更早的任务。请重试。
zh:settings.bot.history.loadFailed.en: Could not load older tasks. Try again.

zh:usageCard.caption.subscription.text: 等值：已由你的订阅涵盖

zh:usageCard.caption.metered.text: 按你的 API 密钥统计

zh:usageCard.unpriced.text: 此引擎不报告费用，但其令牌会被统计。
zh:usageCard.unpriced.en: This engine does not report a cost. Its tokens are counted.

zh:usageCard.empty.text: 此机器人尚无用量记录。
zh:usageCard.empty.en: No usage recorded for this bot yet.

zh:widget.aria.card.text: 来自你的机器人的卡片

zh:widget.otherNeeded.text: 请为{label}输入你自己的答案，或选择其中一个选项。
zh:widget.otherNeeded.en: Type your own answer for {label}, or pick one of the options.

zh:widget.sendFailed.text: 没有发送成功。请再试一次。
zh:widget.sendFailed.en: That did not send. Try again.

zh:learnAboutMe.lead.text: 将其他助手已了解的关于你的信息迁移过来。复制此提示词，在那边运行，再将回答粘贴到这里。你可以逐行决定你的机器人保留哪些内容。
zh:learnAboutMe.lead.en: Bring over what another assistant already knows about you. Copy this prompt, run it there, paste the answer here. You decide line by line what your bots keep.

zh:learnAboutMe.promptLabel.text: 在其他助手中运行的提示词
zh:learnAboutMe.promptLabel.en: The prompt to run in your other assistant

zh:learnAboutMe.pasteLabel.en: The answer from your other assistant

zh:learnAboutMe.replaceConfirm.text: 离开而不保留其余内容？

zh:learnAboutMe.refused.chars.text: 该回答长度为 {count} 个字符。单次粘贴最多 {limit} 个字符。请分段粘贴。
zh:learnAboutMe.refused.chars.en: That answer is {count} characters long. One paste can hold up to {limit}. Paste it in parts.

zh:learnAboutMe.refused.lines.text: 该回答共有 {count} 行。单次粘贴最多 {limit} 行。请分段粘贴。
zh:learnAboutMe.refused.lines.en: That answer has {count} lines. One paste can hold up to {limit}. Paste it in parts.

zh:learnAboutMe.banner.text: 此列表仅存在于当前窗口，关闭或重新加载后即会消失。再次粘贴即可恢复：已保留的行会显示为“已知”。
zh:learnAboutMe.banner.en: This list lives only in this window and is gone if you close or reload it. Paste again to bring it back: a line you already kept shows Already known.

zh:learnAboutMe.memoryOff.text: 开启记忆后才能保留内容。
zh:learnAboutMe.memoryOff.en: Turn memory on to keep lines.

zh:learnAboutMe.nothingFound.text: 该回答中没有可查看的内容。请确认它是对上方提示词的回答。
zh:learnAboutMe.nothingFound.en: Nothing to review in that answer. Check that it is the answer to the prompt above.

zh:learnAboutMe.group.instructions.text: 适用于所有机器人的指令

zh:learnAboutMe.dated.text: 来自你的 {provider} 导出内容，日期为 {date}

zh:learnAboutMe.undated.text: 来自你的 {provider} 导出内容，无日期

zh:learnAboutMe.lineText.text: 你的机器人将保留的内容
zh:learnAboutMe.lineText.en: The words your bots will keep

zh:learnAboutMe.flag.tooLong.text: 超过 1,000 个字符，请先缩短

zh:learnAboutMe.flag.dateIgnored.text: 日期格式不正确，已视为无日期
zh:learnAboutMe.flag.dateIgnored.en: The date did not look right, so it reads as undated

zh:memory.exportPaste.line.text: 这看起来像另一个助手的笔记。Murage 没有把它记入记忆。查看一下，保留你想要的内容。
zh:memory.exportPaste.line.en: This reads like notes from another assistant. Murage left it out of memory. Review it to keep the lines you want.

zh:learnAboutMe.forgotten.text: 已遗忘，相关内容已删除。

zh:learnAboutMe.done.text: 已全部查看。你的机器人现在已了解你保留的内容，你可以在“设置 > 记忆”中遗忘任意一行。
zh:learnAboutMe.done.en: All reviewed. Your bots now know what you kept, and you can forget any line in Settings > Memory.

zh:learnAboutMe.error.conflict.text: 此行已以其他措辞保留。请重新粘贴以重新查看。
zh:learnAboutMe.error.conflict.en: This line was already kept with other words. Paste again to review it fresh.

zh:memoryReview.forgottenWords.text: 已忘记。其中的文字已删除。

zh:settings.bot.phoneForBots.description.text: 选择你的机器人可以在这部手机上使用什么。
zh:settings.bot.phoneForBots.description.en: Choose what your bots can use on this phone.

zh:phone.ask.settingTitle.text: 从这部手机分享并提问
zh:phone.ask.settingTitle.en: Share and ask from this phone

zh:phone.ask.settingOff.text: 这部手机已关闭分享和提问。
zh:phone.ask.settingOff.en: Sharing and asking are off for this phone.

zh:phone.ask.errorGone.text: 该聊天已不可用，请另选一个。
zh:phone.ask.errorGone.en: That chat is no longer available. Pick another.

zh:phone.ask.errorUpdate.text: 请在你的电脑上更新 Murage 以使用此功能。
zh:phone.ask.errorUpdate.en: Update Murage on your computer to use this.

zh:phone.ask.errorSetup.text: 请打开 Murage，重新设置分享。
zh:phone.ask.errorSetup.en: Open Murage to set up sharing again.

zh:phone.removal.pendingBody.text: Murage 会继续尝试移除这部手机。
zh:phone.removal.pendingBody.en: Murage will keep trying to remove this phone.

zh:engineSignIn.waitingBrowser.en: Waiting for you in the browser

zh:engineSignIn.desktop.account.text: 这会为此电脑上使用 {label} 的所有机器人登录。登录信息保存在 {folder}。
zh:engineSignIn.desktop.account.en: This signs {label} in for every bot that uses it on this computer. The sign-in is saved in {folder}.

zh:engineSignIn.terminal.line.text: {label} 通过 Terminal 窗口登录。Murage 会打开它，登录已在运行。
zh:engineSignIn.terminal.line.en: {label} signs in from a Terminal window. Murage opens it with the sign-in already running.

zh:engineSignIn.terminal.opened.text: Terminal 已打开。请在那里完成 {label} 登录，然后回到这里。
zh:engineSignIn.terminal.opened.en: Terminal is open. Finish signing in to {label} there, then come back here.

zh:engineSignIn.terminal.failed.en: Could not open Terminal. Try again.

zh:engineSignIn.none.text: Murage 无法为你启动此登录。请在终端中登录 {label}，然后再次检查。
zh:engineSignIn.none.en: Murage cannot start this sign-in for you. Sign in to {label} in your terminal, then check again.

zh:engineSignIn.elsewhere.text: 请在运行 Murage 的电脑上完成登录。
zh:engineSignIn.elsewhere.en: Finish sign-in on the computer running Murage.

zh:engineSignIn.setupLine.text: 登录一次，然后在下方再次检查。
zh:engineSignIn.setupLine.en: Sign in once, then check again below.

zh:engineInstall.failed.text: 无法更新此引擎。请重试。
zh:engineInstall.failed.en: Could not update this engine. Try again.

zh:engineCheck.line.text: 你似乎已登录。一条简短回复可以确认它能正常工作，并会用掉你套餐的一小部分。
zh:engineCheck.line.en: You look signed in. One short reply shows it works, and uses a small part of your plan.

zh:engineCheck.checking.text: 正在请求一条简短回复…

zh:engineSignIn.notFinished.text: 登录未完成。请关闭此窗口，准备好后重试。
zh:engineSignIn.notFinished.en: The sign-in did not finish. Close this and try again when you are ready.

zh:engineSignIn.failed.text: 登录没有成功。请关闭此窗口后重试。
zh:engineSignIn.failed.en: The sign-in did not work. Close this and try again.

zh:engineSignIn.startFailed.text: 无法启动登录。请关闭此窗口后重试。
zh:engineSignIn.startFailed.en: Could not start the sign-in. Close this and try again.

zh:engineWall.needsOwnAccount.text: {name} 需要你自己的 {name} 账户才能登录。
zh:engineWall.needsOwnAccount.en: {name} needs your own {name} account to sign in.

zh:calls.botSettings.canCallMeHelp.text: {bot} 只会为你在下方选择的事情打电话，其他一律发消息。
zh:calls.botSettings.canCallMeHelp.en: {bot} rings you for the things you choose below. Everything else stays a message.

zh:calls.botSettings.neededNow.text: 当 {bot} 认为现在需要你时

zh:calls.botSettings.tierBHelp.text: 先以消息发送。如果你 10 分钟内没有查看，会响铃一次；免打扰时段、忙碌时间或其他通话期间从不响铃。
zh:calls.botSettings.tierBHelp.en: Starts as a message. Rings once if you haven't seen it in 10 minutes, never during quiet hours, busy time or another call.

zh:calls.botSettings.botCaps.text: 此机器人每小时最多打 2 次电话，每天最多 6 次。
zh:calls.botSettings.botCaps.en: Up to 2 calls an hour and 6 a day from this bot.

zh:calls.botSettings.needsVoice.text: 通话需要语音。连接 Flux，或在“设置 > 模型”中添加语音提供方。
zh:calls.botSettings.needsVoice.en: Calls need a voice. Connect Flux or add a voice provider in Settings > Models.

zh:calls.botSettings.pausedAfterRestore.en: Calls are paused after a restore

zh:calls.failed.en: That didn't go through. Try again.

zh:roomShare.askRow.text: {name} 请你分享它对话中的一些内容。
zh:roomShare.askRow.en: {name} asked you to share something from its chats.

zh:roomShare.cardCopy.text: 这些摘录会原样成为房间内容。机器人可能会通过工具转发它们，你之后添加的人也可能看到。
zh:roomShare.cardCopy.en: These exact excerpts become room content. Bots may send them on through their tools, and people you add later may see them.

zh:roomShare.empty.text: 它的对话中没有匹配的内容，所以没有可分享的。
zh:roomShare.empty.en: Nothing in its chats matched, so there is nothing to share.

zh:roomShare.shared.text: 已分享。{name} 会在下一次回复中使用它。
zh:roomShare.shared.en: Shared. {name} will use it in its next reply.

zh:roomShare.closed.en: This request is no longer open.

zh:roomShare.failed.en: That did not go through. Try again.

zh:roomShare.fromChatsOf.text: 从哪个机器人的对话中

zh:roomShare.sharedFrom.text: 分享自你与 {name} 的对话

zh:approveAll.caution.look.text: 请先看一下这些请求。每一个都会让机器人替你做一件事，比如运行命令或编辑文件，一旦做完，Murage 无法撤回。
zh:approveAll.caution.look.en: Please look over these requests first. Each one lets a bot do something for you, such as run a command or edit files, and once it has done it, Murage can't take it back.

zh:approveAll.caution.leavesOut.text: 全部批准会给每个请求一次性的同意，和你手动给的一样。它不包括付款、电子邮件、发布、在机器人文件夹之外删除、给新联系人的第一条消息、由例行任务或外部消息发起的任何内容，以及 Murage 暂停下来需要仔细查看的任何内容。这些会留在这里，由你逐个回答。
zh:approveAll.caution.leavesOut.en: Approve all gives each request the same one-time yes you would give it by hand. It leaves out payments, email, publishing, deleting outside a bot's folder, a first message to someone new, anything a routine or an outside message started, and anything Murage held for a closer look. Those stay here for you to answer one by one.

zh:approveAll.sheet.more.text: 前 25 个。再按一次全部批准处理其余的。
zh:approveAll.sheet.more.en: The first 25. Press Approve all again for the rest.

zh:approveAll.sheet.footer.text: 每个只运行一次，就像你点了允许一次。之后到达的请求会留在收件箱里。
zh:approveAll.sheet.footer.en: Each one runs once, as if you tapped Allow once. Requests that arrive after this stay in your Inbox.

zh:approveAll.reason.unattended.en: started by a message from outside

zh:approveAll.reason.truncated.text: 太长无法在此显示，请打开查看
zh:approveAll.reason.truncated.en: too long to show here, open it

zh:approveAll.result.done.one.text: 已批准 {n} 个。它正在运行，无法撤销。要停止机器人，请打开它的聊天并按停止。
zh:approveAll.result.done.one.en: Approved {n}. It is running now and can't be undone. To stop a bot, open its chat and press Stop.

zh:approveAll.result.done.other.text: 已批准 {n} 个。它们正在运行，无法撤销。要停止机器人，请打开它的聊天并按停止。
zh:approveAll.result.done.other.en: Approved {n}. They are running now and can't be undone. To stop a bot, open its chat and press Stop.

zh:approveAll.result.stopped.one.text: 已批准 {n} 个。{m} 个未批准，因为 {bot} 已不再等待。它仍在你的收件箱里。
zh:approveAll.result.stopped.one.en: Approved {n}. {m} was not approved because {bot} had stopped waiting. It is still in your Inbox.

zh:approveAll.result.stopped.other.text: 已批准 {n} 个。{m} 个未批准，因为 {bot} 已不再等待。它们仍在你的收件箱里。
zh:approveAll.result.stopped.other.en: Approved {n}. {m} were not approved because {bot} had stopped waiting. They are still in your Inbox.

zh:approveAll.result.left.one.text: 另有 {m} 个请求在你回答前发生了变化。它仍在你的收件箱里。
zh:approveAll.result.left.one.en: {m} other request changed before you answered. It's still in your Inbox.

zh:approveAll.result.left.other.text: 另有 {m} 个请求在你回答前发生了变化。它们仍在你的收件箱里。
zh:approveAll.result.left.other.en: {m} other requests changed before you answered. They're still in your Inbox.

zh:approveAll.deviceReason.one.text: 批准来自 {bots} 的 {n} 个请求

zh:approveAll.deviceReason.other.text: 批准来自 {bots} 的 {n} 个请求

zh:approveAll.settings.reset.text: 再次显示全部批准提醒
zh:approveAll.settings.reset.en: Show the Approve all reminder again

zh:approveAll.settings.done.text: 下次你按全部批准时会显示提醒。
zh:approveAll.settings.done.en: The reminder will show the next time you press Approve all.

zh:approveAll.changed.text: 列表已变化。请再按一次全部批准。
zh:approveAll.changed.en: The list changed. Press Approve all again.

zh:approveAll.caution.body.text: 全部批准会给列表中的每一步同样的批准，就像你在那一行按批准一样。付款、删除、读取密钥或给别人发消息的步骤仍保留各自的按钮。
zh:approveAll.caution.body.en: Approve all gives each listed step the same Approve you would press on its row. Steps that pay, delete, read keys or message people keep their own button.

zh:ux.l6c.levers.text: 想暂时停用某个客户？打开该客户的工作区，然后在例行任务中暂停其例行任务，在设置中解除其消息应用的关联，并在设置中断开 Flux Router。要继续，请恢复例行任务、重新关联应用并重新连接 Flux Router。
zh:ux.l6c.levers.en: Need to stop a client for now? Open their workspace, then pause its routines in Routines, unlink its messaging apps in Settings, and disconnect Flux Router in Settings. To carry on, resume the routines, link the apps again and reconnect Flux Router.

zh:ux.l2c.month.billed.text: 本月通过 Flux 的聊天花费：{amount}
zh:ux.l2c.month.billed.en: Chat spend through Flux this month: {amount}

zh:ux.l2c.month.ofLimit.text: 通过 Flux 的聊天花费：{amount} / {limit} · {percent}%

zh:ux.l2c.month.chatOnly.text: 统计的是聊天用量。图片、语音和搜索即将加入。
zh:ux.l2c.month.chatOnly.en: Counts chat use. Images, voice and search are added soon.

zh:ux.l2c.month.pending.text: Flux 报告后，花费会显示在这里
zh:ux.l2c.month.pending.en: Spending will show here once Flux reports it

zh:ux.l2c.month.multiKey.text: 账户总额将随下一次 Flux 更新提供
zh:ux.l2c.month.multiKey.en: Account total arrives with the next Flux update

zh:ux.l2c.month.noLimit.text: 还没有每月上限。建议：每月 {suggested}。
zh:ux.l2c.month.noLimit.en: No monthly limit yet. Suggested: {suggested} a month.

zh:ux.l2c.headsUp.warn.text: 你已用到每月 {limit} 上限的 {percent}%
zh:ux.l2c.headsUp.warn.en: You are at {percent}% of your {limit} monthly limit

zh:ux.l2c.headsUp.limit.text: 你已达到每月 {limit} 的上限

zh:ux.l2c.headsUp.sub.text: 这只是提醒。你的机器人会继续工作。
zh:ux.l2c.headsUp.sub.en: This is a heads-up only. Your bots keep working.

zh:ux.l2c.headsUp.leaveFailed.en: Could not save that. Try again.

zh:ux.l2c.usage.subtitle.text: Flux 本月的计费金额，与你设定的上限对比。
zh:ux.l2c.usage.subtitle.en: What Flux billed this month, against a limit you choose.

zh:ux.l2c.usage.limitLine.text: 每月上限：{limit}。到达 80% 和上限时，“今天”页面会通知你。这只是提醒，你的机器人会继续工作。
zh:ux.l2c.usage.limitLine.en: Monthly limit: {limit}. At 80% and at the limit, Today tells you. It is a heads-up only, and your bots keep working.

zh:ux.l2c.usage.noLimit.en: No limit yet. Suggested: {suggested} a month.

zh:ux.l2c.usage.invalid.en: Type a dollar figure, such as 1000.

zh:ux.l2c.usage.fluxOnly.text: 这些数字来自 Flux 本身，可能会延迟几分钟。月份按 Flux 的计费月计算。
zh:ux.l2c.usage.fluxOnly.en: These figures come from Flux itself and can trail by a few minutes. The month is Flux's billing month.

zh:ux.l2c.needs.meta.text: 每月上限 · 仅作提醒

zh:ux.l5b.when.limitReset.text: 每次引擎的额度重置时
zh:ux.l5b.when.limitReset.en: Each time the engine's limit resets

zh:ux.l5b.when.appEvent.text: 已连接的应用发来事件时
zh:ux.l5b.when.appEvent.en: When a connected app sends an event

zh:ux.l5b.runs.none.text: 还没有运行记录。第一次在 {when}。
zh:ux.l5b.runs.none.en: No runs yet. The first one is {when}.

zh:ux.l5b.deleteAsk.text: 删除 {name}？删除后无法恢复。过去的运行仍保留在历史记录中。
zh:ux.l5b.deleteAsk.en: Delete {name}? This cannot be taken back. Past runs stay in the history.

zh:ux.l5b.paused.toast.text: {name} 已暂停。你可以随时在这里恢复。
zh:ux.l5b.paused.toast.en: {name} is paused. Resume it any time from here.

zh:ux.l5b.started.toast.text: {name} 正在运行。它的报告会出现在“最近运行”中。
zh:ux.l5b.started.toast.en: {name} is running now. Its report lands in Last runs.

zh:ux.l5b.desktopOnly.text: 请在桌面应用中更改、暂停或删除例行任务。你仍然可以立即运行这一个。
zh:ux.l5b.desktopOnly.en: Change, pause or delete routines in the desktop app. You can still run this one now.

zh:ux.l5b.list.empty.text: 还没有例行任务。用一句话开始一个吧。
zh:ux.l5b.list.empty.en: No routines yet. Start one from a sentence.

zh:ux.l5b.new.prompt.text: 说说要做什么、什么时候做
zh:ux.l5b.new.prompt.en: Say what to do and when

zh:ux.l5b.new.placeholder.text: 每个工作日 8 点，给我发一份简报
zh:ux.l5b.new.placeholder.en: Every weekday at 8, send me a brief

zh:ux.l5b.new.askHint.text: {bot} 会在聊天中读取这句话，并给你看待批准的例行任务。
zh:ux.l5b.new.askHint.en: {bot} reads the sentence in chat and shows you the routine to approve.

zh:ux.l5b.new.noBot.text: 请先雇用一个机器人，再给它安排例行任务。
zh:ux.l5b.new.noBot.en: Hire a bot first, then give it a routine.

zh:ux.l5b.limit.after.text: 如果 {time} 后仍在运行，则停止

zh:ux.l6a.hire.placeholder.text: 例如：催收未付发票，并跟进客户
zh:ux.l6a.hire.placeholder.en: For example: chase unpaid invoices and follow up with clients

zh:ux.l6a.hire.level.text: {name} 从 {level} 开始，所以行动前会先问你。你可以在它的设置中更改。
zh:ux.l6a.hire.level.en: {name} starts on {level}, so it checks with you before it acts. You can change that in its settings.

zh:ux.l6a.hire.tooShort.text: 请先简单说说这份工作。
zh:ux.l6a.hire.tooShort.en: Say a few words about the job first.

zh:ux.l6a.hire.failed.text: 没有雇用成功。请再试一次。
zh:ux.l6a.hire.failed.en: That bot was not hired. Try once more.

zh:ux.l6a.today.bareTitle.text: 你的机器人首先需要一个大脑
zh:ux.l6a.today.bareTitle.en: Your bots need a brain first

zh:ux.l6a.today.bareSub.text: 连接 Flux Router，或在这台电脑上登录一个 AI 工具。
zh:ux.l6a.today.bareSub.en: Connect Flux Router, or sign in to an AI tool on this computer.

zh:ux.l6a.today.left.text: 再看 {n} 张简短卡片，就能看到你的第一个结果。
zh:ux.l6a.today.left.en: {n} short cards, then your first result.

zh:ux.l6a.today.leftOne.text: 再看一张简短卡片，就能看到你的第一个结果。
zh:ux.l6a.today.leftOne.en: One short card, then your first result.

zh:ux.l6a.today.resultNext.text: 接下来就是你的第一个结果。

zh:ux.l6a.connect.waiting.text: 我会在这里等。准备好后再连接 {app}。
zh:ux.l6a.connect.waiting.en: I will wait here. Connect {app} when you are ready.

zh:ux.l7.level.onComputer.text: 完全访问和无限制在你的电脑上设置，在那里你可以看到它们改变了什么。
zh:ux.l7.level.onComputer.en: Full access and No limits are set on your computer, where you can see what they change.

zh:ux.l7.level.chatScope.text: 这会更改此聊天的级别。例行任务保留各自的级别。
zh:ux.l7.level.chatScope.en: This changes the level for this chat. Routines keep their own.

zh:ux.l7.level.routineScope.text: 此例行任务跟随这个级别。

zh:ux.l7.routines.empty.text: 本周没有安排运行的任务。
zh:ux.l7.routines.empty.en: Nothing is set to run this week.

zh:ux.l7.alerts.title.text: 机器人需要你时收到提醒
zh:ux.l7.alerts.title.en: Get an alert when a bot needs you

zh:ux.l7.alerts.sub.text: 当机器人提出问题或需要你同意时，你的手机会通知你。
zh:ux.l7.alerts.sub.en: Your phone tells you when a bot asks a question or wants your OK.

zh:ux.l7.pay.line.text: 目前账单在你的电脑上。请打开桌面版 Murage 查看。
zh:ux.l7.pay.line.en: Billing lives on your computer for now. Open Murage on desktop to see it.

zh:folderTrust.chosenLabel.text: 你选择了信任此文件夹。应用你的选择时，Fuigo 会引入 {sources}。指令将在此文件夹的新对话中生效。
zh:folderTrust.chosenLabel.en: You chose to trust this folder. Fuigo brings in {sources} when applying your choice. Instructions apply in a new conversation in this folder.

zh:folderTrust.chosenDescription.text: Fuigo 会自行应用你的选择。工具和钩子（自动执行的操作）可以在机器人处理此消息时加载。指令将在此文件夹的新对话中生效。
zh:folderTrust.chosenDescription.en: Fuigo applies your choice itself. Tools and hooks (automatic actions) can load while the bot handles this message. Instructions apply in a new conversation in this folder.

zh:folderTrust.forgetToAsk.text: 若想再次被询问，请在此对话的文件夹设置中忘记 {key}。
zh:folderTrust.forgetToAsk.en: To be asked again, forget {key} in this conversation's folder settings.

zh:folderTrust.passedLabel.text: 你选择了不信任 {key}，Murage 已把这个答案告知 Fuigo，适用于此文件夹。若要更改，请在此对话的文件夹设置中忘记 {key}。
zh:folderTrust.passedLabel.en: You chose not to trust {key}, and Murage passed that answer to Fuigo for this folder. To change it, forget {key} in this conversation's folder settings.

zh:folderTrust.moreDeclines.text: 这可能包含的所有文件夹

zh:composer.queue.count.text: {count} 条消息已排队，等待下一回合
zh:composer.queue.count.en: {count} messages queued for the next turn

zh:composer.queue.countShort.text: {count} 条已排队，等待下一回合

zh:composer.queue.hint.en: Click a message to see all of it.

zh:composer.queue.hintPhone.en: Tap a message to see all of it.

zh:folderTrust.rowUnstamped.text: 在 Fuigo 1.0.35 之前已信任。Fuigo 会再询问一次
zh:folderTrust.rowUnstamped.en: Trusted before Fuigo 1.0.35. Fuigo asks once more

zh:folderTrust.otherFoldersNote.text: 即使此文件夹的仓库列在其他路径下，Fuigo 也可以采用针对它的决定。
zh:folderTrust.otherFoldersNote.en: Fuigo can count a decision for this folder's repository even when it is listed under another path.

zh:folderTrust.forgetReject.text: Murage 会忘记这个答案。其他信任决定仍然有效，所以 Fuigo 可能不再询问而继续。
zh:folderTrust.forgetReject.en: Murage forgets this answer. Other trust decisions still apply, so Fuigo may continue without asking.

zh:folderTrust.forgetTrustOwn.text: 移除 Murage 的决定。在你删除 {path} 中对应的那一行之前，你自己的 Fuigo 会继续信任 {key}。
zh:folderTrust.forgetTrustOwn.en: Removes Murage's decision. Your own Fuigo keeps trusting {key} until you delete its line in {path}.

zh:folderTrust.storedNo.text: 你自己的 Fuigo 设置为不信任 {key}。若要更改，请删除 {path} 中对应的那一行，然后重新发送消息。
zh:folderTrust.storedNo.en: Your own Fuigo says don't trust {key}. To change that, delete its line in {path} and send the message again.

zh:folderTrust.unreadable.text: 无法读取位于 {path} 的 Fuigo 信任文件，因此这里没有任何内容被信任。请确保 Fuigo 能读取它，且其内容正确使用了 TOML（一种设置文件格式），或者删除该文件。然后重新发送消息。
zh:folderTrust.unreadable.en: Fuigo's trust file at {path} could not be read, so nothing is trusted here. Make sure Fuigo can read it and that its contents correctly use TOML, a settings file format, or remove the file. Then send the message again.

zh:ux.l1.why.messageNew.text: {name}是新联系人，所以{bot}先问你。发送后，{name}就算已知联系人了。
zh:ux.l1.why.messageNew.en: {bot} asked because {name} is someone new. Once this goes, {name} counts as known.

zh:ux.l1.why.messageNewAsk.text: {name}是新联系人，所以{bot}先问你。发送后，{name}就算已知联系人了。在“询问”级别，每次发送都会先问你。
zh:ux.l1.why.messageNewAsk.en: {bot} asked because {name} is someone new. Once this goes, {name} counts as known. At Ask, every send asks.

zh:ux.l1.why.messageSeveral.text: 其中有 {n} 位是新联系人，所以{bot}先问你。
zh:ux.l1.why.messageSeveral.en: {bot} asked because {n} of these people are new.

zh:ux.l1.why.messagePublic.text: 这会在{where}公开发布，所以{bot}先问你。
zh:ux.l1.why.messagePublic.en: {bot} asked because this posts in public on {where}.

zh:ux.l1.why.deleteOutside.text: 这会删除它自己文件夹之外的内容，所以{bot}先问你。
zh:ux.l1.why.deleteOutside.en: {bot} asked because this deletes outside its own folder.

zh:ux.l1.why.deleteOn.text: 这会在{place}上删除内容，所以{bot}先问你。

zh:ux.l1.why.pay.text: 在“询问”“自动”和“完全访问”级别，支付都会先问你，所以{bot}先问你。
zh:ux.l1.why.pay.en: {bot} asked because paying asks at Ask, Auto and Full access.

zh:ux.l1.why.payRoutine.text: 例行任务每次运行时，支付都会先问你。
zh:ux.l1.why.payRoutine.en: Paying asks on every routine run.

zh:ux.l1.why.askOwner.text: {bot}在“询问”级别：每个操作都需要你批准，所以先问你。
zh:ux.l1.why.askOwner.en: {bot} asked because it is on Ask: you approve each action.

zh:ux.l1.why.askRoutine.text: {routine}的这次运行在“询问”级别，所以{bot}先问你。
zh:ux.l1.why.askRoutine.en: {bot} asked because this run of {routine} is at Ask.

zh:ux.l1.why.webhook.text: 这是从触发链接开始的，所以{bot}会每一步都和你确认。
zh:ux.l1.why.webhook.en: {bot} asked because this started from a trigger link, so it does each step with you.

zh:ux.l1.why.channel.text: 这来自{channel}，所以{bot}先问你。只有在“完全访问”下打开相应选项后，你在那里发的消息才会跳过审批。
zh:ux.l1.why.channel.en: {bot} asked because this came in from {channel}. Your own messages there skip approvals only when you turn that on under Full access.

zh:ux.l1.why.channelUnnamed.text: 这来自一条频道消息，所以{bot}先问你。只有在“完全访问”下打开相应选项后，你在那里发的消息才会跳过审批。
zh:ux.l1.why.channelUnnamed.en: {bot} asked because this came in from a channel message. Your own messages there skip approvals only when you turn that on under Full access.

zh:ux.l1.why.unattended.text: 这不是从你的电脑或手机上开始的，所以{bot}会每一步都和你确认。
zh:ux.l1.why.unattended.en: {bot} asked because nobody started this from your computer or your phone, so it does each step with you.

zh:ux.l1.why.alwaysAsk.text: 这可能会清空这台电脑，所以 Murage 在任何级别下都会每次询问。
zh:ux.l1.why.alwaysAsk.en: This could wipe this computer, so Murage asks every time, at every level.

zh:ux.l1.why.unreadable.text: Murage 无法读懂这条命令，所以运行前会先问你。
zh:ux.l1.why.unreadable.en: Murage could not read this command, so it asks you before it runs.

zh:ux.l1.why.sensitiveGuard.text: 这会读取密钥或密码文件，所以 Murage 在任何级别下都会询问。
zh:ux.l1.why.sensitiveGuard.en: This reads a key or password file, so Murage asks at every level.

zh:ux.l1.why.unreadCall.text: Murage 无法完整读懂这个操作，所以会先问你。如果没问题，请允许一次。
zh:ux.l1.why.unreadCall.en: Murage could not read all of this, so it asks. Allow it once if it is right.

zh:ux.l1.why.destructiveGuard.text: 这看起来有破坏性，所以“自动”级别会询问。“完全访问”则不问直接运行。
zh:ux.l1.why.destructiveGuard.en: This looks destructive, so Auto asks. Full access runs it without asking.

zh:ux.l1.why.promptGuard.text: 这条命令可能会等待一个没人看得到的密码或输入，所以 Murage 会先问你。
zh:ux.l1.why.promptGuard.en: This command may wait for a password or input nobody would see, so Murage asks.

zh:ux.l1.why.stopGrantNote.text: Murage 不会再就{place}询问你。如果命令可能等待输入，或要读取密钥，它仍会询问。
zh:ux.l1.why.stopGrantNote.en: Murage will not ask about {place} again. It still asks when a command could wait for input or reads a key.

zh:ux.l1.why.recipientNotNoted.text: Murage 没能把{name}记为已知联系人，所以下次给{name}发邮件时会再问一次。
zh:ux.l1.why.recipientNotNoted.en: Murage could not note {name} as known, so the next email to {name} asks again.

zh:ux.l1.fold.footer.text: {bot}保持在{level}。你可以随时在 {bot} › 级别 下收回这些选择。
zh:ux.l1.fold.footer.en: {bot} stays on {level}. Take any of these back under {bot} › Level.

zh:ux.l1.fold.footerPhone.text: {bot}保持在{level}。这里可以收回本次对话和例行任务的选择；机器人级别的选择请在你的电脑上收回。
zh:ux.l1.fold.footerPhone.en: {bot} stays on {level}. Take back this conversation's and routine choices here; bot-level ones on your computer.

zh:ux.l1.fold.onComputer.text: 允许在你的电脑上执行此操作

zh:ux.l1.row.taskFolder.text: 在本次对话中 12 小时内，在{folder}
zh:ux.l1.row.taskFolder.en: For 12 hours in this conversation, in {folder}

zh:ux.l1.row.taskPlace.text: 在本次对话中 12 小时内，在{place}
zh:ux.l1.row.taskPlace.en: For 12 hours in this conversation, on {place}

zh:ux.l1.row.taskCommand.text: 在本次对话中 12 小时内，针对这条命令
zh:ux.l1.row.taskCommand.en: For 12 hours in this conversation, for this command

zh:ux.l1.row.taskPayee.text: 在本次对话中 12 小时内，支付给{payee}
zh:ux.l1.row.taskPayee.en: For 12 hours in this conversation, to {payee}

zh:ux.l1.row.alwaysFolder.text: 始终允许，在{folder}中删除（包括其子文件夹）
zh:ux.l1.row.alwaysFolder.en: Always, for deleting in {folder} (covers its subfolders)

zh:ux.l1.row.alwaysUnplaced.text: 始终允许，这里的这条完全相同的命令（任何引擎，相同的文件夹和文本）
zh:ux.l1.row.alwaysUnplaced.en: Always, this exact command here (any engine, same folder and text)

zh:ux.l1.row.alwaysExact.text: 始终允许，这里的这条完全相同的命令（此引擎，此文件夹）
zh:ux.l1.row.alwaysExact.en: Always, this exact command here (this engine, this folder)

zh:ux.l1.row.alwaysProgram.text: 始终允许，{bot}运行的任何{program}命令

zh:ux.l1.row.alwaysSet.text: 始终允许，这 {n} 个操作：{list}

zh:ux.l1.outcome.stopped.text: {bot}不再等待这件事了。请再问它一次。
zh:ux.l1.outcome.stopped.en: {bot} stopped waiting for this. Ask it again.

zh:ux.l1.added.nothingNew.text: 已批准。{bot}本来就有这项设置，所以没有新增内容。
zh:ux.l1.added.nothingNew.en: Approved. {bot} already had this, so nothing new was added.

zh:ux.l1.added.takenBack.text: 已收回。已经完成的操作不受影响。
zh:ux.l1.added.takenBack.en: Taken back. Anything already done stays done.

zh:ux.l1.added.partial.text: 其中一部分没能收回。仍保留：{list}。
zh:ux.l1.added.partial.en: Some of this was not taken back. Still kept: {list}.

zh:ux.l1.added.onComputer.text: 请在你的电脑上，到 {bot} › 级别 下收回。
zh:ux.l1.added.onComputer.en: Take this back on your computer, under {bot} › Level.

zh:ux.l1.settings.title.en: Things you said yes to for good

zh:ux.l1.settings.intro.text: {bot}会不经询问直接做这些事。付款许可不会保存在这里：每次都会询问，除非你在一次对话中允许 12 小时内付款。
zh:ux.l1.settings.intro.en: {bot} does these without asking. Permission to pay is never saved here: it asks each time, unless you allow payments for 12 hours in one conversation.

zh:ux.l1.settings.empty.text: 暂时没有。你在审批时选择“始终允许”后，就会显示在这里。
zh:ux.l1.settings.empty.en: Nothing yet. When you choose Always on an approval, it shows up here.

zh:ux.l1.settings.couldNot.en: Could not take it back. Try again.

zh:ux.l1.settings.task.text: 在打开的对话中未来 12 小时内允许：{n}
zh:ux.l1.settings.task.en: Allowed for the next 12 hours in open conversations: {n}

zh:ux.l1.settings.clearLabel.text: 清除在打开的对话中未来 12 小时内允许的事项
zh:ux.l1.settings.clearLabel.en: Clear what is allowed for the next 12 hours in open conversations

zh:ux.l1.settings.couldNotClear.en: Could not clear them. Try again.

zh:ux.l1.level.chipHeader.text: 只会更改本次对话。例行任务保持各自的级别。{bot}对新对话的默认级别是{level}，可在 {bot} › 级别 下更改。
zh:ux.l1.level.chipHeader.en: Changes this conversation only. Routines keep their own level. {bot}'s default for new conversations is {level}, under {bot} › Level.

zh:ux.l1.level.askDetail.text: 需要你点头的每个操作之前都会先问你。在它自己的文件夹里写入则直接进行。
zh:ux.l1.level.askDetail.en: Asks before each action that needs your yes. Writing in its own folder goes ahead.

zh:ux.l1.level.autoDetail.text: 支付、给新联系人发邮件、公开发布、删除它文件夹之外的内容之前，会先问你。
zh:ux.l1.level.autoDetail.en: Asks before paying, emailing someone new, posting in public, or deleting outside its folder.

zh:ux.l1.level.fullDetail.text: 支付、给新联系人发邮件、公开发布、删除它文件夹之外的内容，或读取你的密钥和密码之前，仍会先问你。
zh:ux.l1.level.fullDetail.en: Still asks before paying, emailing someone new, posting in public, deleting outside its folder, or reading your keys and passwords.

zh:ux.l1.level.tableHeading.text: 在没有任何事先允许的情况下，各级别的做法
zh:ux.l1.level.tableHeading.en: What each level does when nothing has been approved yet

zh:ux.l1.level.row.read-given.text: 读取交给它的邮件、日历和文件
zh:ux.l1.level.row.read-given.en: Read email, calendar and files it was given

zh:ux.l1.level.row.write-own-folder.text: 在它自己的文件夹里写入

zh:ux.l1.level.row.destructive-inside-or.text: 在它的文件夹内看起来有破坏性的命令，或可能等待输入的命令
zh:ux.l1.level.row.destructive-inside-or.en: A command that looks destructive inside its folder, or may wait for input

zh:ux.l1.level.row.message-known.text: 给之前联系过的人发邮件或消息
zh:ux.l1.level.row.message-known.en: Email or message someone it has written to before

zh:ux.l1.level.row.someone-new-or-public.text: 给新联系人发邮件，或公开发布
zh:ux.l1.level.row.someone-new-or-public.en: Email someone new, or post in public

zh:ux.l1.level.row.delete-outside.text: 在它自己的文件夹之外、GitHub 上或数据库中删除
zh:ux.l1.level.row.delete-outside.en: Delete outside its own folder, on GitHub or in a database

zh:ux.l1.level.row.contact-bot.text: 联系其他机器人（当“联系其他机器人前先问我”开启时）
zh:ux.l1.level.row.contact-bot.en: Contact another bot (when "Ask me before contacting other bots" is on)

zh:ux.l1.level.row.wipe-command.text: 可能清空这台电脑的命令
zh:ux.l1.level.row.wipe-command.en: A command that could wipe this computer

zh:ux.l1.level.stopColumn.text: 新联系人、公开发布、删除它文件夹之外的内容或支付
zh:ux.l1.level.stopColumn.en: Someone new, a public post, a delete outside its folder or a payment

zh:ux.l1.level.other.owner-channel.text: 你从 Telegram、Slack 或 Discord 发来的消息
zh:ux.l1.level.other.owner-channel.en: Your messages from Telegram, Slack or Discord

zh:ux.l1.level.other.other-channel-or-we.text: 其他人的频道消息，或触发链接
zh:ux.l1.level.other.other-channel-or-we.en: Anyone else's channel message, or a trigger link

zh:ux.l1.level.cell.lower-of-ceiling.text: 按例行任务级别和此级别中较低的一个运行
zh:ux.l1.level.cell.lower-of-ceiling.en: Runs at the lower of the routine's level and this one

zh:ux.l1.level.cell.asks-unless-routine-.text: 询问，除非已为该例行任务允许
zh:ux.l1.level.cell.asks-unless-routine-.en: Asks, unless allowed for the routine

zh:ux.l1.level.cell.goes-ahead-with-opti.text: 仅在开启“也跳过我自己消息的审批”时直接进行
zh:ux.l1.level.cell.goes-ahead-with-opti.en: Goes ahead only with "Also skip approvals for my messages" on

zh:ux.l1.level.note.never-for-payment.text: 例行任务中的支付永远不会被允许。
zh:ux.l1.level.note.never-for-payment.en: A payment is never allowed for a routine.

zh:ux.l1.level.note.reads-and-own-folder.text: 读取和在它自己的文件夹里开展工作仍会直接进行。
zh:ux.l1.level.note.reads-and-own-folder.en: Reading and work in its own folder still go ahead.

zh:ux.l1.level.underTable.text: 例行任务保持各自的级别，运行时不会高于此级别。你从 Telegram、Slack 和 Discord 发来的消息会每一步都询问，除非你在“完全访问”下将其关闭。拒绝规则和禁止清单在任何级别下都适用。
zh:ux.l1.level.underTable.en: Routines keep their own level and never run above this one. For your messages from Telegram, Slack and Discord, it asks at each step unless you turn that off under Full access. Deny rules and the never-list apply at every level.

zh:ux.l1.level.lockLine.text: “完全访问”和“无限制”需要在你的电脑上设置，在那里你可以看到它们会改变什么。
zh:ux.l1.level.lockLine.en: Full access and No limits are set on your computer, where you can see what they change.

zh:ux.l1.confirm.fullBody.text: {level}会让{bot}运行命令、编辑文件、与其他机器人协作时不再询问。
zh:ux.l1.confirm.fullBody.en: {level} lets {bot} run commands, edit files and work with other bots without asking.

zh:ux.l1.confirm.fullStill.text: 支付、给新联系人发邮件、公开发布、删除它文件夹之外的内容，或读取你的密钥和密码之前，仍会先问你。
zh:ux.l1.confirm.fullStill.en: It still asks before paying, emailing someone new, posting in public, deleting outside its folder, or reading your keys and passwords.

zh:ux.l1.confirm.routine.en: the routine {name} (its level is set to {level})

zh:ux.l1.confirm.routinesKeep.text: 例行任务保持各自的级别。

zh:ux.l1.confirm.routinesFollow.text: 无论怎么选，上面的例行任务都会跟随默认级别。
zh:ux.l1.confirm.routinesFollow.en: Routines above follow the default either way.

zh:ux.l1.confirm.onComputer.text: 在这台电脑上，这包括你自己的屏幕、鼠标和键盘。
zh:ux.l1.confirm.onComputer.en: On this computer that includes your own screen, mouse and keyboard.

zh:ux.l1.confirm.everyRun.text: 这会更改{routine}的每一次运行。

zh:ux.l1.confirm.stale.text: 打开期间，{bot}的设置发生了变化。请重新查看，然后再选择。
zh:ux.l1.confirm.stale.en: {bot}'s settings changed while this was open. Look again, then choose.

zh:ux.l1.levelLine.routineOne.text: 现在有 1 个例行任务按{level}运行。

zh:ux.l1.levelLine.routineMany.text: 现在有 {n} 个例行任务按{level}运行。

zh:ux.l1.levelLine.backRoutineOne.text: 有 1 个例行任务又按{level}运行了。

zh:ux.l1.levelLine.backRoutineMany.text: 有 {n} 个例行任务又按{level}运行了。

zh:ux.l1.levelLine.applyRefused.text: {bot}的默认级别是{level}。对话的更新没有应用。
zh:ux.l1.levelLine.applyRefused.en: {bot}'s default is {level}. The conversation update was not applied.

zh:ux.l1.levelLine.applyUnconfirmed.text: {bot}的默认级别是{level}。Murage 没能确认对话的更新。
zh:ux.l1.levelLine.applyUnconfirmed.en: {bot}'s default is {level}. Murage could not confirm the conversation update.

zh:ux.l1.levelLine.nothingUndone.text: 之后{bot}又被更改过。没有撤销任何内容。
zh:ux.l1.levelLine.nothingUndone.en: {bot} has changed since. Nothing was undone.

zh:ux.l1.levelLine.undoneBothOne.text: 已为{bot}和 1 个对话撤销。

zh:ux.l1.levelLine.undoneBothMany.text: 已为{bot}和 {n} 个对话撤销。

zh:ux.l1.levelLine.keptOne.text: 有 1 个对话之后被更改过，保留了它的级别。
zh:ux.l1.levelLine.keptOne.en: 1 conversation has changed since and kept its level.

zh:ux.l1.levelLine.keptMany.text: 有 {n} 个对话之后被更改过，保留了它们的级别。
zh:ux.l1.levelLine.keptMany.en: {n} conversations have changed since and kept their level.

zh:ux.l1.levelLine.botKept.text: {bot}之后被更改过，保留了它的级别。
zh:ux.l1.levelLine.botKept.en: {bot} has changed since and kept its level.

zh:ux.l1.levelLine.restoreOnComputer.text: 在你的电脑上恢复这个级别
zh:ux.l1.levelLine.restoreOnComputer.en: Restore this level on your computer

zh:ux.l2a.door.tip.today.text: 发生了什么，以及哪些需要你处理
zh:ux.l2a.door.tip.today.en: What happened and what needs you

zh:ux.l2a.door.tip.needsYou.text: 所有在等你回答的事项

zh:ux.l2a.door.tip.routines.text: 你的机器人按计划做的事
zh:ux.l2a.door.tip.routines.en: What your bots do on a schedule

zh:ux.l2a.door.needsWaiting.text: 需要你处理，{n} 项在等待

zh:ux.l2a.door.needsUnknown.text: 需要你处理：详情暂时不可用
zh:ux.l2a.door.needsUnknown.en: Needs you: details not yet available

zh:ux.l2a.offline.desktop.text: 没有网络连接。这台电脑上的机器人会继续工作；已连接的应用和 Flux Router 会等网络恢复后再继续。
zh:ux.l2a.offline.desktop.en: No internet connection. Bots on this computer keep working; connected apps and Flux Router wait until it is back.

zh:ux.l2a.offline.phone.text: 没有网络。你电脑上的机器人会继续工作；网络恢复后，这部手机会自动同步。
zh:ux.l2a.offline.phone.en: No internet. Your computer's bots keep working; this phone catches up when it is back.

zh:ux.l2a.tag.fluxKey.en: Flux Router: the key is not working

zh:ux.l2a.tag.offline.text: 离线 · 这台电脑上的机器人会继续工作
zh:ux.l2a.tag.offline.en: Offline · bots on this computer keep working

zh:ux.l2a.tag.needsOne.text: 有 1 件事需要你处理

zh:ux.l2a.tag.needsMany.text: 有 {n} 件事需要你处理

zh:ux.l2a.working.none.text: 现在没有机器人在工作
zh:ux.l2a.working.none.en: No bot is working right now

zh:ux.l2a.working.stopping.text: 已请{name}停止。它目前完成的内容在它的聊天里。
zh:ux.l2a.working.stopping.en: Asked {name} to stop. What it did so far is in its chat.

zh:ux.l2a.still.ask.en: Ask what is taking so long

zh:ux.l2a.firstRun.title.text: 你的 Chief of Staff 正在帮你完成设置。
zh:ux.l2a.firstRun.title.en: Your Chief of Staff is getting you set up.

zh:ux.l2a.firstRun.sub.text: 三张简短的卡片，然后就是你的第一个结果。
zh:ux.l2a.firstRun.sub.en: Three short cards, then your first result.

zh:ux.l2a.firstRun.remote.text: 设置会在你的电脑上完成。请在那边打开 Murage 继续。
zh:ux.l2a.firstRun.remote.en: Setup finishes on your computer. Open Murage there to carry on.

zh:ux.l2a.health.summary.many.text: 有 {n} 项需要修复。先从{name}开始。

zh:ux.l2a.health.flux.none.text: 还没有 Flux Router 密钥。

zh:ux.l2a.health.flux.pct.text: 密钥正常。已使用额度的 {n}%。
zh:ux.l2a.health.flux.pct.en: Key working. {n}% of the allowance used.

zh:ux.l2a.health.enginesUsed.text: 你的机器人在用的引擎

zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.backupNotProtecte.text: 没有最近已验证的备份
备份已开启，但 Murage 没有可供检查的最近备份。
zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.backupNotProtecte.en: Backups are on, but Murage has no recent backup it could check.

zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.backupNotProtecte.text: 如果这台电脑现在出故障，你最近的工作可能找不回来。
zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.backupNotProtecte.en: If this computer fails now, your recent work may not come back.

zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.backupNotProtecte.text: 打开备份，立即运行一次，并查看上次没有完成的原因。
zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.backupNotProtecte.en: Open Backups to run one now and see why the last one did not finish.

zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.backupOverdue.hap.text: 计划的备份没有按时运行。
zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.backupOverdue.hap.en: A scheduled backup did not run on time.

zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.backupOverdue.mat.text: 有一点影响。你最新的工作还没有备份。
zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.backupOverdue.mat.en: A little. Your newest work is not backed up yet.

zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.backupOverdue.can.text: Murage 会在下一个计划时间再试一次。你也可以在备份中立即运行一次。
zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.backupOverdue.can.en: Murage tries again at the next scheduled time. You can also run one now in Backups.

zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.backupStalled.tit.text: 备份已开始，但还没有完成
zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.backupStalled.tit.en: A backup started and has not finished

zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.backupStalled.hap.text: 备份已开始，并且已超出预定时间。
zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.backupStalled.hap.en: A backup started and has run past its time.

zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.backupStalled.mat.text: 有一点影响。在备份完成之前，你最新的工作不会被备份。
zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.backupStalled.mat.en: A little. Your newest work is not backed up until one finishes.

zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.backupStalled.can.text: Murage 会继续关注。打开备份，查看进度并重新开始。
zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.backupStalled.can.en: Murage keeps watching it. Open Backups to see where it is and start again.

zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.ioPressure.title.text: Murage 空闲时保存了大量数据
zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.ioPressure.title.en: A lot of data was saved while Murage was idle

zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.ioPressure.happen.text: Murage 在无事可做时仍持续写入磁盘。
zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.ioPressure.happen.en: Murage kept writing to disk while it had nothing to do.

zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.ioPressure.matter.text: 这可能会让这台电脑变慢。负载过高时，Murage 会放慢自己的工作。
zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.ioPressure.matter.en: It can slow this computer down. Murage slows its own work down when it gets too heavy.

zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.ioPressure.canDo.text: 打开存储，看看是什么占用了空间。
zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.ioPressure.canDo.en: Open Storage to see what is taking up room.

zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.extraction.title.text: 记忆学习收到了无法使用的回复
zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.extraction.title.en: Memory learning got replies it could not use

zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.extraction.happen.text: Murage 用来学习的引擎返回了 Murage 无法使用的回复。
zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.extraction.happen.en: The engine Murage learns with sent back replies Murage could not use.

zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.extraction.matter.text: 你的机器人会继续工作。在问题解决之前，它们从近期对话中学到的会少一些。
zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.extraction.matter.en: Your bots keep working. They learn less from recent conversations until this clears.

zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.extraction.canDo.text: 打开记忆设置，重试被跳过的部分，或换一个引擎来学习。
zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.extraction.canDo.en: Open Memory settings to try what was skipped, or pick a different engine for learning.

zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.dispatch.title.text: 有些消息在多次重试后仍然中断
zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.dispatch.title.en: Some messages stopped after every retry

zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.dispatch.happened.text: 有些消息即使重试多次也没有得到回答。
zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.dispatch.happened.en: Some messages did not get an answer, even after every retry.

zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.dispatch.matters.text: 对这些消息有影响。每条消息会在它自己的聊天里显示发生了什么。
zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.dispatch.matters.en: Yes, for those messages. Each one shows what happened in its own chat.

zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.dispatch.canDo.text: 打开引擎，检查登录和上限，然后重新发送消息。
zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.dispatch.canDo.en: Open Engines to check sign-in and limits, then send the message again.

zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.engineHolds.title.text: 有引擎一直打开着文件，拖慢了清理
zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.engineHolds.title.en: An engine kept its files open and held up cleanup

zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.engineHolds.happe.text: 有引擎一直打开着文件，所以 Murage 在等待清理。
zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.engineHolds.happe.en: An engine kept its files open, so Murage is waiting to clean up.

zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.engineHolds.matte.text: 没有影响。你的对话会继续正常进行。

zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.engineHolds.canDo.text: 无需操作，Murage 正在处理。关闭该引擎自己的应用可以更快完成。
zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.engineHolds.canDo.en: Nothing to do, Murage is on it. Closing the engine's own app finishes this sooner.

zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.deletion.title.text: 部分已删除的对话仍在清除中
zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.deletion.title.en: Some deleted conversations are still being removed

zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.deletion.happened.text: 这些对话已从你的聊天中消失。Murage 仍在清除引擎文件中留下的副本。
zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.deletion.happened.en: These conversations are gone from your chats. Murage is still clearing the copies left in an engine's files.

zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.deletion.matters.text: 没有影响。Murage 会自行完成。
zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.deletion.matters.en: No. Murage finishes this by itself.

zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.deletion.mattersU.text: 没有影响。Murage 会在下次更新后再试一次。
zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.deletion.mattersU.en: No. Murage tries again after its next update.

zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.deletion.mattersS.text: 没有影响。Murage 会自行完成其中一部分，其余的在下次更新后再试。
zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.deletion.mattersS.en: No. Murage finishes some of this by itself, and tries the rest again after its next update.

zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.deletion.canDo.text: 无需操作，Murage 正在处理。
zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.deletion.canDo.en: Nothing to do, Murage is on it.

zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.sendFence.title.text: 有对话在发送前反复重建它的历史记录
zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.sendFence.title.en: A conversation keeps rebuilding its history before sending

zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.sendFence.happene.text: 有对话在每条消息发出前都会重建一次历史记录。
zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.sendFence.happene.en: A conversation keeps rebuilding its history before each message goes out.

zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.sendFence.matters.text: 只有一点影响。消息仍会发出，只是稍慢一些。
zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.sendFence.matters.en: Only a little. Messages still go out, a bit more slowly.

zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.sendFence.canDo.text: 无需操作，Murage 正在处理。
zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.sendFence.canDo.en: Nothing to do, Murage is on it.

zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.resets.title.text: 有对话在反复开启新的引擎会话
zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.resets.title.en: A conversation keeps starting a new engine session

zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.resets.happened.text: 引擎一直在用新的会话重新开始对话。
zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.resets.happened.en: The engine keeps starting a conversation again in a new session.

zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.resets.matters.text: 你的消息会保留。引擎可能需要一点时间跟上。
zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.resets.matters.en: Your messages are kept. The engine may need a moment to catch up.

zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.resets.canDo.text: 无需操作，Murage 正在处理。
zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.resets.canDo.en: Nothing to do, Murage is on it.

zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.isolationNoise.ti.text: 有些技能或智能体没有名称，因此 Murage 使用了文件名
zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.isolationNoise.ti.en: Some skills or agents had no name, so Murage used the file name

zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.isolationNoise.ha.text: 某个个人技能或智能体的文件里没有可用的名称，所以 Murage 使用了文件名。
zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.isolationNoise.ha.en: A personal skill or agent has no usable name in its file, so Murage went by the file name.

zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.isolationNoise.ma.text: 没有影响。这很常见，你的机器人照常工作。
zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.isolationNoise.ma.en: No. This is routine and your bots work as usual.

zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.silentServer.titl.text: Murage 没有发来最新的健康信息
zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.silentServer.titl.en: Murage has not sent fresh health information

zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.silentServer.happ.text: Murage 的健康数据已经有一阵子没有传来了。
zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.silentServer.happ.en: Murage's health figures have not come in for a while.

zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.silentDesktop.tit.text: 桌面应用没有发来最新的健康信息
zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.silentDesktop.tit.en: The desktop app has not sent fresh health information

zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.silentDesktop.hap.text: 桌面应用的健康数据已经有一阵子没有传来了。
zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.silentDesktop.hap.en: The desktop app's health figures have not come in for a while.

zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.statsStale.title.text: 存储数据在等待新的读取
zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.statsStale.title.en: Storage figures are waiting for a fresh reading

zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.statsStale.happen.text: 存储数据比应有的要旧。
zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.statsStale.happen.en: Storage figures are older than they should be.

zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.scanFailing.title.text: 最近的健康检查没有完成
zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.scanFailing.title.en: Recent health checks did not finish

zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.scanFailing.happe.text: 最近几次健康检查在完成之前就停止了。
zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.scanFailing.happe.en: The last few health checks stopped before they finished.

zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.sourceServer.titl.text: 来自 Murage 的健康信息在等待新的读取
zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.sourceServer.titl.en: Health information from Murage is waiting for a fresh reading

zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.sourceServer.happ.text: 暂时无法读取 Murage 的健康数据。
zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.sourceServer.happ.en: Murage's health figures could not be read just now.

zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.sourceDesktop.tit.text: 来自桌面应用的健康信息在等待新的读取
zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.sourceDesktop.tit.en: Health information from the desktop app is waiting for a fresh reading

zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.sourceDesktop.hap.text: 暂时无法读取桌面应用的健康数据。
zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.sourceDesktop.hap.en: The desktop app's health figures could not be read just now.

zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.sourceBackup.titl.text: 备份状态在等待新的读取
zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.sourceBackup.titl.en: Backup status is waiting for a fresh reading

zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.sourceBackup.happ.text: 暂时无法读取备份状态。
zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.sourceBackup.happ.en: The backup status could not be read just now.

zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.sourceDbStats.tit.en: Storage figures are waiting to be read

zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.sourceDbStats.hap.text: 暂时无法读取存储数据。
zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.sourceDbStats.hap.en: Storage figures could not be read just now.

zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.unknown.title.text: 一次健康检查发现了值得看一下的事项
zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.unknown.title.en: A health check found something to look at

zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.unknown.happened.text: 一次健康检查发现了这个版本的 Murage 还无法描述的情况。
zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.unknown.happened.en: A health check found something this version of Murage has no words for yet.

zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.unknown.matters.en: Nothing has stopped because of it.

zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.unknown.canDo.text: 目前无需操作。如果一直存在，可以问问你的机器人。
zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.unknown.canDo.en: Nothing to do right now. If it stays, ask your bot about it.

zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.coverage.matters.text: 你的机器人会继续工作。在此之前，健康状态可能稍有滞后。
zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.coverage.matters.en: Your bots keep working. Health may be a little out of date until then.

zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.coverage.canDo.text: 无需操作，Murage 正在处理。下次读取后就会恢复。
zh:ux.l2b.health.issue.coverage.canDo.en: Nothing to do, Murage is on it. This clears with the next reading.

zh:ux.l2b.health.lineAct.text: 有一项健康检查需要你处理。

zh:ux.l2b.health.lineWatch.en: Worth a look, nothing is urgent.

zh:ux.l2b.health.lineNote.text: 需要你处理的都已完成。Murage 正在收尾几件事。
zh:ux.l2b.health.lineNote.en: Everything that needs you is done. Murage is finishing a few things.

zh:ux.l2b.health.settingsLine.text: Murage 的检查发现了什么，以及该怎么处理。
zh:ux.l2b.health.settingsLine.en: What Murage's checks found, and what to do about it.

zh:ux.l2b.health.closedNone.text: 最近没有已解决的事项。

zh:ux.l2b.health.deletion.retryFailed.text: Murage 暂时无法重试。它会自动继续尝试。
zh:ux.l2b.health.deletion.retryFailed.en: Murage could not try again just now. It keeps trying by itself.

zh:ux.l2b.health.deletion.pending.text: 仍在清除：{n} 项。最早的已有{age}。
zh:ux.l2b.health.deletion.pending.en: Still clearing: {n}. The oldest is {age} old.

zh:ux.l2b.health.need.fluxUsedUp.text: 请增加 Flux 额度，让你的机器人继续工作。
zh:ux.l2b.health.need.fluxUsedUp.en: Add more Flux allowance so your bots can carry on.

zh:ux.l2b.health.need.fluxKey.text: 请检查你的 Flux 密钥，让你的机器人继续工作。
zh:ux.l2b.health.need.fluxKey.en: Check your Flux key so your bots can carry on.

zh:ux.l2b.health.need.engine.text: 你的机器人需要这个引擎才能回答。
zh:ux.l2b.health.need.engine.en: Your bots need this engine to answer.

zh:ux.l2b.health.deletion.holding.text: 正在等待{engines}关闭。之后 Murage 会自行完成。
zh:ux.l2b.health.deletion.holding.en: Waiting for {engines} to close. Murage finishes this by itself after that.

zh:ux.l2b.door.chipsLabel.text: 只显示某个机器人的卡片

zh:ux.l2b.door.keys.text: 按 Enter 打开卡片，按 Esc 关闭，J 和 K 移动，S 稍后提醒。在打开的卡片中，按 1 到 9 选择答案。
zh:ux.l2b.door.keys.en: Enter opens a card, Esc closes it, J and K move, S snoozes. In an open card, 1 to 9 pick an answer.

zh:ux.l2b.door.emptyMore.text: 当机器人需要你确认、登录或回答时，会显示在这里和“今天”里。
zh:ux.l2b.door.emptyMore.en: When a bot needs a yes, a sign-in or an answer, it shows here and on Today.

zh:ux.l2b.snooze.done.text: 已推迟到{time}。在你回答之前，它仍会计入。
zh:ux.l2b.snooze.done.en: Snoozed until {time}. It still counts until you answer it.

zh:ux.l2b.snooze.doneTomorrow.text: 已推迟到明天{time}。在你回答之前，它仍会计入。
zh:ux.l2b.snooze.doneTomorrow.en: Snoozed until tomorrow at {time}. It still counts until you answer it.

zh:ux.l2b.snooze.failed.text: 没能推迟，所以它仍留在列表里。
zh:ux.l2b.snooze.failed.en: That could not be snoozed, so it stays in the list.

zh:ux.l2b.snooze.undoFailed.text: 暂时没能恢复。到你选的时间，它会自动回来。
zh:ux.l2b.snooze.undoFailed.en: That could not come back just now. It comes back by itself at the time you picked.

zh:ux.l2b.snooze.returnBody.text: 你推迟的一项事务又在等你了。
zh:ux.l2b.snooze.returnBody.en: Something you snoozed is waiting on you again.

zh:ux.l2b.snooze.hiddenOne.text: 已推迟 1 项。在你回答之前，它仍会计入。
zh:ux.l2b.snooze.hiddenOne.en: 1 snoozed. It still counts until you answer it.

zh:ux.l2b.snooze.hiddenMany.text: 已推迟 {n} 项。在你回答之前，它们仍会计入。
zh:ux.l2b.snooze.hiddenMany.en: {n} snoozed. They still count until you answer them.

zh:ux.l2b.flux.detail.text: 使用 Flux Router 的机器人会等到额度重置或你增加额度。你自己的密钥可以立即使用。
zh:ux.l2b.flux.detail.en: Bots on Flux Router wait until the allowance resets or you add more. Your own key works right away.

zh:ux.l2b.health.doc.engineOff.matters.text: {engine}运行着{bots}。在它打开之前，它们无法回答。
zh:ux.l2b.health.doc.engineOff.matters.en: {engine} runs {bots}. They cannot answer until it is on.

zh:ux.l2b.health.doc.engineOff.mattersDe.text: {engine}是你的默认引擎。在它打开之前，新的聊天无法回答。
zh:ux.l2b.health.doc.engineOff.mattersDe.en: {engine} is your default engine. New chats cannot answer until it is on.

zh:ux.l2b.health.doc.engineOff.step.text: 请在你电脑上的“设置 › 引擎”中打开它。
zh:ux.l2b.health.doc.engineOff.step.en: Switch it on in Settings, Engines on your computer.

zh:ux.l2b.health.doc.engineMissing.matte.text: {engine}运行着{bots}。在这里设置好之前，它们无法回答。
zh:ux.l2b.health.doc.engineMissing.matte.en: {engine} runs {bots}. They cannot answer until it is set up here.

zh:ux.l2b.health.doc.engineMissing.matte.text: {engine}是你的默认引擎。在这里设置好之前，新的聊天无法回答。
zh:ux.l2b.health.doc.engineMissing.matte.en: {engine} is your default engine. New chats cannot answer until it is set up here.

zh:ux.l2b.health.doc.engineMissing.step.text: 请在你电脑上的“设置 › 引擎”中设置它。
zh:ux.l2b.health.doc.engineMissing.step.en: Set it up in Settings, Engines on your computer.

zh:ux.l2b.health.doc.engineSignedOut.mat.text: {engine}运行着{bots}。在你重新登录之前，它们无法回答。
zh:ux.l2b.health.doc.engineSignedOut.mat.en: {engine} runs {bots}. They cannot answer until you sign in again.

zh:ux.l2b.health.doc.engineSignedOut.mat.text: {engine}是你的默认引擎。在你重新登录之前，新的聊天无法回答。
zh:ux.l2b.health.doc.engineSignedOut.mat.en: {engine} is your default engine. New chats cannot answer until you sign in again.

zh:ux.l2b.health.doc.engineSignedOut.ste.text: 请在你电脑上的“设置 › 引擎”中重新登录。
zh:ux.l2b.health.doc.engineSignedOut.ste.en: Sign in again in Settings, Engines on your computer.

zh:ux.l2b.health.doc.engineLimit.matters.text: {engine}运行着{bots}。它们会等到上限重置。
zh:ux.l2b.health.doc.engineLimit.matters.en: {engine} runs {bots}. They wait until the limit resets.

zh:ux.l2b.health.doc.engineLimit.matters.text: {engine}是你的默认引擎。新的聊天会等到上限重置。
